roles.Phenomenon: Thm Phenomenon is the entity or situation in the world of which a Cognizer becomes aware.
roles.Purpose: The goal that the Cognizer has in mind, which they believe to be accomplishable by finding the Phenomenon.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Cognizer becomes aware of the Phenomenon.
roles.Topic: Topic indicates the general field within which the Phenomenon is found.

Becoming_detached.def: The Becoming_detached frame covers two situations: a scene in which one thing comes to be physically detached from something else; or a scene in which two things come to be disconnected from each other.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Item: This FE identifies the Item that detaches from the Source.
roles.Items: This FE identifies the plural Items that are becoming detached from each other, resulting in their separation.
roles.Manner: Any description of the detaching event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), seconda
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Item becomes detached.
roles.Source: Source identifies the location to which an Item was attached before getting detached.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Item becomes detached from the Source.

Becoming_dry.def: An Entity loses moisture with the outcome of being in a dry state.

roles.Circumstances: The situation in which the Entity is becoming dry.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity is the thing that loses moisture and becomes dry.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Entity becomes dry.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Entity becomes dry.
roles.Time: When the Entity becomes dry.

Becoming_separated.def: A Whole separates into Parts, or one part of a whole, called Part_1, becomes separate from the remaining portion, Part_2.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An intermediate action or event that enables the separation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part_1: Part-1 is the first of two Parts mentioned.
roles.Part_2: Part_2 is the second of two Parts mentioned.
roles.Parts: This refers collectively to the Parts resulting from separation of a Whole: 'These daughter chromosomes then begin to separate from each other, each moving away
roles.Place: Where the separation occurs. 'The two parts likely separated above the Atlantic.'
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of an event.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the separation occurs.
roles.Whole: The Whole is a single entity or an aggregate of entities which separates into Parts.

Becoming_silent.def: In this frame a Speaker ceases speaking, sometimes about a particular Topic.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Expressor: The Expressor is the Speaker's voice or other communicative noise emitted by the Speaker.
roles.Manner: The manner in which the quietening occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the location where the becoming silent occurs.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker has previously been speaking but has now stopped.
roles.Time: The Time is when the becoming silent occurs.

Becoming_visible.def: An Entity that is previously not visible to a Perceiver becomes visible.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The thing that the Perceiver is able to see or recognize.
roles.Manner: A description of how the Entity becomes visible that is not covered by more specific FEs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The physical location in which the Entity becomes visible.
roles.Time: A temporal description of the event of the Entity becoming visible.

Behind_the_scenes.def: Artists work at various tasks that further the completion of a film, play, television show, or other similar Production.

roles.Artist: The Artist works off-stage to help make the Production.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Distributor: Often (especially with film or television) the Production is advertised and transmitted to the audience by the Distributor.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Artist creates the Production.
roles.Medium: This FE indicates the Medium in which a particular Artist works or a Production is made.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Performer: In screen performances, the Performer is filmed as he or she acts out a role with respect to the larger Production 'This particular scene was shot with a local
roles.Place: This FE indicates the location of production.
roles.Production: The Production is the final product put out by the off-stage (and on-stage) participants.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which an Artist works on a Production.
roles.Scene: A Scene is a sub-part of a larger production.
roles.Score: The music which may be performed in the performance of the Production, either in isolation or accompanying actions and speech.
roles.Studio: This FE indicates the particular orgainzaion that makes the Production.
roles.Time: This FE indicates the time when the Production is made.
roles.Type: An Artist may be categorizedy by Type. 'Hollywood director' 'independent film-maker'

Being_active.def: An Agent is described as pursuing an Activity, expending some effort.

roles.Activity: This FE identifies the name of the ongoing Activity in which an Agent engages.
roles.Agent: The Agent engages in an ongoing Activity.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the amount of Time for which an Activity is ongoing.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Activity which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), and general de
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Activity is pursued.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent is engaged in an ongoing Activity.
roles.Role: This FE identifies the role filled by the Agent which is saliently associated with an Activity.
roles.Salient_entity: An entity acted upon by the Agent. 'As many as 324 companies' stocks were active across the board.'
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Activity is pursued.

Being_at_risk.def: An Asset is in a state where it is exposed to or otherwise liable to be affected by a Harmful_event, which may be metonymically evoked by reference to a Dangerous_entity.

roles.Asset: Something judged to be desirable or valuable which might be lost or damaged.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dangerous_entity: A concrete or abstract entity which may come to cause the loss of, or damage to the Asset either due to its participation in a Harmful_event.
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the state of security or insecurity of the Asset logically follows.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Harmful_event: An action that may occur or a state which may hold which could result in the loss of or damage to the Asset.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A particular location in which the Asset is secure.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Asset enjoys the specified level of security from a Harmful_event.

Being_attached.def: An Item is attached by a Handle, via a Connector, to a Goal, or Items are attached to each other.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Connector: Connector identifies the instrument used to attach and is usually expressed in a with-PP.
roles.Goal: Goal identifies the location to which the Item(s) is attached.
roles.Item: Item identifies the entity that comes to be attached to the Goal.
roles.Items: Items identifies the plural items that are tied together, resulting in their mutual attachment.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Item is in an attached state to a Goal, or two Items are attached to each other.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Being_awake.def: A Protagonist is awake at some Time and Place.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Protagonist is awake.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Protagonist being awake which is not covered by more specific FEs including secondary effects (quietly, noisily), and general description
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Protagonist: The entity that is not sleeping. 'She was awake through the whole football game.'
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Protagonist is awake.

Being_born.def: This frame concerns the inception of the life of a Child, generally human, at a particular Time and Place.

roles.Child: Child identifies the new self-motile creature.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Means: The way in which the Child leaves the womb; this FE is typically only filled by phrases such as by natural birth or by Caesarian.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Child enters the world.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the birth occurs, generally expressed as a date or a year.

Being_detached.def: An Item is detached from a Source, or Items are detached from each other.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Item: Item identifies the entity that is detached from a Source.
roles.Items: Items identifies the plural items that are detached from each other.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Item is in an detached state relative to a Source, or two Items are detached from each other.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Source: Source identifies the location from which the Item(s) is detached.

Being_dry.def: An Item is in a state of dryness. 'The shingles are dry.' 'The apple is completely dehydrated.' 'The mop is dry.'

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Item: The Item exists in a state of dryness. ' The mop is dry.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Being_employed.def: An Employee has a Position doing work in a particular Field, or doing work on a particular Task, for which an Employer gives Compensation to the Employee.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the amount of Time for which the Employee continues being employed.
roles.Employee: The Employee is obligated to perform a Task in order to receive Compensation.
roles.Employer: The Employer gives Compensation to an Employee.
roles.Field: This FE identifies the Field in which one works.
roles.Frequency: How often the Employee works.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Employee works for an Employer.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Employee works. 'Most people work in the city.'
roles.Place_of_employment: This FE identifies the Place_of_employment of the Employee.
roles.Position: The label given to a particular type of employment.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Employee is in employment.
roles.Task: The Employee is obligated to perform the Task to recieve Compensation from the Employer .
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time period during which an Employee works for an Employer.

Being_in_captivity.def: A Theme is held in captivity by an Agent or Cause.

roles.Cause: An inanimate force which causes the Theme in be unable to move.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Theme remains in captivity.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Theme is held captive.
roles.Holding_location: The area within which the Theme is confined.
roles.Manner: Any description of the state of being captive which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously),
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the general Place where the Theme is held captive.
roles.Theme: The entity which is confined. 'He was in captivity for six days.'
roles.Time: The Time when the Theme is held captive.

Being_in_category.def: An Item belongs to a Category, as (often implicitly) conceived of by a Cognizer.

roles.Category: This frame element expresses a general type or class of which the Item is considered an instance.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are the set of conditions in which the categorization holds.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Criteria: This frame element expresses properties of the Item which is used as a basis for categorization.
roles.Item: This is the entity which is is an instance of a particular Category.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which an Item (metaphorically) is construed as being in a Category.
roles.Means: An act or state of affairs by which the Item (perhaps metaphorically) is interpreted as being in a Category.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate when a certain Categorization holds.

Being_in_control.def: A Controlling_entity has control of a Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or Dependent_variable.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Controlling_entity: A thing or person whose behavior controls a Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or Dependent_variable.
roles.Degree: The Degree to which the Controlling_entity effects the Dependent_entity.
roles.Dependent_entity: An entity, usually a thing, that is influenced in its behavior by a Controlling_entity.
roles.Dependent_situation: A situation whose temporal or other characteristics are influenced by a Controlling_entity.
roles.Dependent_variable: A scalar variable, whose value depends on the behavior of a Controlling_entity.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descrip
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the controlling occurs.
roles.Time: The Time at which the controlling occurs.

Being_in_effect.def: A particular Binding_principle is (or is not) operative, that is, any obligations, restrictions, and any other aspects of the Binding_principle are (or are not) in effect.

roles.Binding_principle: The Binding_principle is the law, contract, principle, or other (set of) obligations that is (or is not) operational.
roles.Circumstances: The state-of-affairs under which the Binding_principle is/isn't operational.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time for which the Binding_principle is or is not in effect.
roles.Explanation: A cause, reason, or other Explanation for the status of the Binding_principle 'Your contract is null because you left the county.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place at which the Binding_principle is or is not operational.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Binding_principle is in effect.

Being_in_operation.def: A Device or machine is in (or out of) service.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Device: The Device or machine that is in or out of operation.
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place in which the Device is or is not operating.
roles.Time: The Time when a Device is in or out of operation.

Being_incarcerated.def: A Prisoner is punished for committing a Crime by being confined to a Prison for a specified period of time.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Prisoner remains in jail.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Prisoner is in custody.
roles.Manner: Any description of the state of being imprisoned which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the general Place where the Prisoner is held captive.
roles.Prison: The facility where the Prisoner is held.
roles.Prisoner: The Prisoner is held in custody as a punishment for having committed a crime.
roles.Time: The Time when the Prisoner is in prison.

Being_located.def: A Theme is in a stable position with respect to a Location.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Location: A salient entity that the Theme is located with respect to.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location (generally presumed to be known to the interlocutor) with respect to which the location of the Theme can be understood.
roles.Theme: An entity which is at a particular Location
roles.Time: The time at which the Theme is at the Location.

Being_named.def: This frame concerns entities conventionally being referred to by particular names.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity is the person the speaker intends to refer to by using a particular name.
roles.Name: Name identifies the linguistic expression used to refer to Entities.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Being_necessary.def: A Dependent state-of-affairs has a Requirement as a prerequisite for obtaining or occurring.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dependent: The state-of-affairs which cannot hold without the Requirement.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Place denotes a location in which the specified relation between Requirement and Dependent holds.
roles.Required_entity: An entity that has to be present for the Dependent state of affairs to obtain.
roles.Requirement: The entity or state-of-affairs that must be present or obtain in order for the Dependent to obtain.
roles.Time: The time at which the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent.

Being_obligated.def: Under some Condition, usually left implicit, a Responsible_party is required to perform some Duty.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duty: The action that the Responsible_party is obligated to perform.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A location in which the Responsible_party has a specified Duty .
roles.Responsible_party: The person who must perform the Duty. 'Everyone has the obligation to vote.'
roles.Time: The time interval during which the Responsibly_party is obligated to fulfill the Duty.

Being_obligatory.def: Under some Condition, usually left implicit, a Duty needs to be fulfilled by a Responsible_party.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duty: The action that the Responsible_party is obligated to perform.
roles.Explanation: The reason why the Duty is necessary for the Responsible_party.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A location in which the Duty obtains. 'Gymnasium is not obligatory in Sweden, but nearly everyone attends gymnasium'
roles.Purpose: The positive consequence of the Duty being fulfilled.
roles.Responsible_party: The person who must perform the Duty. 'The use of TM software is obligatory for every freelance translator working on projects for our company.'
roles.Time: The time interval during which the Duty is mandatory.

Being_operational.def: An Object with an understood function is or is not in a state ready to perform that function.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Object: The entity with an understood purpose.

Being_questionable.def: In this frame, an Entity or Behavior is suspicious or otherwise subject to question.

roles.Behavior: The Behavior is the state of affairs or action of the social actor that is regarded as susipcious.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity metonymically stands in for a Behavior that saliently involves the Entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Social_actor: An individual that is suspected of wrongdoing because of the Behavior.

Being_relevant.def: A Phenomenon is related to some cognitive action, the Endeavor, of a Cognizer.

roles.Cognizer: A participant in the mental Endeavor to which the Phenomenon is related.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Endeavor: A cognitive action (eg discussion, decision) performed by the Cognizer to which the Phenomenon is connected in some way.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomenon: Something that is profiled in the mind of the Cognizer as being related to mental Endeavors.

Being_rotted.def: An organic item, the Patient, has undergone the natural process of rotting and decaying with a possible expression of the Degree to which the rotting has occurred.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is the organic matter that has decayed.

Being_up_to_it.def: An Entity meets the pre-conditions for participating in an Activity that is judged to be difficult for it to participate in, either due to inherent properties of the Entity or temporary Circumstances.

roles.Activity: The Activity that the Entity may participate in.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the Entity meets or fails to meet the pre-conditions.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity whose meeting or falling short of pre-conditions is assessed.
roles.Explanation: An entity, event, or state that causes the Entity to meet or fail to meet the pre-conditions for participating in an Activity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Being_wet.def: An Item is in a state of wetness with the possibility of the wetting Liquid being mentioned, along with the Degree of wetness.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation brings about the state of wetness, and is usually expressed in a from-prepositional phrase.
roles.Item: The Item takes up the Liquid through its pores.
roles.Liquid: The Liquid is a fluid or gas that permeates the Item.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Besieging.def: An Assailant, a group of armed forces, surrounds the Victim, a military location and the people within it, in an attempt to cut the Victim off from the outside, with the goal of either forcing their surrender or weakening them so that an in

roles.Assailant: The Assailant is a group of armed forces (or, metonymically, their commander or the organization they represent) that encircles, surrounds, or otherwise cuts of
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Victim is under attack from the Assailant
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Assailant that accomplishes the assault.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Assailant makes an assault on the Victim.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Assailant attacks the Victim.
roles.Source: The starting-point of the motion of the Assailant or projectiles of the Assailant as they move toward the the Place that the Victim is occupying in the attack.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Assailant attacks the Victim.
roles.Victim: The Victim is the fortification or geopolitical entity that is being attacked.

Beyond_compare.def: Compared to its Competitors, a Standard is at the high end of a scale with respect to some Variable.

roles.Competitors: The FE Competitors denotes the entities that are exceeded by the Standard with regard to the Variable.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Standard: The Standard is the entity that is located closest to the end of the scale evoked by some Variable.
roles.Variable: The Variable is a property that evokes a scale along which the Standard is located closest to one extreme in comparison to its Competitors.

Billing.def: A Billing_authority communicates in written form that the Debtor owes the Owed_party (often the same as the Billing_authority) some amount of Money for certain Goods (including services) provided by the Owed_party or to clear a debt for a B

roles.Bad_action: An earlier action by the Debtor causing harm (directly or indirectly) to the Owed_party, for which the Owed_party expects compensation, and therefore bills the
roles.Billing_authority: The individual who communicates to the Debtor the Money that they owe.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Debtor: The person (or organization) that owes the Owed_party.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which an event occurs.
roles.Goods: The FE Goods is anything (including labor or time, for example) which is exchanged for Money in a transaction.
roles.Manner: Any description of the billing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparin
roles.Means: The means by which the billing occurs. 'The money was billed through a credit card transaction.'
roles.Money: Money is the thing given in exchange for Goods in a transaction, or as recompense for the Bad_action.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Owed_party: The Owed_party expects a specific amount of Money from the Debtor, either because the Debtor received Goods or because the Debtor performed a Bad_action against
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Rate: In some cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Biological_area.def: This frame contains words that denote large ecological areas as well as smaller locations characterized by the type of life present--in other words, geography locations as defined by biota.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Locale: This FE identifies a stable bounded area, and is typically the designation of the nouns of Locale-derived frames.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Biological_classification.def: This frame has to do with scientific taxonomy.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Member: The living organism which belongs to the expressed Rank.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Rank: The Rank is the taxonomic category to which the Member belongs.
roles.Subtype: The subtype of the Rank. 'Do humans belong to the order Primate?'

Biological_entity.def: The LUs in this frame refer to biological entities labeled by the FE Organism.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Organism: An organic that has naturally occuring bioligical processes and functions.

Biological_mechanisms.def: A trigger mechanism brings about a change in a biological system.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Location where the Systemic_effect takes place.
roles.Systemic_effect: The biological entity that is affected by the Trigger.

Biological_urge.def: An Experiencer is in a State where a biological urge is signaling the need to perform a certain action such as eating, drinking, stopping exertion, sleeping, regurgitating, or having sex.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration identifies the amount of time for which the Experiencer feels the urge.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer receives the biological signal and possesses the internal experience which is a reaction to the phsyical signal.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which the Experiencer has the biological urge.
roles.Expressor: Expressor is used for a gesture, expression, or body part indicating that the Experiencer is feeling a certain urge.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place is where the Experiencer feels the biological signal.
roles.State: State identifies the Experiencer's state of being.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Experiencer feels the biological signal.

Board_vehicle.def: A Traveller boards a Vehicle that they intend to use as a means of transportation either as a passenger or as a driver.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: The Manner describes a property of the motion not related to its trajectory.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Traveller boards the Vehicle.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Traveller boards the vehicle.
roles.Source: Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion outside of or off the Vehicle expresses the frame element Source.
roles.Time: When the boarding of the Vehicle takes place.
roles.Traveller: The Traveller is the entity which boards the Vehicle.
roles.Vehicle: The Vehicle is the intended means of conveyance of the Traveller.

Body_decoration.def: This frame concerns the decorations that human beings have on or apply to their bodies.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Decoration: Decoration is the decorative item that adorns the body.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Body_description_holistic.def: This frame covers descriptions of an entire human body, viewed as a gestalt (as opposed to descriptions based on salient body parts).

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Figure: This FE identifies the Figure or form being described by the target.
roles.Individual: This FE identifies the individual (or individuals) being described.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Body_description_part.def: This frame is concerned with words that describe a person based on a salient part of their body.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Figure: This FE identifies the Figure or form being described by the target.
roles.Individual: This FE identifies the Individual (or individuals) being described.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Body_mark.def: In this frame a Body_mark is present on a Possessor's body.

roles.Body_mark: This FE identifies the Body_mark. 'Mark has a cancerous mole on his back.'
roles.Cause: The Cause is the event that brings about the presence of the Body_mark.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Possessor: This Frame Element denotes the Possessor of the Body_mark.

Body_movement.def: This frame contains words for motions or actions an Agent performs using some part of his/her body.

roles.Addressee: Addressee only occurs in the Body-movement frame in sentences which are blends with Communication.
roles.Agent: The Agent uses some part of his/her body to perform the action.
roles.Body_part: With some verbs in this frame, the Body_part involved in the action is specified by the meaning of the verb and cannot be expressed separately.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period of time during which the movement of a Body_part occurs.
roles.Goal: Goal is any expression that identifies the endpoint of movement.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the body movement occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location within which the movement of a Body_part takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose of the body movement. 'He winked his eye to give her a hint'
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of an event.
roles.Source: Source is the place from which the Body_part is moved.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the body movement occurs.

Body_parts.def: This frame covers words for Body_part(s) (BP) belonging to a Possessor (Poss), which may be characterized by a Descriptor (Desc).

roles.Body_part: This Frame Element is the Body_part. 'Kim's arm is broken.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Possessor: This Frame Element denotes the Possessor of the Body_part.

Bond_maturation.def: A Financial_instrument (a bond or insurance) fulfills a condition at a certain Time after which the Issuer of the Financial_instrument is legally obligated to pay the Holder a monetary Value, based on the instrument's original Principle and

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Financial_instrument: The bond, insurance, or debt security which a Holder buys from an Issuer.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: When the Financial_instrument reaches maturity.

Borrowing.def: The Borrower takes possession of a Theme with the knowledge that the Borrower will have to give the Theme back to the Lender after a Duration of time.

roles.Borrower: The person who receives the Theme from the Lender for a Duration.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the Borrower has possession of the Theme.
roles.Lender: The person or institution who gives the Theme to the Borrower for a Duration.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Borrower gains possession of the Theme from the Lender.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Borrower gets the Theme from the Lender.
roles.Purpose: The aim of the Borrower which they believe will be accomplished by possessing the Theme.
roles.Theme: The object that the Borrower receives from the Lender for a Duration.
roles.Time: When the borrowing even occurs.

Boundary.def: This frame contains words that describe a Boundary between two Entities.

roles.Boundary: The region which is between the Entities or between the Entity and empty space.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entities: The joint construal of both Entities next to the Boundary.
roles.Entity: The entity that has a Boundary.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Bragging.def: A Speaker talks about a Topic, which may be an action performed by the Speaker or an entity or state of affairs that they are associated with in order to suggest that the Speaker is worthy of admiration.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee is the person to whom the Speaker communicated a message.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A characteristic of the entity or state of affairs denoted by the Topic which explains why the Speaker is proud of the association with the Topic referent.
roles.Expressor: Expressor is the body part or action that conveys the feeling of pride of the Speaker.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compa
roles.Means: An act whereby the Speaker makes a boastful statement.
roles.Medium: Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Speaker to transmit the statement.
roles.Message: A description of the state of affairs that redounds to the Speaker's credit 'Cosmai BRAGGED that Hyundai's latest quality rankings place the automaker on par wi
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The FE specifies the place where the statement takes place.
roles.Role: Role is used for the capacity in which the Topic entity or state of affairs is judged, and is expressed in as-PPs.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker is the person who produces a message about a Topic.
roles.Time: The time when the statement is made. 'The public does not care, but the media definitely do as Haddock herself boasted the next morning on Good Morning America.
roles.Topic: The Topic is a positively judged entity or state of affairs with which the Speaker is associated and about which they talk.

Breaking_apart.def: A Whole breaks apart into Pieces, resulting in the loss of the Whole (and in most cases, no piece that has a separate function).

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Any description of the event or participants not covered by more specific Frame Elements.
roles.Means: An action, event, or state that enables the event of breaking apart.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Pieces: The Pieces result from the breaking apart of the Whole.
roles.Place: The location at which the breaking apart takes place.
roles.Time: The time at which the breaking apart takes place.w
roles.Whole: The Whole goes into Pieces which were not (necessarily) definable subparts prior to breaking.

Breaking_off.def: An single Subpart breaks off from a Whole.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Any description of the event or participants not covered by more specific Frame Elements.
roles.Means: An action, event, or state that enables the event of breaking off.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the breaking off occurs.
roles.Subpart: The part of the Whole that is conceived as being broken or taken off from the remaining part of the whole.
roles.Time: The time at which the breaking off of the Sub_part happens.
roles.Whole: The piece that is presented in a less prominent position, and which is the landmark or remaining whole from which Sub_part breaks off.

Breaking_out_captive.def: An Agent brings about the end of a Theme's captivity at a Location_of_confinement in contravention of the plans or desires of a captor.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the individual who ends the confinement or captivity of the Theme.
roles.Circumstances: The state of the world when the Releasing event occurs.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation identifies the reason for which the Agent releases the Theme.
roles.Location_of_confinement: The location to which the Theme's motion was formerly inhibited.
roles.Manner: Any description of the release which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing even
roles.Means: The action of the Agent which brings about the release.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Theme ceases to be confined.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose identifies the purpose for which the Agent release the Theme.
roles.Theme: The Theme is the person or object in motion released by the Agent.
roles.Time: The Time identifies when the Agent release the Theme .

Breathing.def: An Agent causes Air to move in a direction, usually specifying either in or out of the body.

roles.Agent: The Agent's breathing causes the motion of the Air.
roles.Air: Air is the substance that the Agent causes to move.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances are expressions indicating prevailing physical conditions or states of affairs concurrent to the breathing event.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE idenitfies the Duration of time that an Agent breathes.
roles.Goal: This FE identifies the point at which the Air ends up as a result of the motion.
roles.Instrument: An entity that allows the Agent to breathe, either a natural part (the lungs, say) or a device (like a respirator).
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent breathes.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means of breathing.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the breathing occurs.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by breathing in the specified manner.
roles.Source: Source identifies the starting point of the Air.
roles.Time: The time at which breathing occurs. 'All I know is that he was still breathing at 2AM.'

Bringing.def: This frame concerns the movement of a Theme and an Agent and/or Carrier.

roles.Agent: The Agent is a sentient being who physically controls the movement of the Theme via the carrier, accompanying the Theme.
roles.Area: Area is used for descriprion of a general area in which the carrying action takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular or not to consist of a sin
roles.Carrier: The Carrier provides support for the Theme.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Explanation: Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is used to indicate the location of a participant in cases where the multiple participants of an event are not co-located in the typical fash
roles.Goal: Goal identifies the endpoint of the path.
roles.Means: The actions the Agent takes to move the Theme.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: Path along which carrying occurs. 'Karl carried the books across the campus.'
roles.Place: The Place is the general area that serves as a setting for the specific motion of the Agent and Theme (with Source, Path, or Goal).
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Carrier or Agent carries the Theme .
roles.Source: Source indicates the beginning of the path along which the Theme travels.
roles.Theme: The objects being carried. 'Karl toted the books to the car.'
roles.Time: The time in which the carrying event takes place.

Budget_status.def: Spending compared with a budget or limit: over, under, on track.

roles.Cause: What drove it.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Building.def: This frame describes assembly or construction actions, where an Agent joins Components together to form a Created_entity, which is profiled, and hence the object of the verb.

roles.Agent: The Agent builds a Created_entity. 'Jack built a new house.'
roles.Beneficiary: This extrathematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate.
roles.Components: This FE identifies the Components that form the Created_entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Created_entity: Created_entity identifies the entity that is created in the act of building.
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument(s) with which an Agent builds a Created_entity.
roles.Manner: This FE idenitifies the Manner in which an Agent builds a Created_entity.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent builds a Created_entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the building occurs.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of the act of building.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the building occurs.

Building_subparts.def: This frame includes words that name subparts of buildings that can be occupied by people.

roles.Building_part: The place or area specified inside a structure.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE describes where the Building_part is located.

Buildings.def: This frame contains words which name permanent fixed structures forming an enclosure and providing protection from the elements.

roles.Building: The entity built by the Builder which has some Function.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The building's location.

Bungling.def: An Agent performs an Action incorrectly. The affected Patient may be mentioned metonymically for the Action. 'Mickey botched that swing.' 'Julia bungled the cake.'

roles.Action: This FE identifies the Action that the Agent performs incorrectly.
roles.Agent: The Agent performs an action incorrectly.
roles.Area: The type of action that the Agent habitually bungles.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument with which an Agent bungles.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Agent bungles.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent bungles.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: Patient is the entity affected by the Agent's bungling of an Action.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the bungling occurs.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the bungling occurs.

Burying.def: An Agent or Cause places a Theme under a surface (often the ground) into a Goal location.

roles.Agent: The Agent intentionally buries the Theme.
roles.Beneficiary: The Beneficiary derives a benefit from the occurrence of the burying event.
roles.Cause: A non-animate force which buries the Theme.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration is the amount of time for which the Theme stays in the Goal location.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation that the Theme is buried.
roles.Goal: The FE Goal is the location where the Theme ends up.
roles.Manner: Any expression which describes a property of the placing action which is not directly related to the trajectory of the Theme's motion expresses the frame elemen
roles.Means: The Means is an act whereby the Agent achieves the burying of the Theme.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place indicates where the burying occurs.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by performing the burying action.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of the burying.
roles.Source: The Source is the initial location of the Theme, before it is buried.
roles.Theme: The Theme is the object that is buried. 'The pirate buried the gold under the tree.'
roles.Time: Time is when the burying occurs 'Smithers had buried the treasure there the night before.'

Business_closure.def: A business locale, the Entity, ceases to provide services and closes.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances that caused failure. Compared to Explanation, this describes situations or environments that lead to failure, not a specific reason for failur
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity is rendered unable to continue its regular operations.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is named as one of the causes of failure.
roles.Manner: The Manner describes the way in which the Entity failed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place of the failing entity. 'Every Ikea shut down in Ohio last week.'
roles.Time: The Time of the failure. 'The local McDonalds shut down in 2008 because the owner died.'

Businesses.def: A Proprietor owns or runs a Business which provides a Product (which may be goods or services).

roles.Business: Business identifies the company or establishment.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place in which the business is located.

Cache.def: A hidden Cache of a Resource is kept safe and available for later Use.

roles.Cache: This FE denotes the Cache of Resources. 'She concealed her cache of sweets under her sweater.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Possessor: The entity that possesses the Cache. 'Eventually our stash ran out and we had to get more.'
roles.Resource: The goods or commodity that is being stored in a Cache.
roles.Use: The future Use for the Resource. 'Police discover arms cache for school attack.'

Calendric_unit.def: Words in this frame name the different parts of the calendric cycle, both man-made and natural.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Relative_time: Relative_time is used for the word or words that locate the time with respect to an identifiable reference point.
roles.Unit: The calendric unit that is denoted. LUs in this frame all denote the Unit.
roles.Whole: Whole is used for the larger unit of which the target word names a part.

Candidness.def: This frame contains adjectives and nouns that describe the truth or sincerity of communication.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee is the person to whom the Message is communicated.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: This FE indicates the manner of candidness.
roles.Medium: Medium is the physical or abstract setting in which the Message is conveyed.
roles.Message: Message is the communicative content whose truth or sincerity is at issue.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Speaker: The Speaker produces the Message, the truth or sincerity of which is at issue.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the subject matter to which the Message pertains.

Capability.def: An Entity meets the pre-conditions for participating in an Event.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the Entity meets or fails to meet the pre-conditions.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity whose meeting or falling short of pre-conditions is assessed.
roles.Event: The Event that the Entity may participate in.
roles.Explanation: An entity, event, or state that causes the Entity to be meet or fail to meet the pre-conditions for participating in an Event.
roles.Frequency: This FE expresses how often the Entity is able to do the Event.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Role: The particular role that the Entity plays in the Event.
roles.Time: The time at which the Entity is capable of the Event.

Capacity.def: An Entity has the ability to contain a Theme.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the Entity meets or fails to meet the pre-conditions for containing.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity whose ability to contain items is assessed.
roles.Explanation: An entity, event, or state that causes the Entity to be able or unable to hold the items.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: The Purpose of the Entity's specified capacity.
roles.Theme: The Entity has the ability to contain the Theme, often expressed with a quantity.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Entity has or had a certain capacity.

Capital_stock.def: This frame concerns Stock, a purchasable and sellable asset representing a Shareholder's share in a company (the Issuer).

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Issuer: The entity that issues its Stock to the Shareholder.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Shareholder: The creditor that has invested into a business by purchasing some Type of its Stock.
roles.Stock: The investment that a Shareholder makes into a business, differing from property and assets.
roles.Type: The the kind of Stock, of which there are two: preferred or common.

Cardinal_numbers.def: This frame presents a situation where there is a certain Number of instances of an Entity or a certain Number that quantifies a Unit.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: This FE identifies the Entity enumerated by the Number.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Number: This FE identifies the Number. 'JP has almost one million dollars.'
roles.Unit: A Unit expresses some quantification of some property of an entity, event, or situation by providing a base value of the property combined with a Number express

Carry_goods.def: A Distributor sells, lends, or otherwise distributes a class of Goods.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Distributor: The Distributor maintains a store of Goods for the purpose of selling or otherwise distributing them.
roles.Duration: This FE indicates the length of time that the Distributor carries the Goods.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Goods: The Goods are kept on hand and distributed by the Distributor.
roles.Manner: Any description of the storing of goods which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient ch
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place indicates where the carrying of Goods occurs.
roles.Time: The Time when the Distributor carries the Goods.

Catastrophe.def: The words in this frame involve an Undesirable_event which affects the Patient negatively.

roles.Cause: The cause of the Undesirable_Event. 'Most counties are prepared for some level of natural disaster.'
roles.Circumstances: This FE indicates the Circumstances under which a warning applies.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The entity that experiences the Undesirable_Event.
roles.Place: Where the Undesirable_Event takes place.
roles.Time: When the Undesirable_Event occurs.

Catching_fire.def: A Fuel, some flammable object or substance, ends up on fire.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A description of why the event happened.
roles.Fire: The total material currently involved in combustion, including both the parts of the Fuel currently undergoing chemical alteration and the partially ionized gas
roles.Fuel: The entity that is begins to undergo rapid chemical alteration leading to damage or destruction.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Fire event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing e
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Fire begins to burn.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Fire begins to burn.

Categorization.def: A Cognizer construes an Item as belonging to a certain Category.

roles.Category: This frame element expresses a general type or class of which the Item is considered an instance.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are the set of conditions in which the categorization holds.
roles.Cognizer: This is the person who performs an act of categorization.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Criteria: This frame element expresses properties of the Item which is used as a basis for categorization.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Cognizer categorizes the Item in the given way.
roles.Item: This is the entity which is construed or treated by the Cognizer as being an instance of a particular Category.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act whereby the Cognizer categorizes.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate when a certain Categorization was made.

Causation.def: A Cause causes an Effect. Alternatively, an Actor, a participant of a (implicit) Cause, may stand in for the Cause. The entity Affected by the Causation may stand in for the overall Effect situation or event. '' Those frames that inherit th

roles.Actor: An entity which participates in a Cause, perhaps volitionally and perhaps not.
roles.Affected: Agents in a joint or reciprocal action (e.g.
roles.Cause: A force, process, or event that produces an effect.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Effect: A positive or negative evaluation of the Phenomenon.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: How often the action denoted by the target occurs.
roles.Manner: Any holistic description of the event, including overall depictions (the same way) and descriptions pertaining to the Actor's influence on the character of the
roles.Means: An action through which the Actor or Cause accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.

Cause_bodily_experience.def: An Agent or Cause affects a Body_part of an Experiencer so that the quality of the Experiencer's perceptual experience of the Body_part is qualitatively changed.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person causing a bodily experience in the Experiencer.
roles.Body_part: >The Body_part identifies the location on the Experiencer's body where the bodily experience takes place.
roles.Cause: The Cause marks expressions that indicate some non-intentional, typically non-human, force that affects the Experiencer's Body_part.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the causal event and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the Cause_bodily_experience event to its end.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the being or entity whose experience changes.
roles.Explanation: A fact or action somehow related to the Experiencer that the Agent responds to by causing an experience in the Experiencer.
roles.Frequency: How often the Cause_bodily_experience event occurs.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descrip
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Place identifies the place where the bodily experience is caused.
roles.Purpose: Purpose identifies the state-of-affairs that an Agent hopes to bring about by causing an experience in the Experiencer.
roles.Result: Result identifies the result of the Agent's action.
roles.Time: Time identifies the time when the experience-causing event occurs.

Cause_change.def: An Agent or Cause causes an Entity to change, either in its category membership or in terms of the value of an Attribute.

roles.Agent: The sentient entity that effects a change in the Entity.
roles.Attribute: A characteristic of the Entity for which a value can be assigned or determined by calculation, measurement , or observation.
roles.Cause: An event that causes a change in the Entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Entity: The abstract or concrete thing or situation that the Agent causes to change.
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in bringing about the change in the Entity.
roles.Final_category: The category that the Entity belongs to after it has undergone the change.
roles.Final_value: The value that the Attribute assumes as a result of the change that the Entity is caused to undergo.
roles.Initial_category: The category of which the Entity is a member before the Agent causes a change.
roles.Initial_value: The value that the Attribute has before the change takes place.
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent (or event resulting from the Cause) that produces a change in the Entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the change of the Entity is caused.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by effecting a change in the Entity.
roles.Time: The time at which the change of the Entity is caused.

Cause_change_of_consistency.def: In this frame an Agent or Cause changes the consistency of a Patient from its Initial_state to a Result.

roles.Agent: The Agent causes the change of consistency in the Patient.
roles.Cause: The Cause is the non-Agent which brings about the change in the Patient.
roles.Circumstances: This FE identifies the Circumstances at which the consistency change occurs.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which the Patient's consistency is changed.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument with which the Agent changes the consistency of the Patient.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Patient's consistency is changed.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent changes the consistency of the Patient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: Patient is the entity that undergoes a change.
roles.Place: Where the the Patient changes consistency.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Agent changes the consistency of the Patient.
roles.Result: Result is the result of the change of consistency.
roles.Time: When the Patient changes consistency.

Cause_change_of_phase.def: A Cause or Agent causes a Patient to undergo a change of phase.

roles.Agent: The Agent causes the Patient to change phase.
roles.Cause: The Cause is the non-Agent which brings about the change in the Patient.
roles.Circumstances: This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the phase change occurs
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time for which the Agent changes the phase of the Patient.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument with which the Agent intentionally affects the Patient.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Agent intentionally affects the Patient.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent intentionally affects the Patient
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient undergoes a change of phase brought about by the Agent.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where change of phase occurs.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which the Agent affects the Patient,
roles.Result: Result is the result of the change of phase.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time at which the change of phase occurs.

Cause_change_of_position_on_a_scale.def: This frame consists of words that indicate that an Agent or a Cause affects the position of an Item on some scale (the Attribute) to change it from an initial value (Value_1) to an end value (Value_2).

roles.Agent: The person who causes an entity (Item) to change its positon on a scale with respect to some property (Variable).
roles.Attribute: The scale along which the Item ranges in value.
roles.Cause: The force that causes the change. 'The rain increased the river's flow rate to an astonishing million gallons per second.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Item: The entity whose position along a scale is being changed.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Agent changing the value of an Attribute which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and ge
roles.Means: An act performed by the Agent that brings about the change in the position of the Item on the scale.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Agent changes the value of an Attribute.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Cause_change_of_strength.def: An Agent causes a Patient to be more strong, often resulting in something that is more secure and safe.

roles.Agent: The Agent fortifies the Patient.
roles.Cause: An event which causes the Patient to become stronger.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances of the world at the time of the event (which do not bear directly on the event itself).
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: An act performed by an Agent that enables them to act upon the Patient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is the entity that is being made stronger.
roles.Place: The location at which the Agent fortifies the Patient.
roles.Result: The resultant state of the action.
roles.Time: The time at which the Agent makes the Patient stronger.

Cause_emotion.def: An Agent acts to cause a Experiencer to feel a certain emotion.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person who's action's cause an emotion in the Experiencer.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The Event is the occasion or happening that evokes emotions in the Experiencer.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer feels an emotion as caused by the Agent.
roles.Explanation: This FE describes the reason for the state of affairs described by the target.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Instrument: The tool used by the Agent to cause an emotion in the Experiencer.
roles.Manner: In what way the Agent causes an emotion in the Experiencer.
roles.Means: An act performed by an Agent that enables them to act upon the Experiencer.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Agent causes the Experiencer to feel the emotion.
roles.Time: When the Agent causes emotion in the Experiencer.

Cause_expansion.def: An Agent or non-human Cause causes an Item to change its physical size.

roles.Agent: With some words in this frame, an Agent who causes the change in size of the Item may be present.
roles.Cause: The Cause is a non-human entity which brings about the change in size.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument with which the Agent causes the expansion of the Item.
roles.Item: The Item is frequently the External Argument of verbs or the NP Object if an Agent is expressed.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner of performing an action.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent brings about the expansion of the Item.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Agent cause the expansion of the Item.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Agent causes the expansion of the Item.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Agent causes the Item to expand.

Cause_fluidic_motion.def: An Agent or a Cause causes a Fluid to move from a Source to a Goal along a Path or within an Area.

roles.Agent: The animate protagonist who causes the Fluid to move.
roles.Area: The setting in which the Fluid's movement takes place along an unspecified Path.
roles.Cause: An event or force that causes the Fluid to move.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in causing the Fluid to move.
roles.Fluid: The entity that changes location and moves in a fluidic way.
roles.Goal: Goal is the location the Fluid ends up in as a result of the motion 'Why did you squirt juice onto my chair?'
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.Means: An action of the Agent which brings about the motion of the Fluid.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: The trajectory along which the Fluid moves, exclusive of the Source and Goal.
roles.Place: The location where the motion takes place.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Agent is attempting to bring about by causing motion.
roles.Result: A state of the Fluid that results from the motion event.
roles.Source: The location that the Fluid occupies initially.
roles.Time: The Time when the fluidic motion event is caused.

Cause_harm.def: The words in this frame describe situations in which an Agent or a Cause injures a Victim.

roles.Agent: Agent is the person causing the Victim's injury.
roles.Body_part: The Body_part identifies the location on the body where the bodily injury takes place.
roles.Cause: The Cause marks expressions that indicate some non-intentional, typically non-human, force that inflicts harm on the Victim 'A falling rock crushed my ankle.'
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the Cause_harm event and any of its particip
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
