roles.Adversity: The Adversity is a state of affairs or entity that hinders or negatively affects the Event.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The Event that occurs despite an Adversity that would seem to contradict the possibility of its occurence.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Contrition.def: An Experiencer feels bad about a choice, an Action, or a failure to do something, which they now consider to have been a mistake or wrong.

roles.Action: The FE Action marks expressions that indicate a prior action that the Experiencer has come to feel bad about.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Emotional_state: The FE Emotional_state is modified by an adjective that indicates the Experiencer is contrite.
roles.Experiencer: The FE Experiencer indicates the person who experiences the emotion about their prior action.
roles.Expressor: The FE Expressor marks expressions that indicate a gesture or body part which is displaying the Emotional_state of the Experiencer.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Experiencer or Expressor has contrition.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The Time at which the Experiencer or the Expressor is contrite.

Control.def: A Controlling_entity, Controlling_situation, or Controlling_variable control a Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or Dependent_variable.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Controlling_entity: A thing or person whose behavior controls a Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or Dependent_variable.
roles.Controlling_situation: A situation whose temporal or other characteristics control a Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or Dependent_variable.
roles.Controlling_variable: A scalar variable (with unspecified value) which has an effect on the Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or Dependent_variable.
roles.Degree: The Degree to which the Controlling element affects the Dependent element.
roles.Dependent_entity: An entity, usually a thing, that is influenced in its behavior by a Controlling_entity or an Controlling_situation.
roles.Dependent_situation: A situation whose temporal or other characteristics are influenced by a Controlling_entity, Controlling_situation, or Controlling_variable.
roles.Dependent_variable: A scalar variable, whose value depends on the behavior of a Controlling_entity, a Controlling_situation, or a Controlling_variable.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descrip
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the controlling occurs.
roles.Time: The Time at which the controlling occurs.

Controller_object.def: This frame contains items which, when manipulated, alter the function of some device, internal or external.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Control: This FE identifies the entity or substance that is designed to have a particular Use.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Convey_importance.def: Through a Message, a Speaker (sometimes encoded metonymically by a Medium) communicates the relative importance of the state of affairs denoted by the Message.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee is the audience to which the Speaker communicates the Message.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, in particular secondary effects (loudly), general descriptions comparing even
roles.Means: The Means by which the Speaker communicates the importance of the state of affairs denoted by the Message.
roles.Medium: The physical or abstract setting in which the Message is conveyed.
roles.Message: The proposition whose denotation the Speaker presents as important.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Speaker delivers the Message.
roles.Speaker: The person who uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey a Message to another person.
roles.Time: The time at which the Speaker communicates a Message.

Convoy.def: A Convoy consists of several Vehicles which move together to transport Cargo from a Source to a Goal.

roles.Cargo: The Cargo are the goods and/or individuals transported by the Convoy.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Convoy: The group of vehicles transporting the Cargo.
roles.Goal: The Goal is the endpoint of path along which the Convoy travels.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The general Place where the Convoy is operating.
roles.Source: The Source is the beginning of the path along which the Convoy travels.
roles.Support: People and possibly other elements of the convoy who support and defend the transport of the Cargo are the Support.
roles.Vehicles: The constituent vehicles that make up the Convoy.

Cooking_creation.def: This frame describes food and meal preparation.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Cook: The Cook prepares the Produced_food. 'Drew cooked dinner for his friends.' 'Drew baked an apple pie.'
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the cooking creation performed.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the cooking creation is performed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the cooking creation occurs.
roles.Produced_food: The Produced_food is the result of a Cook's efforts.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the cooking creation is performed.
roles.Recipient: Recipient identifies the person for whom the food has been prepared.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the cooking creation occurs.

Corporal_punishment.def: Blend of Rewards_and_punishments and Bodily_injury in which the Agent performs some action intended to cause Bodily harm to the Evaluee as a consequence of some action or belief of the Evaluee (the Reason).

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person performing the intentional act.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: Evaluee is the person or thing about whom/which a judgment is made.
roles.Instrument: The instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: The action that is taken that results in punishement/reward.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Reason: Typically, there is a constituent expressing the Reason for the Judge's judgment.
roles.Result: Result of an event
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Correctness.def: A particular piece of Information is evaluated for its accuracy.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Communicative_act: The event which communicates the Information.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: How often the Information is correct.
roles.Information: The Information matches or does not match the facts of the world.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Source is correct/incorrect.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Result: The outcome of the correctness if the Source or Information.
roles.Source: The Source is the agent who holds the correct/incorrect information.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Information or the Source is correct.
roles.Topic: The Topic about which the Source has accurate information.

Corroding.def: In this frame the Patient, an inorganic item, undergoes a chemical process which renders it less useful, desirable or stable.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifes the Duration of time for which the Patient corrodes.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which the Patient corrodes.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient undergoes a change. 'The bikes rusted from their former beauty.'
roles.Place: The Place where the Patient corrodes.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of the change of phase.
roles.Time: The Time when the Patient corrodes.

Corroding_caused.def: In this frame, the Patient, an inorganic item, undergoes a chemical process caused by another entity, which renders it less useful, desirable or stable.

roles.Agent: The individual that corrodes the Patient.
roles.Cause: Cause identifies an animate or inanimate entity, a force, or event that corrodes the Patient.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Cause corrodes the Patient.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which the Patient is corroded.
roles.Instrument: The Agent may use an Instrument to cause the corrosion.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Cause corrodes the Patient.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Cause corrodes the Patient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is corroded by the Cause. 'The metal was corroded by the water.'
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Cause corrodes the Patient.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Patient is corroded.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of the caused corrosion.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Cause corrodes the Patient.

Cotheme.def: This frame contains words that necessarily indicate the motion of two distinct objects.

roles.Area: Area marks expressions which describe a general area in which the motion of Theme and Cotheme takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular and not
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Cotheme: This frame element is the second moving object, expressed as a direct object or an oblique: 'Pat accompanied me down the street.' 'The squirrel chased after the
roles.Direction: The direction in which the Theme and Cotheme move.
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which motion occurs.
roles.Explanation: Some event or state of affairs that leads to the Theme following the Cotheme.
roles.Goal: Any expression which tells where the Cotheme ends up as a result of the motion expresses the frame element Goal.
roles.Means: This frame element expresses the Means by which a (volitional) Theme moves in relation to the Cotheme.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: Path marks phrases that describe the Theme and Cotheme's trajectory of motion and which are neither expressions of the Source nor the Goal of motion.
roles.Place: The Place is the location which provides a setting for a defined motion (that is one with Source, Path or Goal).
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which a Theme moves.
roles.Road: Phrases that denote a physical path on which the motion of Theme and Cotheme takes place are marked Road.'The police followed the suspect on the interstate for
roles.Source: Source marks any expression which implies a definite starting-point of the motion of the Cotheme.
roles.Theme: This is the entity, frequently a living being, which moves in relation to the Cotheme.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the motion occurs.

Counterattack.def: An Assailant physically attacks a Victim (which is usually but not always sentient), causing or intending to cause the Victim physical damage.

roles.Assailant: The person (or other self-directed entity) that is responding to a prior attack by attempting physical harm to the Victim.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Assailant is responding to that leads them to make an assault on the Victim.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Assailant that accomplishes the assault.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Assailant makes an assault on the Victim.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Assailant attacks the Victim.
roles.Result: The Result of the attack on the Victim by the Assailant.
roles.Source: The starting-point of the motion of the Assailant or projectiles of the Assailant as they move toward the the Place that the Victim is occupying in the attack.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Assailant attacks the Victim.
roles.Victim: This FE is the being or entity that is injured by the Assailant's attack.

Court_examination.def: A Questioner asks a Witness (or defendant) questions in the context of a court procedure.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: How long the examination takes place. 'The gruelling two-hour cross-examination revealed much new information regarding the murder.'
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Questioner examines the Witness.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Questioner examines the Witness.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the examination takes place.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose of the examination. 'The defense examined their own client in order to show the jury her compassionate side.'
roles.Questioner: The individual who asks a Witness questions.
roles.Time: When the examination occurs.
roles.Witness: A person who is present in a courtroom in order to give some form of evidence, has been sworn in, and is being examined by a Questioner.

Craft.def: A particular Activity, performed conventionally or habitually by more than one Practitioner within a Culture, is described in terms of its method.

roles.Activity: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate the Activity that is being performed habitually or conventionally.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Culture: A Culture within which the Activity is performed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate the Place in which the Activity is performed.
roles.Practitioner: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate whose Activity is at issue.

Create_physical_artwork.def: A Creator creates an artifact that is typically an iconic Representation of an actual or imagined entity or event.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Creator: An individual or individuals that bring the Representation into existence.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the creation of the Representation ogically follows.
roles.Instrument: The entity which the Creator uses to create the work of art.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compa
roles.Means: An action performed by the Creator which brings about the creation of the Representation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Creator produces the Representation.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Creator intends to accomplish by creating the Representation.
roles.Representation: The entity that is created to represent either iconically or abstractly.
roles.Role: This FE identifies a Role that one of the role fillers of the current frame also fills in a background context, either generically or in some specific instance.
roles.Time: The time at which a Representation is created.

Create_representation.def: A Creator produces a physical object which is to serve as a Representation of an actual or imagined entity or event, the Represented.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Creator: An individual or individuals that bring the Representation into existence.
roles.Instrument: The entity used by the Creator to make a Representation of the Represented entity.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compa
roles.Means: The action of the Creator that allows them to make a Representation of the Represented entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the artist produces the representation.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Creator intends to accomplish by creating the Representation.
roles.Represented: The entity--which may be a thing, an action or a state--that is represented by the Representation.
roles.Role: This FE identifies a Role that one of the role fillers of the current frame also fills in a background context, either generically or in some specific instance.
roles.Time: The time at which a Representation is created.

Creating.def: A Cause leads to the formation of a Created_entity.

roles.Beneficiary: The Beneficiary benefits in some way from the creation of the Created_entity.
roles.Cause: An animate or inanimate entity, a force, or event that produces an effect.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Co-participant: A secondary agent with whom the Creator intentionally creates the Created_entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Created_entity: This FE identifies the entity that the Agent intentionally creates.
roles.Creator: The Creator creates a created entity.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the instrument with which an Agent intentionally creates a Created_entitiy.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which a Creator intentionally creates a new entity.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which a Creator intentionally creates a new entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place ehere the Agent intentionally creates the new entity.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which the Creator intentionally creates a new entity.
roles.Recipient: The individual who is intended to receive the Created_entity.
roles.Time: This FE identifes the Time when an Agent intentionally creates a new entity.

Credential.def: A password, PIN, code or login for a device, network, account or door. Recognized so that secrets can be withheld; only the existence of the credential is remembered.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Criminal_investigation.def: This frame describes the process that involves the inquiry and determination by an authority, the Investigator, of the circumstances surrounding an Incident perpetrated by a Suspect.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of the investigation. 'The police carried out a two-year investigation into terrorist kidnappings.'
roles.Incident: The Investigator attempts to determine the exact circumstances surrounding the Incident, which is typically a criminal act (murder, robbery) or the result of su
roles.Investigator: The Investigator is the person or agency that investigates the Suspect of a crime (Incident).
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Suspect: This FE denotes the Suspect that is investigated by the Investigator.
roles.Time: When the Investigator investigates the Incident.

Cure.def: This frame deals with a Healer treating and curing an Affliction (the injuries, disease, or pain) of the Patient, sometimes also mentioning the use of a particular Treatment or Medication.

roles.Affliction: The Frame Element Affliction is generally the NP Object of a verb, frequently incorporating the Patient as a possessor, as described above: 'This potion heals a
roles.Body_part: The Body_part is the specific area of the Patient's body which is treated.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period of time that the Patient recieves the Treatment.
roles.Healer: The Healer, anyone who treats or cures the Patient, occurs as the External Argument of verbs: 'Doctors alleviated his suffering.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Medication: The injested, applied, injected, etc. substance designed to cure the Patient. 'He needs prolonged treatment with anibiotics. ' Note the tight relationship betwe
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: This is the sufferer of the injury, disease or pain and can occur as an NP Object in this frame.
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.
roles.Treatment: The FE Treatment is used for treatments and means, distinguished by separate FEs in FN-1.

Custom.def: A Behavior is classified as entrenched for a Protagonist or a Society.

roles.Behavior: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate the entrenched Behavior.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE marks expressions that indicate a region where the Behavior is entrenched.
roles.Protagonist: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate whose entrenched Behavior is at issue.
roles.Society: 'We can help , you to meet Egyptian people and learn about Egyptian customs.

Cutting.def: An Agent cuts a Item into Pieces using an Instrument (which may or may not be expressed).

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person cutting the Item into Pieces.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which the Item is being cut into Pieces.
roles.Item: The item which is being cut into Pieces. 'People back then had to chop firewood all day long.'
roles.Manner: Manner in which the Item is being cut into Pieces.
roles.Means: An act of the Agent that accomplishes the slicing.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Pieces: The Pieces are the parts of the original Item which are the result of the slicing.
roles.Place: Where the slicing takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Item is being sliced into Pieces.
roles.Result: The Result of the Item being sliced into Pieces.
roles.Time: When the slicing occurs.

Damaging.def: An Agent affects a Patient in such a way that the Patient (or some Subregion of the Patient) ends up in a non-canonical state.

roles.Agent: The conscious entity, generally a person, that performs the intentional action that results in the damage to the Patient.
roles.Cause: An event which leads to the damage of the Patient.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in performing the action.
roles.Instrument: An entity directed by the Agent that interacts with a Patient to accomplish the damage.
roles.Manner: Any description of the action of damaging which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), forc
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the damage.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The entity which is affected by the Agent so that it is damaged.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the location of the scene where a Agent damages a Patient.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent causes the damage to the Patient.
roles.Result: Result of the Agent's action. 'She tore the sugar packet open'
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent damages the Patient.

Daring.def: An Agent performs some Action which is considered imprudent.

roles.Action: This FE denotes the Action taken by the Agent.
roles.Agent: The individual that performs the Action, resulting in danger to themself.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation the Agent takes the risk.
roles.Manner: Any description of the risking action which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compari
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Agent risks doing the Action.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Action is performed.
roles.Time: The time at which the Agent dares to perform the Action.

Dead_or_alive.def: A Protagonist is in the dynamic, maintained state of being alive or has exited this state.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: Explanation identifies any object or event that brings about the death of the Protagonist.
roles.Figure: This FE identifies the Figure or form being described by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Protagonist: Protagonist identifies the being or entity that is dead or alive.
roles.Time: The time in which the Protagonist is dead or alive.

Death.def: The words in this frame describe the death of a Protagonist.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The FE Explanation expresses any object or eventuality that brings about the Protagonist's death.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descrip
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The FE Place indicates where the death takes place.
roles.Protagonist: The FE Protagonist is the being or entity that dies.
roles.Result: The FE Result indicates what occurs as the result of the death of the Protagonist.
roles.Time: The FE Time denotes when the dying or killing occurs.

Deception_success.def: A Deceiver successfully causes a Victim to end up with incorrect beliefs about a Topic.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Deceiver: The person who acts so as to give the Victim an incorrect idea about a Topic.
roles.Means: The action performed by the Deceiver to fool the Victim.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomenon: The Phenomenon, as percieved by the Victim, causes the Victim to have an incorrect understanding about a Topic.
roles.Place: The location at which the deception occurs.
roles.Time: The time at which the deception occurs.
roles.Topic: The entity to which the misleading idea relates, what it is about.
roles.Victim: The person who receives an incorrect idea because of the Deceiver's actions.

Deciding.def: A Cognizer makes a Decision, which may be about an entity or a course of action.

roles.Cognizer: The Cognizer decides on a course of action.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Decision: Decision identifies the entity or course of action upon which the Cognizer decides.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Cognizer makes the Decision.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Cognizer makes a Decision
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the Cognizer makes the decision.
roles.Time: The time or time period over which the Cognizer makes the decision.

Defending.def: A Defender responds to an Assailant's attack on a Victim by directly, and usually violently, countering it.

roles.Assailant: The person (or other self-directed entity) that is attempting physical harm to the Victim.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Defender: This FE is the being or entity that responds forcefully to the Assailant's attack.
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Defender is responding to that leads them to protect the Victim.
roles.Instrument: An entity used by the Defender fend off the Assailant .
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Defender that accomplishes their defense of the Victim.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Defender defends the Victim from the Assailant.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Defender defends the Victim from the Assailant.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Defender takes forceful action against the Assailant.
roles.Victim: The individual or entity that is under attack from the Assailant .

Degree.def: LUs in this frame modify a gradable attribute and describe intensities at the extreme positions on a scale.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Degree_of_processing.def: A Material has been processed (generally industrially) to some Degree in order to make it more useful for some (usually implicit) function.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Material: The substance which is altered in some useful way.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Delimitation_of_diversity.def: An Item which encompasses characteristics or types whose diversity is indicated by adducing a Limit1 and a Limit2 which differ considerably from each other.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Item: The entity whose scalar property is specified.
roles.Limit1: The first-mentioned possibility of the range of variation.
roles.Limit2: The second item of the range of variation.
roles.Limits: The range of positions on the scale that the Item occupies.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Variable: The scalar property that the Item possesses.

Delivery.def: A Deliverer hands off a Theme to a Recipient or (more indirectly) a Goal location, which is accessible to the Recipient.

roles.Beneficiary: The person for whom the Delivery action occurs.
roles.Circumstances: The conditions under which the delivery takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Deliverer: This is the person who completes the movement of the Theme after having transported it.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for the delivery. 'Letters are generally delivered in the morning because that's when most people are home.'
roles.Goal: The end of the path and intended goal of the sending.
roles.Manner: Any description of the delivery event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondar
roles.Means: The Means are intermediate actions performed by the Deliverer in order to move the package to the Goal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the delivery takes place.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose of the delivery. 'Rachel delivered the letter to her mother to see how she would react on getting it.'
roles.Recipient: This is the Recipient of the sent Theme. 'Tess delivered a package to Abby and her kitty.'
roles.Source: The location of the Theme before the delivery process begins.
roles.Theme: The objects being delivered. 'I delivered the documents to the court house.'
roles.Time: When the delivery takes place 'I delivered the letter to you last week, Sir.'

Deny_or_grant_permission.def: In this frame, an Authority allows a Protagonist to know (in some way) that they may or may not engage in an Action.

roles.Action: The Action is what the Protagonist seeks to do, but is ordered not to.
roles.Authority: The Authority orders the Protagonist to not engage in a particular Action.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: How often the event occurs.
roles.Manner: A holistic description of the event (the same way), or a description of the Authority that also affects the overall event (carefully).
roles.Means: The action performed by an Authority that brings about the Denying or Granting Permission.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is where the denial of permission occurs.
roles.Protagonist: The Protagonist wants to engage in an Action, but is ordered not to by the Authority.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose is what the Authority hopes to accomplish by denying permission.
roles.Time: The Time is when the denying of permission occurs.

Departing.def: An object (the Theme) moves away from a Source.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the motivation or explanation for why the Theme departs.
roles.Frequency: The Frequency is the rate at which each Theme departs.
roles.Goal: This FE labels any expression which tells where the Theme ends up, or would end up, as a result of departing from the Source.
roles.Manner: Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion expresses the frame element Manner.
roles.Means: The action of the Theme which results in its departure.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the location in which the departing takes place.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Theme departs from the Source.
roles.Source: All the verbs in this frame express some change of location, away from one place and to another.
roles.Theme: This is the object which moves. It may be an entity which moves under its own power, but it need not be. 'The officer left the house.'
roles.Time: The Time at which the departure takes place.'We left in the morning.'

Deserving.def: The existence of a State_of_affairs is sufficient reason for taking an Action .

roles.Action: An Action that is taken to be justifiable given the State_of_Affairs.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the Deserving event and any of its participa
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State_of_affairs: An Eventuality or an Entity that is taken to constitute sufficient reason for taking another Action.

Desirability.def: This frame concerns an Evaluee being judged for its quality, i.e.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions under which the quality of the Evaluee is being judged.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: The Evaluee is being judged for its quality.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Parameter: This FE marks expressions that denote a scalar property of the Evaluee with respect to which the Evaluee is judged.

roles.Circumstances: The FE Circumstances encodes a setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the State_of_affairs has the specified assessment of desirability.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: The event or state of affairs that is achieved by bringing about the desirable State_of_affairs.
roles.State_of_affairs: The State_of_affairs that the speaker finds desirable.

Desiring.def: An Experiencer desires that an Event occur.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the Experiencer has desired something.
roles.Event: The change that the Experiencer would like to see.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the person (or sentient being) who wishes for the Event to occur.
roles.Explanation: An aspect of the Experiencer that causes a desire.
roles.Focal_participant: This is the entity that the Experiencer wishes to be affected by some Event.
roles.Location_of_event: The Location_of_event is the place involved in the desired Event.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Experiencer desires something.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place. Note that this FE is of extremely rare occurrence in this frame. 'In the car I had desired nothing more than to get here, but now t
roles.Time: The Time is when the Experiencer desires something.

Destiny.def: An State_of_affairs will come to hold with respect to a Protagonist at some future time.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: The way in which the State_of_affairs is destined to occur to the Protagonist.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which State_of_affairs is destined to occur to the Protagonist.
roles.Protagonist: The Protagonist is the one for whom the future State_of_affairs is destined.
roles.Role: The Role filled by the Protagonist in his/her destiny.
roles.State_of_affairs: The State_of_affairs that is destined to occur to the Protagonist.
roles.Time: The time for which the Protagonist's future is determined.

Destroying.def: A Destroyer (a conscious entity) or Cause (an event, or an entity involved in such an event) affects the Patient negatively so that the Patient no longer exists.

roles.Cause: The event or entity which is responsible for the destruction of the Patient.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Destroyer: The conscious entity, generally a person, that performs the intentional action that results in the Patient's destruction.
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Destroyer is responding to in destroying the Undergoer.
roles.Frequency: How often the Cause or Destroyer destroys the Patient.
roles.Instrument: An entity directed by the Destroyer that interacts with a Patient to accomplish the Patient's destruction.
roles.Manner: Any description of the process of destruction which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously),
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Destroyer that accomplishes the destruction.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The entity which is destroyed by the Destroyer.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Destroyer destroys the Patient.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which a Destroyer causes the destruction of the Patient.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of an event on the Patient.
roles.Role: The category in which the Patient is destroyed.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Destroyer destroys the Patient.

Detaching.def: The Detaching frame covers two situations: a scene in which somebody causes one thing to be physically detached from something else; or a scene in which somebody causes two things to be disconnected from each other.

roles.Agent: The individual that causes the Item and Source to come apart by manipulating the connector.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument with which an Agent detaches an Item or Items.
roles.Item: This FE identifies the Item that the Agent detaches from the Source.
roles.Items: This FE identifies the plural Items that are detached from each other, resulting in their separation.
roles.Manner: Any description of the detaching event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), seconda
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent detaches an Item or Items.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Agent detaches an Item or Items.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent intentionally detaches an Item or Items.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of a detaching event.
roles.Source: Source identifies the location to which an Item was attached before getting detached.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Agent detaches the Item from the Source.

Detaining.def: The Authorities hold a Suspect under suspicion of having committed a crime (Charges).

roles.Authorities: The Authorities hold the Suspect in custody.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the length of time that the Suspect spends in confinement.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the detaining takes place.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which the Authorities detain a Suspect.
roles.Suspect: This FE identifies the person who is taken into custody and held, under suspicion of having committed a crime.
roles.Time: When the detaining occurs.

Detonate_explosive.def: An Agent causes an Explosive device to explode.

roles.Agent: The Agent detonates the Explosive.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation to its end.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Explosive: The Explosive causes damage to surrounding objects when operated by the Agent.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Instrument: An implement used by the Agent to detonate the Explosive.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent detonates the Explosive.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Agent detonates the Explosive.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent detonates the Explosive.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent detonates the Explosive.

Differentiation.def: Words in this frame have to do with a Cognizer being aware (or not being aware) of the difference between two Phenomena, which may be expressed jointly or disjointly.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances describe the situation in which the Cognizer evaluates the Phenomena.
roles.Cognizer: The cognizer is the person (or other sentient being) who potentially determines that two Phenomena are distinct from each other.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Cognizer that allows them to differentiate the Phenomena.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomena: Both phenomena that are potentially judged to be different from one another can be expressed jointly by the same constituent: 'The teacher couldn't distinguish
roles.Phenomenon_1: The phenomena that are potentially judged to be different from one another can be expressed as separate constituents.
roles.Phenomenon_2: See Phenomenon_1, above. The phenomenon expressed less prominently as a PP complement is called Phenomenon_2: 'The teacher couldn't distinguish Pat from Kim. '
roles.Quality: This is a property that is potentially used by the Cognizer to distinguish one phenomenon from another.

Difficulty.def: An Experiencer has an easy or difficult time carrying out an Activity.

roles.Activity: This Frame Element marks expressions indicating the Activity that the Experiencer finds difficult or easy.
roles.Circumstances: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions in which the Activity is being experienced and which influence the Experiencer's percepti
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate which person judges carrying out the Activity to be easy or difficult.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The time at which the Activity takes place.

words: like taking candy from a baby.adv

Dimension.def: This frame concerns words that express an Object's position on a scale, its Measurement, with respect to some attribute, its Dimension.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dimension: This FE identifies the Dimension which is measured.
roles.Measurement: Measurement identifies the extent of the Object along the specified Dimension.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Object: Object identifies the item which is measured along one of its Dimensions.

Direction.def: This frame covers the basic uses of direction words like the adverbs east, up, and forward.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: The one-dimensional set of locations.

Directional_locative_relation.def: A Figure is located relative to a (presumably more easily located) Ground, asserting that the Figure lies (approximately) on line from the Ground whose direction is established by semantic types of the particular LUs.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Figure: The Figure is perceived as located relative to a certain Ground location in a certain direction specified by the particular LU.
roles.Ground: The Ground serves as a basis for describing the location of the Figure.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The period of time during which the locative relation between Figure and Ground obtains.

Discussion.def: Two (or more) people (the Interlocutors, also encodable as Interlocutor_1 and Interlocutor_2) talk to one another.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration of the conversation. 'They had a short conference off by the stable.'
roles.Frequency: The number of times the discussion happens in a given period of time.
roles.Interlocutor_1: In cases where the Interlocutors involved in a conversation are construed as two separate groups with different levels of volitionality or control, this FE iden
roles.Interlocutor_2: In cases where the Interlocutors involved in a conversation are construed as two separate groups with different levels of volitionality or control, Interlocutor
roles.Interlocutors: In some sentences both participants are expressed by the Subject, and there is no 'with'-phrase (cf example 1).
roles.Manner: This frame element marks phrases that expresss the Manner in which one or both of the Interlocutors communicate.
roles.Means: This Frame Elememt marks constituents expressing the means the parties to the conversation use to talk to each other.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which a discussion takes place.
roles.Purpose: The goal that Interlocutor_1 or the Interlocutors jointly have, i.e.
roles.Time: The time at which the discussion takes place.
roles.Topic: Topic expresses the subject that the Interlocutors are trying to come to some agreement about.

Disembarking.def: A Traveller leaves from or dismounts a Vehicle.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goal: The location that the Traveller reaches by leaving the Vehicle.
roles.Manner: The Manner describes a property of the motion not related to its trajectory.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Traveller disembarks from the Vehicle.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Traveller disembarks from the vehicle.
roles.Time: When the disembarking of the Vehicle takes place.
roles.Traveller: The Traveller is the entity which disembarks from the Vehicle.
roles.Vehicle: The Vehicle is the means of conveyance that the Traveller disembarks from.

Disgraceful_situation.def: An implicit cognizer judges that a particular State_of_affairs for which a Protagonist is responsible is socially unacceptable.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the judgment of disgrace logically follows.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Protagonist: The person or organization responsible for the occurrence of the State_of_affairs.
roles.State_of_affairs: The entity or event which brings disgrace upon the Protagonist.

Dispersal.def: An Agent or a Cause disperses or scatters Individuals from the Source,a relatively confined space, to a the Goal_area, a broader space.

roles.Agent: The Agent disperses or scatters the Individuals.
roles.Cause: An event or force that causes that Individuals to disperse.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in dispersing the Individuals
roles.Individuals: The Individuals are scattered by the Agent.
roles.Manner: Any description of the dispersing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), second
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the dispersal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the dispersing event happens.
roles.Result: A state of the Individuals that results from the dispersal.
roles.Source: Source is the relatively confined space from which an Agent scatters the Individuals.
roles.Time: The Time when the Individuals are dispersed.

Distant_operated_IED.def: A improvised explosive device, the Bomb, is rigged to detonate when it receives a signal, typically by a wire that leads to a trigger.

roles.Bomb: The Bomb is set off by the Detonator at a distance, injuring or damaging a Target.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Distinctiveness.def: A Feature of an Entity serves to distinguish the Entity from other members of its type which have a different value for the Feature.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation to its end.
roles.Entity: The item which differs from other members of its class in the Feature's value.
roles.Feature: The aspect of the Entity which makes it different from the other members of its class.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Distributed_position.def: This frame involves a static (primarily spatial) relationship between a Location and a Theme, in which the Theme is located in many or all subregions of the Location, and is thus construable as covering it.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Location: Location is the entity or area with respect to which the Theme's spatial arrangement is described.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Theme: The Theme in this frame is the object which is described as standing in some spatial relation to a particular Location.
roles.Time: The time at which the Theme occupies the Location.

Diversity.def: A Group is described as having members which are similar or dissimilar to each other.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dimension: This FE marks constituents which express a property in respect to which the similarity of the Group is assessed.
roles.Explanation: An inanimate entity or process that causes the diversity or homogeneity.
roles.Group: This FE marks constituents that express the set of objects or types whose diversity is at issue.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which Dimension is similar or different
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the general area in which diversity occurs or exists.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Group is diverse or homogenous.

Documents.def: Words in the frame refer to any Document that has a legal status or conventional social significance.

roles.Bearer: The holder of the document. 'My visa will expire next month.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Document: Document is the piece of paper that has the legal status.
roles.Issuer: The authority that issues the document. 'US consulate issued a Visa to Ms. Yang to travel to San Francisco.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Obligation: Obligation is the obligation that is imposed on the Bearer of the Document.
roles.Right: Right is the right of the Bearer of the Document that is authorized by the Document.
roles.Status: Status is the state of the Bearer of the Document indicated by the Document.

Dodging.def: A Dodger acts to avoid an oncoming moving Bad_entity.

roles.Bad_entity: The Bad_entity is the oncoming entity to avoid.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dodger: The Dodger acts to avoid an oncoming Bad_entity.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which the dodging occurs.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the dodging occurs.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the dodging occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the dodging occurs.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the dodging occurs.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time at which the dodging occurs.

Domain.def: A Predicate is said to apply in a particular Domain.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Domain: This Frame Element applies to the Domain in which the Predicate is said to apply.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Predicate: This Frame Element denotes the Predicate which is applied to the Domain.

Dominate_competitor.def: An Agent, by virtue of strength or forcefulness, controls, rules, or strongly influences some Patient in some Situation.

roles.Agent: The Agent controls the Patient by being forceful and possibly aggressive.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period of time over which the domination occurs.
roles.Manner: A description of the event as a whole, or of any of the participants that does not fit any of the other more specific Frame Elements.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is trying to gain control of a situation, but ends up being subject to the control and influence of the Agent.
roles.Place: The place where the domination occurs. 'Women tend to dominatemen at home and at Church.'
roles.Time: The time when the domination takes place.

Dominate_situation.def: An Agent acts so as to be the strongest force, or most important causal factor in some Situation, to the exclusion of other competing actors.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the most forceful and pivotal factor in the situation.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period of time over which the domination occurs.
roles.Manner: A description of the event as a whole, or of any of the participants that does not fit any of the other more specific Frame Elements.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the domination takes place.
roles.Situation: The Situation is primarily affected by the Agent, in particular how it develops or concludes.
roles.Time: The Time when the Agent is dominant. 'As discussed above, Ford dominated the market in the 1920s, then left the business to create production capacity for the M

Dough_rising.def: The LUs of this frame describe a lump of Dough expanding as gas develops inside it.

roles.Circumstances: A setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the event takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dough: The paste made out of any cereals (grains) or leguminous crops by grinding, with some water added, which expands in volume as a result of leavening before bakin
roles.Explanation: The entity or state of affairs that leads to the event of the Dough's rising.
roles.Manner: Any description of the rising of the Dough which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The Time when the expansion of the Dough takes place.

Downing.def: An Agent disables a flying or floating Patient, causing it to be unable to support itself in its current medium.

roles.Agent: The Agent forces the Patient to come to the ground.
roles.Cause: An event which causes the Patient to come to the ground.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: An object used by the Agent to facilitate bringing down the Patient.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: An act performed by an Agent that enables them to force the Patient to the ground.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is the entity that is being forced to the ground.
roles.Place: The location at which the event takes place.
roles.Result: The Result of causing the Patient to come to the ground.
roles.Time: The time at which the event takes place.

Dressing.def: A Wearer puts on an item of Clothing, which then occupies the Body_location.

roles.Clothing: Clothing is used for the item of clothing that the Wearer ends up wearing.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of the Wearing that results from putting on the Clothing.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation indicates why the Wearer puts on the Clothing.
roles.Manner: Any expression which describes a property of the donning event which is not directly related to the trajectory of the Clothing's motion expresses the frame elem
roles.Means: The Means is an act whereby the Wearer puts on the Clothing
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place indicates where the Donning occurs.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Wearer intends to accomplish by putting on Clothing.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of the Placing.
roles.Time: The time when the Wearer puts an item of Clothing on.
roles.Wearer: The individual that puts Clothing on their body.

Drop_in_on.def: A Visitor arrives at the Host_location as a guest of the Host, for the purpose of achieving a Purpose.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Visitor remains with the Host.
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that explains why the Visitor is making a visit.
roles.Frequency: The frequency with whic hthe Visitor drops in on a Host.
roles.Host: The Host is the person highly associated with the goal location of the Visitor, and who allows the Visitor onto his/her territory, and possibly to make use of a
roles.Host_location: The Host_location is a place primarily associated with the Host.
roles.Manner: A Manner expression describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Visitor arrives.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The larger area within which the visiting takes place.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which the Visitor arrives at a location associated with the Host.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when arriving occurs.
roles.Visitor: The Visitor arrives at the Host_location to visit the Host for a Purpose.

Dunking.def: An Agent temporarily places a Theme into a Substance, often with the intention to remove it later.

roles.Agent: The Agent places the Theme into a Substance.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: The way that the Agent puts Theme in the Substance.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Substance: The Substance is the fluid into which the Theme is placed.
roles.Theme: The Theme temporarily goes partially or completely into the Substance.
roles.Time: The location in time when the dunking occurs.

Duplication.def: This frame involves a Creator making a duplicate, the Copy, of some Original entity.

roles.Co-participant: An entity that participates in much the same way as another participant (Creator, Copy, or Original), although it is characterized as being less focal to the ac
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Copy: The Copy produced by the Creator is frequently not expressed.
roles.Creator: The Creator produces the Copy based on the Original.
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Frequency: The Frequency is the frequency with which the Original is copied.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Creator that lets them bring about the duplication.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Original: The Original is the entity which is copied.
roles.Place: Where the event takes Place.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Result: Result of an event
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Duration_description.def: An event or state (here termed an Eventuality) or time-Period is described in terms of the Degree to which its duration diverges from a standard.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Eventuality: A situation, action or event whose duration is being described.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Period: Sometimes these adjectives describe simply a period of time, rather than an event or state.

Duration_relation.def: A Period or Eventuality is related to its Duration.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time that the Eventuality, Period, or Entity lasts.
roles.Entity: An item which is metonymically related to an Eventuality.
roles.Eventuality: A situation, action or event whose duration is being described.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Period: Sometimes a period of time, rather than an event or state is described.

Dying.def: A Protagonist is near or approaching death.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: How long the Protagonist is dying.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation why the dying event occurs.
roles.Frequency: How often the dying event occurs.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the dying event happens.
roles.Protagonist: The FE Protagonist is the being or entity that dies.
roles.Time: When the dying event occurs.

Dynamism.def: A physical Exerter, Action, or Force exerts energy at a level specified by the target.

roles.Action: The Action that exerts an energy of the level specified by the target.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the Exerter, Action, or Force exerts an energy.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Exerter: The Exerter which exerts an energy of the level specified by the target.
roles.Force: The Force that exerts an energy of the level specified by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Exerter, Action, or Force exerts its energy.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Exerter, Action, or Force exerts an energy.

Earnings_and_losses.def: An Earner receives Earnings by providing Goods to a Buyer; providing the Goods also generally entails a cost, which may or may not be included in the consideration.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Earner: The Earner is involved in a transaction or set of transactions as the party that receives payment.
roles.Earnings: Earnings are the money given to the Earner in a transaction, generally in exchange for Goods.
roles.Explanation: This FE denotes a proposition from which the event of earning or losing logically follows.
roles.Manner: Any description of the action of earning which reveals correllated details, especially characterizations of the Earner which influence the event.
roles.Means: The means by which the Earner gains money.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Earner makes their Earnings.
roles.Purpose: A state of affairs that the Earner intends to bring about as a result of participating in the Commercial Transaction.
roles.Time: The time when the Earner makes their Earnings.

Eclipse.def: An Obstruction blocks an Eclipsed entity partially or completely from view.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Eclipsed: The entity which is blocked from view. 'The mists obscured the top of the tower.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Obstruction: The entity which blocks the Eclipsed entity from view.

Economy.def: A Political_region, often a nation, has an economic system, theEconomy, defined by the level of production and consumption of goods and services.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Economy: The Economy is the state of the Political_region as defined by the production, consumption, etc.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Political_region: The Political_region is the nation, state, or other political body within which an economic system exists.

Education_teaching.def: This frame contains words referring to teaching and the participants in teaching.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Course: FN: a program of lectures or other matter dealing with a subject
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
roles.Fact: A piece of information that the Student is informed of by the Teacher.
roles.Institution: An educational establishment, such as a school or college.
roles.Material: Educational Material, such as books, tapes, or videos, used by a Teacher or a Student to acquire skills or knowledge.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the location within which the teaching takes place.
roles.Precept: A guideline for correct behavior. In most cases, this concerns morally or socially desirable actions. 'My brother taught me not to be mean to guys when I'm not
roles.Qualification: A formal Qualification such as an academic degree or a certificate for which a student is aiming.
roles.Role: A role, typically professional or vocational, that the Student is meant to be able to fill as a result of their training.
roles.Skill: An action which the Student is able to perform as a result of instruction.
roles.Student: One who is instructed by a Teacher in skills or knowledge.
roles.Subject: The area of knowledge or skill which is taught by a Teacher or to a Student.
roles.Teacher: One who instructs a Student in some area of knowledge or skill.
roles.Time: The time when the teaching occurs.

Electricity.def: Lexical units in this frame refer to Electricity, in particular as a form of energy harnessed for particular uses (such as powering machines).

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Electricity: Electricity is the physical force that is used as power.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Source: The Source of the Electricity. 'The electrical power from the plant will be fed into the public grid' 'And that is part of the reason Italy is now rethinking it

Elusive_goal.def: An Experiencer does not achieve a Desired_goal.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Desired_goal: Desired_goal identifies the goal that is not achieved or the entity that is not captured.
roles.Duration: The length of time during which the Experiencer does not acheive the Desired_goal.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer does not achieve a Desired_goal, or capture a pursued entity.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the goal is not achieved.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Experiencer fails to achieve a Desired_goal.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Experiencerr fails to achieve a Desired_goal .

Emanating.def: In this frame an Emission emanates from a Source along a Path or to a Goal.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which emanation occurs.
roles.Emission: The Emissions are discharged out of the Source .
roles.Goal: This FE is the point at which the Emission ends up as a result of the motion.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the emanating occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Result: This FE identifies the result of the emanating.
roles.Source: The Source is the location from which the Emission emanates.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the emanation occurs.

Emergency.def: This frame characterizes the situation or state of affairs in which someone should or must act to prevent a Undesirable_event from occurring.

roles.Circumstances: The conditions in which the Undesirable_event occurs; or, the circumstances that explain the impending threat to the Entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: How long the Emergency takes place.
roles.Experiencer: This FE identifies the experiencer within the emergency action chain, often relating the person or group who feels or is threatened by the emergency.
roles.Frequency: How often the Emergency occurs.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the emergency situation arises.
roles.Time: When the Emergency occurs.
roles.Undesirable_event: The potentially damaging event that should be prevented or ameliorated.

Emergency_fire.def: A fire which burns and requires an emergency-type response.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
