roles.Fire: The total material currently involved in combustion, including both the parts of the Fuel currently undergoing chemical alteration and the partially ionized gas
roles.Fuel: The entity that is undergoing rapid chemical alteration leading to damage or destruction.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Emergency_fire event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (loudly, urgently), and general descriptions
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Fire is burning.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Fire is burning.

Emitting.def: In this frame a Source_emitter discharges its Emission along a Path or to a Goal.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the Source_emitter emits the Emission.
roles.Emission: The Emissions are discharged out of the Source_emitter .
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Source_emitter emits the Emission
roles.Goal: This FE is the point at which the Emission ends up as a result of the motion.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Source_emitter emits the Emission
roles.Means: The Means by which the Source_emitter emits.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Source_emitter: The Source_emitter is the item from which the Emission are discharged.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Source_emitter emits the Emission.

Emotion_active.def: This frame has similarities to Experiencer_subject, but here the verbs are more 'active' in meaning.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: The FE Experiencer indicates the one who is actively expressing emotion over the Topic.
roles.Manner: The FE Manner indicates the manner in which the active emotion is expressed.
roles.Means: An action performed by the Experiencer which brings about the active emotion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Result: The FE Result indicates what happens due to the Experiencer actively expressing emotion.
roles.Topic: The Experiencer's emotion generally is about something.

Emotion_directed.def: The adjectives and nouns in this frame describe an Experiencer who is feeling or experiencing a particular emotional response to a Stimulus or about a Topic.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The Event is the occasion or happening that Experiencers in a certain emotional state participate in.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.
roles.Expressor: The Frame Element Expressor marks expressions that indicate a body part, gesture or other expression of the Experiencer that reflects his or her emotional state
roles.Manner: The Manner is the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State: The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
roles.Stimulus: The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the general area in which the emotion occurs.

Emotion_heat.def: This frame contains verbs that describe emotional experiences and participate in the locative alternation, as in the following examples: '' ' I was boiling with anger.' 'Anger was boiling inside me.' While these words might seem to be like

roles.Cause: The Cause of the Emotion can be expressed in a PP Complement headed by at: 'Jo burned with shame at the criticism.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Emotion: The Emotion experienced (usually restricted to words such as anger, fury, rage, passion) can occur as the External Argument or in a PP Complement.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the individual that experiences the Emotion.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Seat_of_emotion: The words in this frame can occur with an overtly expressed Seat of the Emotion.

Emotions_by_stimulus.def: An Experiencer, Expressor, Event, or State has an emotion as brought on by an Stimulus or Topic.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The Event is the occasion or happening that Experiencers in a certain emotional state participate in.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.
roles.Expressor: The body part, gesture, or other expression of the Experiencer that reflects his or her emotional state.
roles.Manner: Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, lo
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State: The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
roles.Stimulus: The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
roles.Time: The Time when the Experiencer, Expressor, Event, or State can be described as having said emotion.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the general area in which the emotion occurs.

Emotions_of_mental_activity.def: An Experiencer can be described as having an emotion as induced by a Stimulus.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.
roles.Manner: Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, lo
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Stimulus: The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
roles.Time: The Time when the Experiencer has an emotion as caused by the Stimulus.

Emotions_success_or_failure.def: A Topic or Stimulus fails or succeeds at causing an emotion in an Experiencer, which is conveyed by an Expressor or manifested in a State or description of an Event.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The Event is the occasion or happening that Experiencers in a certain emotional state participate in.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.
roles.Expressor: The body part, gesture, or other expression of the Experiencer that reflects his or her emotional state.
roles.Frequency: The number of times the Experiencer feels the emotion.
roles.Manner: Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, lo
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State: The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
roles.Stimulus: The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
roles.Time: The Time when the Experiencer, Expressor, Event, or State can be described as having said emotion.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the general area in which the emotion occurs.

Emphasizing.def: An Agent who is engaged in an Undertaking accords a Degree of importance to a Consideration that influences the success of an Undertaking.

roles.Action: The Action is performed with importance placed on the Consideration.
roles.Agent: The Agent is the individual who devotes time, concentration, or other resources to a Consideration that is important for the success of a larger Undertaking.
roles.Artifact: The Artifact is a physical object designed with some Consideration in mind, such that it functions to facilitate the Undertaking.
roles.Competing_consideration: The Competing_consideration is another factor that is relevant to the Undertaking to which the Agent devotes less attention or effort.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Consideration: An event or state of affairs, an attribute, or an entity whose properties have the potential to influence the success of the Agent's Undertaking.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which the Consideration is important to the Undertaking.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: Any further description of the Agent's placing of importance on the Consideration.
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent that allows the Agent to respond to the importance of the Factor to the Undertaking.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Agent attaches the specified level of importance to the Consideration.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by assigning the specified level of importance to the Consideration.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Agent attaches a specified degree of importance to the Consideration to further the success of the Undertaking.

Employing.def: An Employer employs an Employee whose Position entails that the Employee perform certain Tasks in exchange for Compensation.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The FE Duration identifies the amount of time for which the Employee continues in employ.
roles.Employee: The FE Employee denotes the person who is obligated to perform some Task in order to receive Compensation.
roles.Employer: The Employer is the person (or institution) that gives Compensation to an Employee.
roles.Field: The FE Field identifies the field in which the Employee is employed.
roles.Manner: The FE Manner identifies the way in which an Employer hires an Employee.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The FE Place identifies the location where the Employer hires the Employee.
roles.Position: The FE Position indicates a particular type of employment.
roles.Purpose: The FE Purpose identifies what the Employer intends to accomplish through the hiring of the Employee.
roles.Task: The Task indicates the action/duty that the Employee is obligated to do for the Employer.
roles.Time: The FE Time identifies the time at whcih the Employer hires the Employee.

Emptying.def: These are words relating to emptying containers and clearing areas of some substance or items.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the entity that does the emptying.
roles.Cause: The Cause is the non-sentient force which instigates the emptying.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Goal: The Goal is any expression which tells where the Theme ends up, or would end up, as a result of the motion.
roles.Instrument: This is the object with which the Agent empties the Source.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Agent empties the Source.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Agent empties the Source.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the emptying takes place.
roles.Purpose: The reason why the Agent empties the Source of the Theme.
roles.Result: The Result of the Agent emptying the Source.
roles.Source: The Source is the region or container which is emptied of something.
roles.Theme: The Theme, when overtly expressed, invariably occurs in a PP Complement headed by "of".
roles.Time: The time at which the emptying takes place.

Encoding.def: A person (Speaker) expresses a Message or mental content, broadly understood, in a particular Manner.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee is the person to whom the communication is directed.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: For most of the words in this frame, some expression of Manner or Medium is obligatory.
roles.Means: An act done by the Speaker whereby they achieve the phrasing of the Message.
roles.Medium: Medium expresses the Medium of communication, such as the language used or the specific type of text in which the Message occurs:'Kim formulated her objections
roles.Message: The Message is almost invariably expressed in an NP Object.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Speaker: Speaker, the person who encodes the Message, occurs as the External Argument of all the verbs: 'The teacher phrased the question carefully.'

Encounter.def: This frame describes Individuals who unintentionally come together to form a Group.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Group: The Group describes the resulting formation of the Individuals.
roles.Individuals: The Individuals are self-movers who unintentionally meet up.
roles.Manner: Any description of the unintentional meeting which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects and general descriptions comparing events In
roles.Means: The Means descibes the way in which the Individuals came together to form the Group.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Party_1: Party_1 is the grammatically more prominent participant in the encountering event.
roles.Party_2: A grammatically less prominent participant in the encountering event.
roles.Place: The Place where the encountering event happens.
roles.Time: The Time when the encountering event happens.

Endangering.def: An Agent or Cause is responsible for placing a Valued_entity at risk.

roles.Agent: The sentient entity which causes the risk to the Valued_entity.
roles.Cause: An (non-sentient) entity or state of affairs that leads to the peril to the Valued_entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: The Manner describes an aspect of the endangering act that is not directly related to the cause, intermediate action, or entity involved.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Valued_entity is put in danger.
roles.Time: The time when the Valued_entity is put in danger.
roles.Valued_entity: The entity which may be negatively impacted as a result of the emperilment.

Endeavor_failure.def: Some individual or group ceases to be able to sustain an Endeavor (a long-term activity involving economic interaction with the public, often a business venture).

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances that caused failure. Compared to Explanation, this describes situations or environments that lead to failure, not a specific reason for failur
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Endeavor: The Endeavor is rendered unable to continue its regular operations.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is named as one of the causes of failure.
roles.Manner: The Manner describes the way in which the Endeavor failed.
roles.Means: The means by which the Endeavor fails.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place of the failing Endeavor. 'The hot dog stand on 4th avenue flopped.'
roles.Time: The Time of the failure. 'Her campaign failed in 2008 but found much more support in 2012.'

Enforcing.def: An Agent acts to ensure that a Rule (often a constraint on behavior) is being followed.

roles.Agent: The Agent, often an institution, governmental organization, or arm thereof, puts into effect (i.e., enforces) a Rule.
roles.Circumstances: The state-of-affairs under which the Agent puts the Rule into effect.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time for which the Rule is or is not in effect.
roles.Explanation: A cause, reason, or other explanation for the enforcing of the Rule.
roles.Manner: The Manner describes some state of the Agent, or provides additional characterization of the event.
roles.Means: The Means is an intermediate action done by the Agent in order to enforce the Rule.
roles.Medium: This FE describes the medium through which the rule was enforced.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place at which the Rule is or is not enforced.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Agent enforces the Rule.
roles.Rule: The Rule is the set of constrants on behavior that the Agent implements (i.e., forces others to obey or face consequences).
roles.Time: The Time at which the Agent enforces the Rule.

Entering_of_plea.def: The Accused enters a Plea in answer to the Charges.

roles.Accused: The person entering the plea in court. 'Joy Peterson pleaded innocent to the murder of his son.'
roles.Charges: The crime with which the Accused is charged 'Simpson pleaded not guilty to the murder of his wife.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Court: The Court is the institution before which the plea is entered.
roles.Judge: The judge of the court in which the accused enters a plea.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Plea: The Plea that a defendant makes. 'The student pleaded guilty to stealing a bike.'
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Entity.def: This frame is for words that denote highly schematic entities.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: A thing (either abstract or physical) that exists with some degree of permanence.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Entourage.def: A group of Individuals form a group, the Entourage, which remains co-located with the Attended_person.

roles.Attended_person: The Attended_person is followed by the Entourage.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entourage: This FE identifies the collection of entities that follow the Attended.
roles.Individuals: This FE identifies the people or things that form the Entourage.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Erasing.def: An Agent or Cause removes a piece of Information from a Document such that it cannot be retrieved.

roles.Agent: The person who removes the Information.
roles.Cause: A non-agentive entity that removes the Information.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Document: The collection of pieces of information from which the specific Information is removed.
roles.Information: The thing that the Agent removes from the Document.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Agent or Cause removes the Information from the Document.
roles.Means: The means by which the Agent or Cause removes the Information from the Document.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Agent or Cause removes the Information from the Document.
roles.Time: The time when the Agent or Cause removes the Information from the Document.

Escaping.def: A Self-moving Escapee departs from an Undesirable_location.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Escapee: The Escapee manages to leave the Undesirable_location.
roles.Explanation: The situation that explains why the (instance of) the event occurred.
roles.Goal: Goal identifies any expression which tells where the Escapee ends up, or would end up, as a result of the motion.
roles.Manner: Manner is used for any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion, including descriptions of stea
roles.Means: covers any act performed by the Escapee brings about the escape.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Escaping occurs.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the escaping takes place.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the escaping occurs.
roles.Undesirable_location: The Undesirable_location is where the Escapee begins.

Estimated_value.def: A Cognizer has carried out an approximate calculation or considered some Evidence and produced an approximation of the Value of a feature of an Item.

roles.Cognizer: The individual who has considered evidence or performed calculations to produce the approximation.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Estimation: A proposition expressing the Cognizer's approximation of a feature's Value.
roles.Item: The entity that possesses a feature whose Value the Cognizer has approximated.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Cognizer has formed their estimate.
roles.Question: An open proposition for which the Cognizer has approximated the Value of a variable.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Cognizer formed the estimate.
roles.Value: The position or area on the feature scale that the Cognizer has concluded the Item occupies.

Estimating.def: A Cognizer carries out an approximate calculation or considers some Evidence so as to arrive at an approximate Value for some Feature of an Item.

roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the Circumstances under which the Cognizer estimates.
roles.Cognizer: The individual who considers evidence or performs calculations to arrive at an approximation.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Estimation: A proposition expressing the Cognizer's approximation of a Feature's Value.
roles.Explanation: A state-of-affairs enabling the estimating to occur.
roles.Feature: The feature is a scalar property of the Item.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Item: The entity that possesses the Feature whose Value the Cognizer seeks to approximate.
roles.Manner: Manner is used for any expression which describes a property of the activity of Estimating
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Cognizer enabling estimating.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Cognizer forms their estimate.
roles.Question: An open proposition for which the Cognizer seeks to approximate the Value of a variable.
roles.Result: This FE describes how the Estimation made by the Cognizer corresponds to reality.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Cognizer forms the estimate of the Feature's Value.
roles.Value: The position or area on the Feature scale that the Cognizer concludes the Item occupies.

Evading.def: An Evader moves under its own power to thereby avoid Capture or contact with a Pursuer, also generally moving under its own power.

roles.Capture: An actual or hypothetical event in which the Pursuer takes physical control of the Evader.
roles.Circumstances: This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the Evader evades the Pursuer, or avoids Capture.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evader: The Evader moves under its own power to Capture or contact with the Pursuer.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which the Evading is.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the evading occurs.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Evader bringd about the evasion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Evading is done.
roles.Pursuer: The Pursuer is going after the Evader unless they act.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time at which the Evading occurs.

Evaluative_comparison.def: This frame is about the static comparison of an Profiled_item to a Standard_item, often with respect to some Attribute.

roles.Attribute: This Frame Elements marks constituents that indicate in which respect Item-1 and Item-2 are equal to each other.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Profiled_item rivals the Standard_item.
roles.Profiled_attribute: The Profiled_attribute is a particular value on a scale which is being compared to a Standard_item or Profiled_attribute.
roles.Profiled_item: In active sentences, the Profiled_item is the grammatically more prominent one of the items that are compared and realized as the subject.
roles.Standard_attribute: The Standard_attribute is used when the standard is a specific value on a scale.
roles.Standard_item: In active setnnces, the Standard_item is the grammatically less prominent element, i.e.
roles.Time: The time at which the Profiled_item rivals the Standard_item.

Event.def: An Event takes place at a Place and Time.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: How long the Event takes place.
roles.Event: Name of the event which occurs.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which an event occurs.
roles.Frequency: How often the Event occurs. 'Stuff like this happens every day at 3:00pm.'
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Event_instance.def: This frame describes a particular instance of an event.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The event that occurred in one or more instances.
roles.Instance: The particular Instance of a given event.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Eventive_affecting.def: An Entity undergoes some change (the Event) that is (or is construed as) punctual.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: This FE identifies the entity, concrete or abstract.
roles.Event: This FE identifies the event which occurs and affects the Entity.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which an event occurs.
roles.Frequency: How often the Event happens to the Entity.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies where the event takes place.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the event occurs.

Eventive_cognizer_affecting.def: An Event causes the Cognizer to accept some Content.

roles.Cognizer: The person who perceives the Event and changes his or her mind.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: The new idea that the Cognizer accepts as a result of experiencing the Event.
roles.Event: The Event which motivates the Cognizer to change his/her mind.
roles.Manner: Any description which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Cognizer accepts the Content.
roles.Time: The time at which the Cognizer is affected by an outside Event.

Evidence.def: The Support, a phenomenon or fact, lends support to a claim or proposed course of action, the Proposition, where the Domain_of_relevance may also be expressed.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the manner in which a Proposition is supported.
roles.Means: An intermediate logical step that justifies the relationship of the Support to the Proposition.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Proposition: This is a belief, claim, or proposed course of action to which the Support lends validity.
roles.Result: Result of an event
roles.Support: Support is a fact that lends epistemic support to a claim, or that provides a reason for a course of action.

Evoking.def: Some Stimulus causes a Cognizer to think of a prior Phenomenon due to its perceived similarity.

roles.Cognizer: The Cognizer is the person who remembers the Phenomenon .
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration is the amount of time for which the Stimulus continues to remind the Cognizer of the Phenomenon.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Stimulus evokes the Phenomenon.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including speed (quickly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomenon: The Phenomenon is the mental content that a Cognizer remembers.
roles.Stimulus: The entity or situation that causes the Cognizer to think of the Phenomenon.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Cognizer remembers the Phenomenon.

Examination.def: This frame deals with testing or examination of someone's Knowledge or skill in a particular area.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Examination: The Examination that somebody takes.'The examination tests driving skills.'
roles.Examinee: One who undergoes a test of some kind.'The students took a test.'
roles.Examiner: One who administers a test of some kind.'The teacher tested the students.'
roles.Knowledge: The ability, practice, or command of information on which an Examinee is tested.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: An act whereby the Examiner assesses the Examinee.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the examination takes place.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Examiner wants to bring about by giving the Examinee the Examination.
roles.Qualification: A credential or status that one acquires by passing an Examination.'He took the college entrance exam.'
roles.Time: The time at which the examination occurs.

Exchange.def: Two parties, the Exchangers, each give and receive from the other Themes.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Exchanger_1: In cases where the Exchangers involved in a conversation are construed as two separate groups with different levels of volitionality or control, this FE identif
roles.Exchanger_2: In cases where the Exchangers involved in a conversation are construed as two separate groups with different levels of volitionality or control, Exchanger_2 ref
roles.Exchangers: In some sentences both participants are expressed by the Subject, and there is no 'with'-phrase (cf example 1).
roles.Frequency: This frame element denotes how often the Exchangers trade Themes.
roles.Manner: Any description of the exchange act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which Exchanger_1 or the Exchangers effect the trade.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the exchange occurs.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which Exchanger_1 or the Exchangers make the trade.
roles.Theme_1: The item that begins in the possession of Exchanger_1.
roles.Theme_2: The item that begins in the possession of Exchanger_2.
roles.Themes: The items which change possession between the Exchangers.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the exchange takes place.

Exchange_currency.def: A Money_owner exchanges Sum_1 in the Source_currency for Sum_2 in the Target_currency at some Exchange_service.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Any description of the exchange event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (h
roles.Means: The action of the Money_owner whereby the exchange is acheived.
roles.Money: Currency that is being exchanged by the Money_owner.
roles.Money_owner: The person who exchanges Sum_1 for Sum_2.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the money is exchanged.
roles.Purpose: The action that the Money_owner is attempting to accomplish with the exchange.
roles.Source_currency: The kind of currency of the Money_owner has before the exchange.
roles.Sum_1: An amount of money in the Source_currency that the Money_owner exchanges for an amount in the Target_currency.
roles.Sum_2: The amount of money in the Target_currency that the Money_owner receives in exchange for Sum_1.
roles.Target_currency: The kind of currency that the Money_owner receives as part of the exchange.
roles.Time: The time when the currency is exchanged. 'We walked around Eyre Square and exchanged money before walking into Taaffes pub and grabbing my first draught pint of

Exclude_member.def: A former Member of a Group ceases to be a member as a result of the action of an Authority within the Group.

roles.Authority: An empowered subset of the Group which decides to expel its former Member.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A cause, reason, or other explanation for the exclusion of the Member.
roles.Group: A set of people standing in a semi-permanent relationship together.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Authority excludes the Member.
roles.Member: The person who used to belong to a Group.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the Member is excluded.
roles.Time: The time when the Member is excluded.

Excreting.def: An Excreter excretes Excreta. 'Principal Skinner burped on me.' 'Lenny and Karl pee three times a day.'

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Excreta: The Excreta is the waste expelled by the body.
roles.Excreter: The Excreter is the agent who excretes the Excreta.
roles.Frequency: TheFrequency is the number of times per time period that the Excreter is engaged in exctretion.
roles.Goal: The Goal is where the Excreta finishes its motion.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Excreter engages in excretion.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Excreter engages in excretion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifieis the Place where the excretion occurs.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose is the motivation behind the Excreter's act.
roles.Source: The Source is the starting point of the Excreta's motion.
roles.Time: When the Excreter engages in excretion.

Execute_plan.def: An Agent acts according to a Plan, carrying it out (or taking steps to carry it out).

roles.Agent: The Agent, often an institution or governmental organization, puts a Plan into effect.
roles.Circumstances: The state-of-affairs under which the Agent puts the Plan into effect.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time for which the Plan is or is not in effect.
roles.Explanation: A cause, reason, or other explanation for the implementation of the Plan
roles.Manner: The Manner describes some state of the Agent, or provides additional characterization of the event of executing the plan.
roles.Means: The Means is an intermediate action done by the Agent in order to execute the Plan.
roles.Medium: This FE describes the medium through which a plan was executed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place at which the Plan is or is not operational.
roles.Plan: The Plan is a goal or purpose that the Agent carries out.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Agent executes the Plan.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Agent puts the Plan into effect.

Execution.def: An Executioner punishes an individual (Executed) with death as a consequence of some action of the Evaluee (the Reason).

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Executed: The Executed is the person who is killed by the Executioner in retribution for the crime that the Executed was convicted of.
roles.Executioner: The Executioner is the individual who performs the execution.
roles.Explanation: Often, there is a constituent expressing the Explanation for the Judge's judgment which the Executioner is carrying out.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument with which an Executioner performs an execution.
roles.Manner: Any description of the execution event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: The action that is taken that accomplishes the execution 'Execution by lethal injection is certainly humane.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the execution takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the execution is carried out.
roles.Result: Result of an event
roles.Time: When the execution occurs.

Exemplar.def: This frame concerns a specific subset of Instances of a Type which are evaluated in terms of their similarity to a conceptual prototype of the Type.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instance: A thing or episode that is considered exemplary of a certain Type.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Type: The category of things or events from which an Instance is picked out.

Exemplariness.def: An Entity, with regard to a particular Domain, is representative of a conceptual prototype of the Comparison_set of which it is a member.

roles.Comparison_set: The group which the Entity is a member of.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The thing being judged by its similarity to an ideal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Exercising.def: An Agent actively maintains or improves their level of phyiscal fitness.

roles.Agent: The person who is trying to improve or maintain their physical fitness.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: How often the Agent works on their fitness.
roles.Manner: A general description of how the Agent acts while exercising.
roles.Means: Something that the Agent uses to exercise.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location of the Agent while exercising.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Agent exercises.
roles.Time: The time that the Agent exercises. 'I like to exercise at 3 am.'

Existence.def: An Entity is declared to exist, generally irrespective of its position or even the possibility of its position being specified.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions under which the Entity is declared to exist
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period during which the Entity exists.
roles.Entity: Some entity, abstract or concrete, which is stated to exist.
roles.Explanation: A situation, force, or entity which brings about the existence of the Entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the Entity exists.
roles.Time: A time at which the entity is in existence.

Expansion.def: An Item changes its physical size. The Size_change of an Item may be explicitly indicated or characterized in terms of Initial_size and/or Result_size. In the default case, expansion is along all dimensions, but sometimes the Dimension of e

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time that the expansion takes.
roles.Goal: Where the Iteam ends up due to Expansion.
roles.Item: This FE identifies the Item whose size changes.
roles.Manner: This FE is used for any description of the Manner of the expansion including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the expansion occurs.

Expectation.def: Words in this frame have to do with a Cognizer believing that some Phenomenon will take place in the future.

roles.Cognizer: This is the person who believes some Phenomenon will take place in the future.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomenon: This is what the Cognizer believes will happen in the future.
roles.Place: The location where the Cognizer foresees the Phenomenon.
roles.Time: The time when the Cognizer makes the prediction.
roles.Topic: An entity that serves as the focus of a predicted Phenomenon.

Expected_location_of_person.def: A Person usually resides or works in a Location.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of the time interval during which the Person occupies the Location.
roles.Location: The Location is the place of business or residence prototypically occupied by the Person.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Person: The Person is located in or at a place that they customarily occupy.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Person occupies the Location.

Expend_resource.def: An Agent uses a Resource which is consumed and unavailable for future use.

roles.Agent: The Agent uses the Resource.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: The degree to which the Resource is depleted by the Agent.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent exhausts the Resource.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Agent exhausts the Resource.
roles.Purpose: The Agent uses the Resource for a Purpose.
roles.Resource: The Resource is exhausted over time by being used.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent exhausts the Resource.

Expensiveness.def: A Payer gives up (or potentially gives up) the use of an Asset (generally money) in order to achieve an Intended_event.

roles.Asset: The price of or payment made for the Goods.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goods: The FE Goods is the item(s) whose price is being assessed.
roles.Intended_event: The event that the Payer brings about by deploying the Asset.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Payer: The person whose Asset is given up in order to achieve an Intended_event.
roles.Time: The time when a transaction takes place. 'No, they've got a special on; it's really cheap there on Tuesdays'

Experience_bodily_harm.def: An Experiencer is involved in a bodily injury to a Body_part.

roles.Body_part: The location on the body of the Experiencer where the bodily injury takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period of time during which the Experiencer repeatedly receives bodily injuries.
roles.Experiencer: The being or entity that is injured. 'The squirrel abraded its tail as it twitched nervously in the confined space.' 'Then I cut myself on an envelope.'
roles.Frequency: The number of times that the Experiencer has an experience of bodily harm.
roles.Manner: Manner in which the injury takes place.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the harming event occurs.
roles.Time: The time when the harming event occurs. 'So you cut your leg on the window frame at six o'clock, correct?'

Experiencer_focus.def: The words in this frame describe an Experiencer's emotions with respect to some Content.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances FE encodes the circumstances or conditions under which the Experiencer experiences the emotion.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: Content is what the Experiencer's feelings or experiences are directed towards or based upon.
roles.Event: The Event is the occasion or happening that Experiencers in a certain emotional state participate in.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer experiences the emotion or other internal state.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the explanation for why an Experiencer experiences the particular emotion.
roles.Expressor: The Frame Element Expressor marks expressions that indicate a body part, gesture or other expression of the Experiencer that reflect his or her emotional state.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State: The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
roles.Time: The time at which the Experiencer is in the specified emotional state.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the area about which the Experiencer has the particular experience.

Experiencer_obj.def: Some phenomenon (the Stimulus) provokes a particular emotion in an Experiencer.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances is the circumstances under which the Stimulus brings about the experience.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer reacts emotionally or psychologically to the Stimulus.
roles.Explanation: The reason why the Stimulus causes the emotion in the Experiencer.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Stimulus affects the Experiencer.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Stimulus affects the Experiencer.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Result: The Result of the Stimulus affecting the Experiencer.
roles.Stimulus: The Stimulus is the event or entity which brings about the emotional or psychological state of the Experiencer.
roles.Time: The Time when the Experiencer has an emotion as caused by the Stimulus.

Experimentation.def: An Experimenter conducts an Experiment based on a Hypothesis.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Control_group: The group of entities in the Experiment which have not been treated and are compared to the Treatment_group or Treated_individual.
roles.Control_group_member: An individual entity of the Experiment which is left untreated and then compared with the Treatment_group or the Treated_individual.
roles.Duration: The amount of time the Experiment lasts. 'The six week long study was published in a prominent scientific journal.'
roles.Experiment: The test or Experiment conducted by the Experimenter using a Control_group and a Treatment_group.
roles.Experimenter: The Experimenter is the individual conducting the Experiment.
roles.Hypothesis: The Hypothesis is a conjecture as to the result of an Experiment.
roles.Instrument: A tool used in conducting the Experiment.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place in which the Experiment is conducted.
roles.Result: The Result depicts the outcome of the Experiment.
roles.Subjects: In this frame Control_group and Treatment_group can be combined and expressed as Subjects.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Experimenter conducts the Experiment.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the subject that the Experiment is studying.
roles.Treated_individual: An individual subject that receives treatment and is then compared to the Control_group or Controlled_individual.
roles.Treatment_group: A group of subjects that receive Treatment and are compared to the Control_group or Controlled_individuals.

Expertise.def: This frame concerns people's knowledge or skill in certain domains.

roles.Behavior_product: A product of behavior that shows the Protagonist's skill or lack of skill.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Focal_participant: This frame element can only occur in place of a skill expression.
roles.Knowledge: The area of knowledge (as opposed to a practical skill) in which the Protagonist 's experience is assessed.
roles.Manner: The Manner give further description of the way in which the Protagonist exhibits their skill or lack of skill.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Protagonist: The person whose expertise is assessed.
roles.Role: This frame element denotes a role in which the protagonist has developed his expertise.
roles.Skill: Skill identifies the Protagonist's talent or ability to do things with one's hand or body.
roles.Time: The Time when the Protagonist has the expertise.

Explaining_the_facts.def: A Question about the reason or cause of a known State_of_affairs is presented as being answered by the existence of a particular Fact.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Fact: A Fact which can be connected by a chain of reasoning to the State_of_affairs.
roles.Manner: This FE indicates salient characteristics of the Fact considered as an explanation.
roles.Means: An intermediate logical step that justifies the relationship between the Fact and the State_of_affairs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Question: An open proposition concerning the cause of the State_of_affairs.
roles.State_of_affairs: A Fact whose cause is under consideration.

Explosion.def: Due to chemical, nuclear, or other reactions, an Explosive explodes, potentially causing damage to the surrounding area.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explosive: The Explosive releases a large amount of force, destroying itself and causing damage to the surrounding area.
roles.Frequency: How often an explosion occurs. 'The daily explosions are enough to drive anyone mad.'
roles.Manner: A description of the explosion not specifically covered by other Frame Elements.
roles.Means: The means by which the Explosive explodes.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the explosion occurs.
roles.Time: The Time when the explosion occurs.

Exporting.def: An Exporter moves Goods across a border from an Exporting_area to an Importing_area.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that explains why the Exporter moves the Goods across the border.
roles.Exporter: The conscious entity, generally a person, that moves the Goods across a border out of the Exporting_area.
roles.Exporting_area: The place where the Goods are initially, before the the Exporter moves them.
roles.Goods: The items of value whose location is changing.
roles.Importing_area: The FE Importing_area is the place that the Goods end up as a result of motion.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Exporter that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the state-of-affairs that the Exporter is attempting to bring about by exporting.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Exporter moves the Goods.

Expressing_publicly.def: A Communicator publically communicates some difficult-to-express Content which they (or a social group of which they are a member) have had for some time.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee is the person to whom the Content is communicated.
roles.Circumstances: The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the communication and any of its participants.
roles.Communicator: The Communicator is the person who expresses the Content (whether spoken or written).
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: The attitude or feeling that the Communicator had not previously expressed.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the particular public expression logically follows.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and gene
roles.Means: An act whereby the Communicator communicates the Content.
roles.Medium: Medium is the observable action or product of the Communicator.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The FE specifies the place where the communication takes place.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose is the desired result of public expression.
roles.Time: The time when the Content is communicated.

Extradition.def: A Suspect in a Current_jurisdiction is forced by Authorities (of the Current_jurisdiction) to go to the Crime_jurisdiction, i.e.

roles.Authorities: The Authorities act on behalf of the Current_jurisdiction, giving up the Suspect to the Crime_jurisdiction.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Crime_jurisdiction: The jurisdiction (generally a nation) to which the Suspect is sent.
roles.Current_jurisdiction: The jurisdiction (generally a nation) the Suspect starts off in.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Authorities extradite the Suspect.
roles.Manner: A description of the manner of the extradition.
roles.Means: The act of the Authorities which brings about the transfer from the Current_jurisdiction to the Crime_jurisdiction.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the extradition occurs.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Authorities extradite the Suspect.
roles.Suspect: The Suspect is forced to go to the jurisdiction where a crime he or she is suspected of took place or is being tried.
roles.Time: The time at which the Suspect is moved.

Extreme_point.def: An Entity that has characteristics which change over time is at a point or in a phase of its development in which, compared to other actual or expected stages of development, it possesses extremely high or low powers or intensity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: An concrete or abstract entity that possesses characteristics that change over time.
roles.Marker: A point or phase in time when, viewed across the actual or expected development, the Entity's powers have reached an extreme high or low point.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Extreme_value.def: An Entity possesses a Value for a certain Attribute which is extreme when compared to the values either of other entities or to values of the same Entity at other points of time.

roles.Attribute: The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity whose Value of a particular gradable Attribute is extreme.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Extreme_value event occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Value: A quantity or other characterization of the Entity's state with respect to the Attribute.

Facial_expression.def: The words in this frame refer to facial Expressions and the Possessors of those Expressions.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Conveyed_emotion: The emotion that is conveyed by a particular Expression.
roles.Duration: The period of time for which the facial Expression is held.
roles.Expression: This is the Expression made.'He gave a wide grin.'
roles.Manner: Manner of Expression.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Possessor: This is the person who exhibitis the Expression.'Ryan grinned.'

Fairness_evaluation.def: In this frame an Action is evaluated with respect to how fairly, justly or equitably the Action affects the Affected_party.

roles.Action: The Action is judged based on how just and appopriate it is to the Affected_party in a particular situation.
roles.Actor: The Actor is the individual who performs the Action and can thus be characterized with repsect to how that Action affects the Affected_party.
roles.Affected_party: The Affected_party's treatment is what determines the evaluation of the Actor's Action.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Grounds: The Grounds is the event or state that requires some decision or action in response to it for which the Actor is judged.
roles.Manner: A holistic characterization of the description of the Actor, including depictions of the Actor's state in terms of how it affects the entire description.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Fall_asleep.def: A Sleeper goes from wakefulness to an altered state of consciousness where they are largely unaware of their environment.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.
roles.Sleeper: The Sleeper is the entity that falls asleep.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time where the event occurs.

Fall_for.def: A Victim comes to have incorrect beliefs as a result of exposure to a Deception.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Deception: The Deception is perceived by the Victim, leading to false beliefs.
roles.Manner: A description of the way Victim is deceived which is not covered by more specific FEs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the Victim falls for the Deception.
roles.Time: The Time when the Victim falls for the Deception.
roles.Victim: The Victim has false beliefs as a result of exposure to a Deception.

Fame.def: An Entity is well-known among a wide range of people (in general or in a particular domain) for a particular Reason, which may be a behavior, characteristic, or some other associated item.

roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity is considered famous.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time during which the Entity is famous.
roles.Entity: The Entity which is widely known and recognized.
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that provides an explanation (via reasoning, causation, etc.) for the level of fame of the Entity.
roles.Means: The way in which the Entity becomes famous.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Entity is famous. 'Certain people are well known only in North America.'
roles.Reason: The behavior, attribute, or associated entities that provide the reason for the Entity being famous.
roles.Role: The Role underwhich the Entity become famous.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Entity is famous.

Familiarity.def: An Entity is presented as having been seen or experienced by a (typically generic and backgrounded) Cognizer on a certain number of occasions, causing the Entity to have a certain degree of recognizability for the Cognizer.

roles.Cognizer: The (typically non-specific and backgrounded) sentient being for whom the Entity possesses a specified level of recognizability.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: The deviation of the actual level of recognizability of the Entity from the level specified by the target.
roles.Entity: A concrete thing or abstract phenomenon or fact that is assessed in terms of how well recognizable it is to a Cognizer.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Role: This FE identifies the role filled by a particular participant of the clause headed by the target.

Fastener.def: The Fastener is an artifact created to close a Container (e.g.

roles.Fastener: The artifact created to close a Container.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Fear.def: An Experiencer, Expressor, or State can be described as characterized as having an emotion of fear concerning a particular Topic or as evoked by a Stimulus.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.
roles.Expressor: The body part, gesture, or other expression of the Experiencer that reflects his or her emotional state.
roles.Manner: Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, lo
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State: The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
roles.Stimulus: The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
roles.Time: The Time when the Experiencer, Expressor, or State can be described as having said emotion.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the general area in which the emotion occurs.

Feeling.def: In this frame an Experiencer experiences an Emotion or is in an Emotional_state.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Emotion: The Emotion is the feeling that the Experiencer experiences.
roles.Emotional_state: The Emotional_state is the state the Experiencer is in.
roles.Evaluation: The Evaluation is a negative or positive assessment of the Experiencer regarding his or her Emotional_state.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer experiences the Emotion or is in the Emotional_state.
roles.Explanation: The thing or state-of-affairs that leads to the Experiencer feeling the Emotion or Emotional_state.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Feigning.def: An Agent acts in such a way as to give the incorrect impression to observers that a particular State_of_affairs holds.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person who acts in a misleading way to create the impression that a State_of_affairs holds.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Copy: The Copy produced by the Creator most commonly occurs as the External Argument of a predicative use of an adjective or noun target: The painting is a fake.

roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the feigning event logically follows.

roles.Time: The Time when the Agent feigns something.

Fields.def: An individual or group (Practitioner) or a part of their work life (Work) is defined professionally by the Activity that they typically engage in.

roles.Activity: An activity that defines a group of people in their professional capacity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Practitioner engages in the Activity.
roles.Practitioner: The individual, group, or organization that engages in the Activity as part of their profession.
roles.Salient_entity: A physical or abstract entity that is characteristically associated with the Activity.
roles.Time: The Time when the Practitioner engages in the Activity.
roles.Work: A phase of a Practitioner's career that is spent engaged in an Activity.

Fighting_activity.def: A generally large group of people, the Combatants, are engaged in a chaotic, violent, and usually protracted Fight amongst themselves.

roles.Combatants: The Combatants participate as fighters in the Fight.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the Fight takes place.
roles.Fight: The violent activity. 'I couldn't help but watch as several bruised people reentered the melee.'
roles.Instrument: The weapon or other instrument used by the Combatants.
roles.Manner: The manner of the Fight. 'Officers said they were stunned upon arrival at the scene of the raucous fray.'
roles.Means: The means by which the Combatants engage in the Fight.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the Fight takes place.
roles.Purpose: The state of affairs that (some of) he Combatants wish to acheive by fighting.
roles.Time: When the Fight takes place.

Filling.def: These are words relating to filling containers and covering areas with some thing, things or substance, the Theme.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the actor who instigates the filling.
roles.Cause: An event which brings about the filling of the Goal.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Agent fills or covers the Goal.
roles.Goal: The Goal is the area or container being filled.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which the filling occurs.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the filling occurs.
roles.Means: The Means by which the filling occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the filling takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Agent fills the Goal.
roles.Result: The Result is the resultant state after the filling has occurred.
roles.Source: The Source is the location where the Theme begins its motion.
roles.Theme: The Theme is the physical object or substance which changes location.
roles.Time: When the filling occurs.

Fining.def: The Payer is (legally) forced to pay a Fine by an official Speaker as a punishment for some action (the Reason).

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Fine: The money given to expiate some debt for transgression.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which the fining is performed.
roles.Manner: A description of the event (or state) not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events
roles.Means: The action that is taken that results in punishement/reward.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Payer: The Payer is the person or thing about whom/which a judgment is made.
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Reason: Typically, there is a constituent expressing the Reason for the Judge's judgment.
roles.Result: The Result of an event.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker is the person who imposes the Fine upon the Payer.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Finish_competition.def: A Competition comes to an end, with a Competitor tying, winning, or losing against an Opponent (or opponents) according to their Score.

roles.Competition: The event in which the Competitors compete with each other.
roles.Competitor: The individual involved in the Competition.
roles.Competitors: The individuals who compete against each other.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Any description of the Competition which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary e
roles.Means: An action of the Competitor that results in the outcome of the Competition.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Opponent: The individual that the Competitor has been competing against.
roles.Place: The location at which the Competition takes place.
roles.Time: The time at which the Competition takes place.

Finish_game.def: A Player finishes a Game, possibly with an outcome of winning or losing.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Game: An activity the Player participates in.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Game which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects
roles.Means: An action of the Player that results in the outcome of the Game.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Player finishes the Game.
roles.Player: The individual participating in a Game.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Player wins or loses the Game.
roles.Time: The time at which the Game takes place.

Fire_break.def: This frame pertains to Fire_breaks, entities intended to prevent a fire from traveling in a direction.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Fire_break: The constructed entity that is intended to prevent a fire from reaching a protected area.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Fire_burning.def: A Fire burns Fuel, resulting in damage and possibly complete destruction of the Fuel.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time that the Fire burns.
roles.Fire: The total material currently involved in combustion, including both the parts of the Fuel currently undergoing chemical alteration and the partially ionized gas
roles.Fuel: The entity that is undergoing rapid chemical alteration leading to damage or destruction.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Fire event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing e

roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Fire is burning.

Fire_going_out.def: A Fire goes out. 'The fire is expected to burn out within a week.'

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Fire: The combustion process that comes to an end.

roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Fire goes out.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of the event.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Fire goes out.

Firefighting.def: This frame characterizes the situation or state of affairs in which someone acts to prevent a Fire_disaster from occurring, accelerating, or affecting any area not identified as a Controlled_area.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Firefighter: The individual or group who respond(s) to the Fire.
roles.Instrument: An instrument with which an intentional fire-fighting act is performed.
roles.Manner: The manner in which the Firefighters are fighting the Fire.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

roles.Purpose: The desired result of the firefight. It may either directly refer to the state of affairs that is desired, e.g. 'The firefighters tackled the blaze early to pre

Firing.def: An Employer ends an employment relationship with an Employee.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Employee: The person who is let go by their Employer.
roles.Employer: The person (or institution) that end an employment relationship with an Employee.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Employee is terminated.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Employer fires an Employee.

roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Employer fires the Employee.
