roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when an Employer fires the Employee.

Firing_point.def: A location from which a Detonator activates a distantly-located explosive device.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Firing_point: The location from which the Detonator activates an explosive device.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

First_experience.def: An implicit experiencer has an Experience for the first time.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experience: An event happens for the first time within the Context.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

First_rank.def: An Item is located at the top end of a scale of importance or social rank (or some other Attribute) in comparison to other members of a Contrast_set (usually, implicit) that is otherwise similar in kind to the Item.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Contrast_set: The Contrast_set is a group of entities similar to the Item out of which the Item is the most preeminent.
roles.Item: An Item is the foremost thing in the Contrast_set.
roles.Limits_of_consideration: This FE identifies the domain (usually temporally or spatially defined) within which the Item is primary among its kind.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Fleeing.def: A Self_mover responds to a (real or imagined) danger by moving away from it.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Direction: The direction that the Self_mover heads in during the motion.
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the Self_mover moves.
roles.Explanation: The state of affairs that leads to the particular motion that the Self_mover adopts.
roles.Goal: Goal is used for any expression which tells where the Self_mover ends up as a result of the motion.
roles.Manner: An expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory or rate of motion.
roles.Means: An act whereby the Self_mover achieves movement.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: Path is used for any description of a trajectory of motion involving a landmark which is neither a Source nor a Goal.
roles.Place: The Place is the location within which a defined motion takes place.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which a Self_mover moves.
roles.Result: The state of the world which exists because of the motion of the Self_mover
roles.Self_mover: Self_mover is the living (or self-directed) being which moves under its own power.
roles.Source: Source is used for any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion.
roles.Time: The time when the motion occurs.

Fluidic_motion.def: In this frame a Fluid moves from a Source to a Goal along a Path or within an Area.

roles.Area: Area is the setting in which the Fluid's movement takes place on an unspecified Path.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the Fluid moves.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the reason for the fluidic motion.
roles.Fluid: The Fluid is the entity that changes location and moves in a fluidic way.
roles.Goal: Goal is the location the Fluid ends up.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Fluid flows.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: The Path is the trajectory along which the Fluid moves.
roles.Place: The Place describes the location of the motion which has a specified Source, Path or Goal.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the result of the Fluid moving.
roles.Source: The Source is the location the Fluid occupies initially.
roles.Time: The Time when the Fluid flows.

Food.def: This frame contains words referring to items of food.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Food_gathering.def: A Gatherer removes Crop ripe and ready to an accepted degree.

roles.Beneficiary: The person on who's behalf the Gatherer gathers the Crop.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Crop: Crop is item being collected together by the Gatherer.
roles.Duration: For what length of time the Gatherer was gathering the Crop.
roles.Frequency: How often the Gatherer collects his Crop.
roles.Gatherer: The Gatherer is the agent gathering the Crop.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Gatherer gathers the Crop.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Crop is gathered.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The greater geographic location where the Gatherer gathers his Crop.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Gatherer intends to accomplish by gathering his Crop.
roles.Source: The Source is the ground where the Crop is gathered from.
roles.Time: When the Crop gathering action occurs.

Foreign_or_domestic_country.def: A Current_country is identified as matching or not matching the instance of the Discourse_salient_country.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Current_country: The country or countries that the speaker is indicating in the current instance, which may match or be distinct from the Discourse_salient_country.
roles.Discourse_salient_country: The country that has been featured in the discourse, or that the speaker/hearer identify with or are located in; it serves to identify the Current_country by sp
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Forging.def: An Agent produces a Forgery, an entity that they intend to pass off as a particular (instance of) a Standard.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person that creates a Forgery with the intent of passing it off as (an instance of) the Standard.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the forging event logically follows.
roles.Forgery: The Forgery is the product that the Agent creates with the intent of passing it off as (an instance of) the Standard.
roles.Instrument: An entity manipulated by the Agent in order to produce the Forgery.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: An act performed by the Agent that accomplishes the imitation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Agent makes a Forgery.
roles.Purpose: An action or state that the Agent intends to accomplish by producing the Forgery.
roles.Source: An entity corresponding to the Standard which the Agent scrutinizes in order to copy.
roles.Standard: The Standard is the actually existing or imagined (kind of) thing that the Agent wants to pass the Forgery off as.
roles.Time: The time at which the forgery takes place.

Forgiveness.def: A Judge refrains from imposing, or demanding a punishment for an Evaluee who has committed an Offense.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: The Evaluee is subject to the judgment of the Judge for having committed the Offense.
roles.Judge: The Judge holds the Evaluee responsible for the Offense.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Offense: The Offense is the illicit or unpleasant act committed by the Evaluee.

Forgoing.def: AForgoer decides not to partake in something ordinary that is otherwise Desirable.

roles.Circumstances: This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the Forgoer does not partake in the Desirable.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Desirable: Desirable identifies the event or activity in which is the Forgoer does not partake.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which the forgoing occurs.
roles.Forgoer: The Forgoer decides not to partake in the desirable activity or event.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner the forgoing occurs.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the forgoing occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the forgoing occurs.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the forgoing occurs.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time at which the the forgoing occurs.

Forming_relationships.def: Partner_1 interacts with Partner_2 (also collectively expressible as Partners) to change their social relationship.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: How often the Forming_relationship event occurs.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
roles.Means: The action that Partner_1 or the Partners take in order to bring about the change in the relationship.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Partner_1: The individual who comes to form a relationship with Partner_2.
roles.Partner_2: The individual whose relationship with Partner_1 changes.
roles.Partners: The individuals whose relationship is changing.
roles.Place: Where the relationship is formed. 'We married in a gazebo.'
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Partners or Partner_1 hope to bring about by changing their status.
roles.Time: The time when the relationship changes. 'She married Stephen last summer.'

Freeing_from_confinement.def: An Agent causes a Theme which was held captive to be free from a Location_of_confinement, against the wishes of the captors.

roles.Agent: The Agent causes the confinement or captivity of the Theme to end, against the intentions of the captor.
roles.Circumstances: The state of the world when the event of setting free occurs.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation identifies the reason for which the Agent sets the Theme free.
roles.Location_of_confinement: The location to which the Theme's motion was formerly inhibited.
roles.Manner: Any description of the release which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing even
roles.Means: The action of the Agent which brings about the release.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Theme ceases to be confined.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose identifies the purpose for which the Agent releases the Theme.
roles.Theme: The Theme is the person or object which is released by the Agent.
roles.Time: The Time identifies when the Agent frees the Theme .

Frequency.def: This frame has to do with the repetition (and especially the frequency of repetition) of an event.

roles.Attribute: The frequency feature of the Event or Salient_entity that is under discussion.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: The extent to which the actually observed rate of occurrence of the Event or Salient_entity differs from the expected rate.
roles.Event: This FE is used for any (bounded) Event whose frequency or iteration is described.
roles.Interval: The Interval is a noun modified by the target word.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Rate: The number of times per unit of real or scanning time that an Event or Salient_entity is encountered.
roles.Salient_entity: An entity which the implicit cognizer encounters with the specified frequency.
roles.Time: The Time when the Event has a particular frequency.
roles.Time_span: The Time_span is the length of time of the Interval.

Friction.def: A Theme moves on or against the surface of a Static_object.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: The way in which the Theme moves against the Static_object 'is steel helmet grated gently against the top of the door'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The setting in which the motion of the Theme happens 'In the hallway a key grated in the lock'
roles.Static_object: A non-moving physical object over a surface of which the Theme moves.
roles.Theme: The physical entity which moves over the suface of the Static_object 'His backpack grated against the wall'.
roles.Themes: Two moving entities whose surfaces move against each other.

Friendly_or_hostile.def: Two parties or individuals are on the same side or on different sides of a (typically military) conflict.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is a proposition denoting a state of affairs from which the Sides having the relationship indicated logically follows.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the two Sides have an adversarial relationship.
roles.Side_1: Side_1 is the party or individual in a relationship with Side_2.
roles.Side_2: The party or individual with whom Side_1 bears an adversarial or friendly relationship.
roles.Sides: A joint expression of the two Sides with a friendly or hostile stance towards one another.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Sides have the indicated relationship with each other.

Front_for.def: An individual or organization, the Front, serves as a cover for an Illicit_activity or an Illicit_organization.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Front: The Front acts as a legitimate individual, organization, or enterprise, but is truly a cover for an illicit organization or activity.
roles.Illicit_activity: The Illicit_activity of the Illicit_organization is concealed by (the activities of) the Front .
roles.Illicit_organization: The existence and activities of the Illicit_organization are concealed by the Front.
roles.Manner: Any description of the similarity of the event to some other event, particularly descriptions of the Front that also affect the details of the action.
roles.Means: The action taken by the Front to ensure successful deceit of authorities.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the fronting occurs.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Front is attempting to bring about.
roles.Time: The time at which the deceptive activity occurs

Frugality.def: The words of this frame describe how a Resource_controller spends money or other Resources for a particular purpose .

roles.Behavior: Some specific Behavior may be described as frugal or extravagant, rather than attributing the characteristic directly to the Resource_controller.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Resource: This FE is the resource which the Resource_controller expends.
roles.Resource_controller: The Resource_controller is the individual whose frugality or generosity is being described.

Fugitive.def: A Fugitive avoids recapture by or on the authority of Authorities in relation to a Crime which the Fugitive has committed or is suspected of having committed.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Fugitive is on the run.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Fugitive is avoiding capture.
roles.Fugitive: The Fugitive has escaped and/or is evading capture by law enforcement Authorities.
roles.Manner: Any description of the state of being imprisoned which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the general Place where the Fugitive is located.
roles.Time: The Time when the Fugitive is evading law enforcement.

Fullness.def: A Container is in a state of fullness/emptiness with respect to some Contents.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Container: Container is used for the entity whose fullness is being described.
roles.Contents: Contents is used for the stuff that is present/absent in the Container.
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the Container's fullness to the end.
roles.Frequency: The amount of times the Container is empty per unit of time.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The Time when the Container is full.

Function.def: An Entity is designed for or exists to perform an Activity or fulfill a Role.

roles.Activity: The Activity is the action that the Entity performs.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration that the Entity performs an Activity or fulfills a Role.
roles.Entity: The Entity is an object or person that performs the Activity or fulfills the Role.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Entity functions.
roles.Means: The Means by which an Entity functions.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Role: The Role is the position or duty that is occupied by the Entity.

Funding.def: A Supplier gives funds to a Recipient to fulfill a need or purpose (Imposed_purpose) of the Recipient.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are the conditions under which the funding is supplied.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE is the Explanation for which the Supplier gives funding to the Recipient or Imposed_purpose.
roles.Imposed_purpose: Imposed_purpose is the intended purpose of the funding.
roles.Manner: Any description of the funding event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary
roles.Means: This FE expresses the Means by which the Supplier funds the Recipient or Imposed_purpose.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the Supplier funds the Recipient or Imposed_purpose.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Supplier funds the Recipient.
roles.Recipient: Recipient is the person, people, or organization funded by the Supplier.
roles.Source: The Source of the funding. 'Hank's parents supported him by drawing from their retirement fund.'
roles.Supplier: Supplier is the person or entity that funds the Recipient or Imposed_purpose.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Supplier gives funds to the Recipient or Imposed_purpose.

Gathering_up.def: This frame describes an Agent's gathering of Individuals (people or entities) into a group, the Aggregate, defined by relative proximity.

roles.Agent: Agent is the person who gathers Individuals.
roles.Aggregate: This FE identifies the aggregate that results from the gathering.
roles.Co-participant: The Co-participant participates in a coordinated way in the same event as the primary protagonist.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").

roles.Goal: Goal designates the location where the Individuals might end up.
roles.Individuals: This FE identifies the entities that come together to form an Aggregate.
roles.Instrument: An Instrument that the Agent uses to gather the Individuals together.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Individuals are gathered up.
roles.Means: An act performed by the Agent that accomplishes the gathering.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the gathering event occurs.
roles.Purpose: The state of affairs that the Agent is attempting to bring about by gathering.
roles.Source: The Source is the location where the Individuals are at the beginning of the gathering event.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the gathering event occurs, if specified.

Gesture.def: The words in this frame have to do with non-verbal communication.

roles.Body_part: The Body_part is the specific body part of the Communicator which gestures.
roles.Communicator: This is the sentient entity that communicates a Message non-verbally.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Indicated_entity: The Indicated_entity is the entity which the Communicator is pointing out to the Addressee as meaningful.
roles.Instrument: An Instrument that the Communicator uses to gesture to the Addressee together.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act performed by the Communicator that results in the successful transfer of a Message.
roles.Message: This is the content of non-verbal communication.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is where the gesturing occurs.
roles.Time: When the gesturing occus.

Get_a_job.def: A new Employee obtains a Position with an Employer, with which there are certain Tasks associated; in exchange for the performance of these Tasks, the Employee receives Compensation from the Employer.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Employee: The person who enters an employment relation with an Employer.
roles.Employer: The person (or institution) that the Employee enters an employment relationship with.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Employee enters an employment relationship with an Employer.
roles.Means: The action by which the Employee enters an employment relationship.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Employee enteres an employment relationship with an Employer.
roles.Position: The label given to a particular type of employment.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Employee enters an employment relationship.
roles.Task: The action that the Employee is obligated to do for the Employer.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when an Employee signs on with an Employer.

Getting.def: A Recipient starts off without the Theme in their possession, and then comes to possess it.

roles.Beneficiary: The Beneficiary is an entity which the Recipient passes the Theme to, or shares the Theme with.
roles.Circumstances: Any condition or situation that serves as a very general background, against which the further importance of the Getting is understood.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation refers to the existing eventuality that the Recipient is responding to.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent intentionally acts.
roles.Means: The Means is the action of the Recipient which results in their possession of the Theme.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place denotes where the Getting takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Recipient: The Recipient indicates the entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
roles.Result: The state that either the Recipient or the Theme end up in after the acquisition.
roles.Source: The Source is the location that the Theme formerly occupied.
roles.Theme: The Theme is the object that changes possession.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Getting_triggered.def: A System interacts with the environment (which may include a volitional agent) and goes into operation in accordance with its intended purpose.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: The number of times the triggerent event occurs in a particular time period.
roles.Manner: Any holistic description of the event, including overall depictions (the same way) and descriptions pertaining to the System (quietly).
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the System goes off. 'Police came running downstairs when the metal detector went off at the county courthouse.'
roles.System: The System interacts with the environment and activates.
roles.Time: The time when the System triggers. 'The alarm went off at three o'clock today.'

Getting_underway.def: A Self_mover begins the motion away from a relatively deprofiled Source location.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goal: Goal is any expression that tells where the Self_mover ends up, or would end up, as a result of the motion.
roles.Manner: A Manner expression describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which a Self_mover begins the motion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Self_mover: The Self_mover is the volitional agent that moves.
roles.Source: Source refers to the starting-point of the Self_mover's motion.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Self_mover begins the motion away from the Source.

Getting_up.def: A Protagonist leaves the place where they have slept, their Bed, to begin or resume domestic, professional, or other activities.

roles.Bed: The place where the Protagonist has slept.
roles.Circumstances: The FE Circumstances encodes a setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the getting up event takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Protagonist is responding to in getting up.

roles.Place: The location in which the Protagonist's Bed is situated.
roles.Protagonist: The person or animal that has slept in a particular place and now leaves it to engage in other activities.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Protagonist gets out of Bed.
roles.Time: The time when the Protagonist leaves their place of sleeping.

Getting_vehicle_underway.def: A Driver prepares a Vehicle for travel by placing it in the normal location for the operation of the vehicle or by detaching it from a place where it was held.

roles.Circumstances: This FE indicates the Circumstances under which the preparation of the Vehicle takes place.
roles.Co-participant: An individual or vehicle that is also involved in the preparations.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Driver: This is the being, typically human, that prepares the Vehicle for motion, and will control it once it is in motion.
roles.Explanation: This FE marks a proposition from which the main clause logically follows.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compa

roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place describes the location where the Driver prepares the Vehicle for motion.
roles.Result: Result of the Driver's action. 'Bill pulled his Maserati out right into a truck.'
roles.Source: Any expression which describes the location that the Vehicle has been stationed at.
roles.Time: The Time when the Driver prepares the Vehicle for motion.
roles.Vehicle: The device--such as a car, boat, spaceship,.

Give_impression.def: In this class of perception words, a Phenomenon, typically expressed as External Argument, and its perceptual characteristics are given some description.

roles.Appraisal: Appraisal is the positive or negative judgement given to the Phenomenon.'Kim's hair feels nice.''That trumpet sounds dreadful.'
roles.Characterization: Characterization is the subjective description (of the Perceiver_passive ) of the Phenomenon.'Kim's new furniture looks sort of bluish.''The violins sounded as

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").

roles.Inference: Inference expresses some property of the Phenomenon that is not a direct feature of the particular sensory modality (if any), but rather is based on perception
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomenon: The Phenomenon is typically the External Argument of the verbs in this frame.'The soup tasted very salty.'

Giving.def: A Donor transfers a Theme from a Donor to a Recipient.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are the conditions under which the Theme is given.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Donor: The person that begins in possession of the Theme and causes it to be in the possession of the Recipient .
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Manner: The Manner is the manner in which the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Recipient: The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
roles.Theme: The object that changes ownership.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.

Giving_birth.def: A Mother and Father produce a Child or an Egg.

roles.Child: Child identifies the new self-motile creature produced from the Mother and Father.
roles.Circumstances: This FE identifies the Circumstances under which a Mother and Father produce produce a Child.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Egg: Egg is an immobile object containing an organism that may hatch as a mobile, infant organism.
roles.Father: Father is the male creature that copulates with the Mother, thus leading to the birth of the Child.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the event occurs.
roles.Mother: Mother is the female creature that produces the Child.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Parents: The Mother and Father expressed together.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of the birth.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.

Giving_in.def: A Capitulator who has been opposing a Force, which is typically exerted by a Compeller, ceases opposing that Force.

roles.Capitulator: The individual that yields to the Force exerted by the Compeller.
roles.Compeller: An individual that intentionally exerts Force on the Capitulator.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is a proposition denoting a state of affairs from which the Capitulator's giving in on the Issue logically follows.
roles.Force: A state of affairs, typically brought about by a Compeller, that impinges on the Capitulator and eventually causes them to no longer pursue their own view on th
roles.Issue: The matter, usually concerning a course of action, in which the Capitulator has disagreed with the Compeller.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Giving_in which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general de
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the Capitulator ceases to oppose the Force.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Capitulator intends to accomplish by ceasing their opposition.
roles.Resultant_action: The action that the Capitulator engages in after giving in to the Force.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Capitulator yields to the Compeller on the Issue.

Gizmo.def: This frame contains general words denoting equipment where the Use or purpose is not specified by the lexeme but (typically) by a separate expression.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Gizmo: The complex artifact with a particular use.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Go_into_shape.def: A Theme, which may or may not have a default shape or configuration, goes into a particular shape without being made to do so by an agent.

roles.Circumstances: The conditions under which the Theme is shaped.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: How long the event takes place.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the change into the shape occurs.
roles.Frequency: How often the shape changing occurs.
roles.Manner: Any description of the shape-changing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), fo
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the shape-changing event takes place.
roles.Resultant_configuration: The Result is the shape the Theme becomes.
roles.Theme: The Theme goes into a particular shape.
roles.Time: When the changing into a particular shape occurs.

Goal.def: A Landmark (in combination with the image schema evoked by particular targets) serves to pick out the final location of a Trajector in a construed or actual motion event.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Landmark: The relatively locatable entity which serves as a basis for determining the location of the Trajector using the Profiled_region.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Profiled_region: The location (located with respect to the Landmark) which is profiled by the particular image schema pertaining to the locative relation.
roles.Time: The time at which the Trajector is located in the Profiled_region.
roles.Trajector: The entity which is construed to be in motion, whose location at the end of the construed motion event is in question.

Going_back_on_a_commitment.def: A Protagonist has made a Commitment but does not honor it, thereby doing harm to an Affected_party.

roles.Affected_party: The individual or group to whom the Protagonist had made the Commitment and who is negatively affected by the Protagonist's not honoring the Commitment.
roles.Commitment: An expression of the commitment that the Protagonist has taken on earlier and which they fail to follow through on.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the Protagonist's failure to honor the Commitment logically follows.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, secondary effects (quietly), and general descriptions comparing events (the s
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Protagonist fails to honor the commitment they made.
roles.Protagonist: The Protagonist is the person who has committed themselves to do something and later does not follow through on it.
roles.Result: The outcome of the Protagonist going back on a commitment.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Protagonist fails to honor their commitment.

Gradable_artistic_quality.def: This frame contains LUs that ascribe an artistic quality to a work.

roles.Attribute: The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity or its Attribute has a particular style.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: A modifier expressing the deviation of the Entity or Attribute from the norm.
roles.Entity: The Entity for which a particular gradable Attribute is appropriate and under consideration.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Entity has the Attribute to a given Degree.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Entity or its Attribute is in the state of having the specified style.

Gradable_proximity.def: A Figure is (stably) located with respect to a Ground in terms of how the distance between them compares to some general or contextually relevant scale.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Figure: The Figure is perceived as located relative to a certain Ground location.
roles.Figures: The Figures are items which mutually serve to identify the location of the other items.
roles.Ground: The Ground serves as a basis for describing the location of the Figure.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The period of time during which the locative relation between Figure and Ground obtains.

Graph_shape.def: This frame descibes a Shape that Data makes on a Graph.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Data: A (usually quantitative) abstraction of information being represented in some Shape on a Graph.
roles.Graph: The visual representation of the information extracted from the Data.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Shape: A pattern that can be recognized when the Data is represented on a Graph.

Grasp.def: A Cognizer possesses knowledge about the workings, significance, or meaning of an idea or object, which we call Phenomenon, and is able to make predictions about the behavior or occurrence of the Phenomenon.

roles.Cognizer: The sentient animate being who acquires new knowledge.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Faculty: A part of a person's cognitive-emotional faculties that is said to acquire knowledge.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and general descri
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomenon: A state of affairs or dynamic system whose internal make-up and working the Cognizer comes to assimilate into their knowledge structure.
roles.Time: This FE indicates the when the Cognizer asssimilates the new knowledge.

Grinding.def: In this frame a Grinder or Grinding_cause causes a Patient to be broken into smaller pieces.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time for which the Grinder grinds the Patient.
roles.Goal: This is where the Patient might end up, after undergoing the grinding process.
roles.Grinder: The Grinder breaks the Patient into smaller pieces.
roles.Grinding_cause: An animate or inanimate entity, a force, or event that grinds.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument with which the Grinder grinds the Patient.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Grinder grinds the Patient.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Grinder grinds the Patient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is the entity which undergoes the change brought about by the Grinder or Grinding_cause.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Grinder grinds the Patient.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Grinder grinds the Patient.
roles.Result: The Result is the shape the Patient becomes.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Grinder grinds the Patient.

Grooming.def: In this frame, an Agent engages in personal body care by grooming either a Patient or a Body_part.

roles.Agent: The agent is the person who does the grooming.
roles.Body_part: This is the region of the body that gets groomed.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: How long the grooming takes place.
roles.Frequency: The frequency with which the Agent groom himself/other.
roles.Instrument: This is an object that aids the washing process.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent intentionally acts.
roles.Means: The action performed by the Agent to accomplish the grooming.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The patient is the person who gets washed.
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Agent is trying to bring about by grooming.
roles.Result: Result of the grooming event.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the event occurs.

Ground_up.def: In this frame a Patient is in a state of having been broken into smaller pieces.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is the entity acted on and that undergoes a change.
roles.Result: The Result is the shape the Patient becomes.

Growing_food.def: A Grower endeavors to tend to and influence the environment of Food so as to foster its growth.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: For what length of time the Grower is growing Food.
roles.Food: Food is the item grown by the Grower, which can include things not traditionally eaten, like flowers, etc., or items for other consumption-related uses, like me
roles.Frequency: How often the Grower grows Food.
roles.Grower: The Grower is the agent growing Food.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument is used by the Grower as a tool grow Food.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Grower grows Food.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Grower grows Food.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The greater geographic location where the Grower grows Food.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Grower intends to accomplish by growing Food.
roles.Source: The starting state of the Food, e.g., a seed.
roles.Time: When the growing event occurs.

Guest_and_host.def: Two individuals, the Guest and the Host are in a temporary social relationship within which the Host provides use of a location or resources for the Guest at a location highly associated with the Host (in many cases, where the Host lives or

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of the relationship. 'I was Manu's guest for few days in Allepey, in a very beautiful old house.'
roles.Guest: The Guest receives the hospitality of the Host.
roles.Host: The Host provides a location and/or resources for the Guest at the Host_location.
roles.Host_location: The location associated with the Host, where the Guest is staying, working, etc.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act whereby a focal participant achieves an action indicated by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The time when the guest-and-host relationship holds.

Guilt_or_innocence.def: An Accused individual is deemed by a (usually implicit) Judge to be involved (or not) in a Misdeed.

roles.Accused: This is the person who is accused of a Misdeed.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Misdeed: The wrongful act which the Accused was purportedly involved in.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Gusto.def: A Person has a particular mental state and the ability to engage in an activity with enthusiasm, energy, and positivity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Person: The person who is evaluated for a level of enthusiasm.

Hair_configuration.def: Temporary or permanent Styles and Configurations of Hair, as well as its inherent Nature.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Configuration: Temporary Configurations of hair (eg braid, bun, ponytail).
roles.Hair: This FE is the hair itself 'Her tresses were golden.'
roles.Hair_property: A property of the hair (eg curly, fine, brown).
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Possessor: This FE is the Possessor of the body part.

Halt.def: This frame consists of LUs which denote a Theme ceasing motion.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the length of Time during which the motion is stopped.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Theme stops motion.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Theme stops motion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Theme's motion stops.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which a Theme stops the motion.
roles.Theme: This FE identifies Theme whose motion ceases.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Theme stops.

Have_as_requirement.def: The obtaining of a Requirement state of affairs or the presence of a Required_entity is profiled as a prerequisite for the obtaining or occurring of a Dependent state-of-affairs.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dependent: The state-of-affairs which cannot hold without the state of affairs of the Requirement or the presence of the Required_entity.
roles.Explanation: The state-of-affairs which militates that the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent to obtain.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Place denotes a location in which the specified relation between Requirement and Dependent holds.
roles.Required_entity: An entity that has to be present for the Dependent state of affairs to obtain.
roles.Requirement: The state-of-affairs that must obtain in order for the Dependent to obtain.
roles.Time: The time at which the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent.

Have_as_translation_equivalent.def: A Source_symbol in a Source_representation system is presented to be matched by a Target_symbol in a Target_representation in the ability to express a particular Content.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are the set of conditions in which the translation is made.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: The information that is meant to be represented by the Source_symbol and Target_symbol.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Source_representation: The representation system in which the Content pre-exists.
roles.Source_symbol: A symbol or set of symbols representing the Content in the Source_representation format.
roles.Target_representation: The representation system within which the Target_symbol is equivalent in its signification to the Source_symbol within the Source_representation system .
roles.Target_symbol: A symbol or set of symbols representing the Content in the Target_representation format.
roles.Time: The period of time during which the translation equivalence holds.

Have_associated.def: A Topical_entity has properties which are affected by the existence and association of an Entity.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions under which the Entity is declared to exist in association with the Topical_entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period during which the Entity exists in association with the Topical_entity.
roles.Entity: Some entity, abstract or concrete, which is stated to exist and be associated with the Topical_entity.
roles.Explanation: A situation, force, or entity which brings about the existence of the Entity or its association with the Topical_entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the Entity is associated with the Topical_entity.
roles.Time: The time at which the Entity exists and is associated with the Topical_entity
roles.Topical_entity: The entity under discussion, whose states and properties are impacted by its association with the Entity.

Have_visitor_over.def: A Host, at a location strongly associated with him/herself (such as a place of employment or residence), temporarily hosts a Visitor so that the Visitor can achieve a goal.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Host: The Host allows the Visitor to enter his/her location (house, office, etc.) for a temporary period so that the Visitor can achieve a goal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: The Purpose of the Host in hosting the Visitor.
roles.Visitor: The Visitor is a guest of the Host at a location strongly associated with the Host.

Having_or_lacking_access.def: A Theme has access to a Useful_location or is blocked from it by a Barrier.

roles.Barrier: An entity, event, or state that (at least potentially) prevents the Theme from getting to the Useful_location.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the Theme meets or fails to meet the pre-conditions for getting to the Useful_location.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: An Explanation for why the Barrier exists, or for why the Theme meets or fails to meet pre-conditions for entering the Useful_location.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Theme: The Theme whose motion is blocked or free.
roles.Useful_location: The place or thing that the Theme is headed towards, despite a potential or actual Barrier.

Health_response.def: A Protagonist is sensitive to a Trigger, which has the potential to cause some kind of reaction in the Protagonist.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Manner describes the way (or style) in which the Protagonist Health_response manifests itself.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Protagonist: The Protagonist occurs as the External Argument of the targets in this frame.
roles.Trigger: The Trigger most commonly occurs in a PP Complement headed by to.

Hearsay.def: The Hearer receives a Message or communication on a particular Topic.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Hearer: This FE is the person who receives a Message.
roles.Message: The Message is the content that is communicated from one person to another.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The Time the Hearer receives the Message.
roles.Topic: Topic is the subject matter about which the Message is communicated.

Heat_potential.def: An Insulator is judged for its potential to increase the body temperature of an Experiencer.

roles.Circumstances: The state of the world when the Experiencer feels warmth
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Insulator: The object which provides warm. It does not have to radiate heat; it may provide warmth with heavy insulation. 'That is a warm bed.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Hedging.def: When words of this frame are used as hedge markers, they signal that the speaker of the sentence wishes to be careful about asserting some Hedged_content.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Hedged_content: The idea or ideas that the speaker wishes to be careful about asserting.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Heralding.def: A Communicator announces (linguistically or non-linguistically) the imminent arrival of an Individual or the occurrence of an Event.

roles.Communicator: The Communicator greets the arrival of an Individual or occurrence of an Event.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The occurrence which is greeted by the Communicator.
roles.Individual: The person who is greeted at their arrival by the Communicator.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (loudly), and general descriptions comparing event
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which a Communicator heralds.
roles.Medium: The symbol-containing artifact whereby a Communicator heralds.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Communicator heralds.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which a Communicator heralds.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Communicator heralds.

Hiding_objects.def: An Agent causes a Hidden_object to become perceptually inaccessible to potential perceivers by placing it in a Hiding_place or putting in place an Obstruction that screens the object.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person who causes the Hidden_entity to be not perceptually accessible to potential perceivers.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the occurrence of the hiding event logically follows.
roles.Hidden_object: The Hidden_object is the entity which is blocked from view.
roles.Hiding_place: The location in which the Hidden_object is placed so as not to be perceptually accessible.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: An action of the Agent that brings about the hiding of the Hidden_object.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the spatial setting in which the hiding event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Agent hopes to bring about by hiding the Hidden_object.
roles.Time: Time denotes the interval of time during which the Agent causes the Hidden_object to become hidden from perceptual access.

Hindering.def: In this frame a Hindrance makes it more difficult for a Protagonist to complete their intended Action or a Hindrance directly affects an Action where the Action can be a natural act or the actions of many individuals in a collective endeavo

roles.Action: The Action is what the Protagonist desires to do, which is made more difficult by the Hindrance.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time over which the hindering takes place.
roles.Explanation: This FE label is used for the cause of the Hindrance
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Hindrance: The Hindrance is the force which makes the Action more difficult or less likely to be successfully completed.
roles.Manner: The manner in which hindering occurs
roles.Means: This FE describes the means by which hindering occurs
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the location where he Hindrance affects the Protagonist or Action.
roles.Protagonist: The Protagonist is the entity that tends towards or plans some Action which the Hindrance causes to be more difficult.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Hindrance affects the Protagonist or Action.

Hiring.def: An Employer hires an Employee, promising the Employee a certain Compensation in exchange for the performance of a job.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Employee: The person whom the Employer takes on as an Employee, obligating them to perform some Task in order to receive Compensation.
roles.Employer: The person (or institution) that takes on an Employee, giving them Compensation in return for the performance of an assigned Task.
roles.Field: The Field that the Employee is going to work in for their Employer.
roles.Instrument: An entity that the Employer uses to hire the Employee.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Employer hires an Employee.
roles.Means: An action by the Employer whereby the hire is brought about.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Employer hires the Employee.
roles.Position: The label given to a particular type of employment.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Employer hires the Employee.
roles.Task: The action that the Employee is taken on by the Employer to do.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when an Employer hires the Employee.

Historic_event.def: In the course of history, an Event or Entity is taken to have importance or significance.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: This FE identifies the entity, concrete or abstract.
roles.Event: This FE identifies the event which occurs to create history.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which an event occurs.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies where the event takes place.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the event occurs.

History.def: A recordable sequence of events is associated with a given Topic.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration, often expressed in calendric units, of the history of the Topic.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: When the events concerning the Topic occured.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the subject about which the history is given.

Hit_or_miss.def: An Agent succeeds or fails to interact perceptually or physically with the Target or Target_location.

roles.Agent: The individual who tries to interact with the Target.
roles.Circumstances: The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which contextualizes the hitting or missing of the Agent but is not conceived of as caused by it.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: The object manipulated by the Agent in order to interact with the Target.
roles.Manner: Any description of how the details of the event compare to others, either generally (the same way), or in terms of a state of the Agent which influences the eve
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent achieves a Purpose.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the Agent manages or fails to interact with the Target.
roles.Purpose: The reason for which the Agent attempts to interact with the Target
roles.Target: The Target is the entity located in an indirectly accessible location relative to the Agent.
roles.Target_location: The location that the Agent is attempting to access using the Instrument.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when something hits or misses.

Hit_target.def: An Agent causes the ballistic motion of a projectile and its subsequent impact on a Target.

roles.Agent: The individual that directs the Projectile such that it impacts the Target.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: The entity, most often ammunition or a firearm, which the Agent manipulates to hit the Target.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: The action performed by the Agent that accomplishes hitting the Target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the event happens.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Agent hopes to bring about by hitting the Target
roles.Target: The entity which is hit by a Projectile directed by the Agent.
roles.Time: The time at which the Agent hits the Target.

Holding_off_on.def: An Agent decides temporarily not to perform a Desirable_action or not to interact with a Salient_entity.

roles.Agent: The Agent decides not to engage in a Desirable_action for a while or not to interact with a Salient_entity.
roles.Circumstances: This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the Agent does not engage in the Desirable_action.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Desirable_action: Desirable_action identifies the event or activity in which the Agent does not engage for a while.
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the Agent's decision to forgo a Desirable_action to the point in time when the Agent engages in the ac
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the Agent's decision to temporarily forgo a Desirable_action or to not interact with a Salient_entity logically
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the temporary forgoing occurs.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the temporary forgoing occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the temporary forgoing occurs.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the temporary forgoing occurs.
roles.Salient_entity: An entity that evokes a contextually inferrable Desirable_action that the Agent is temporarily forgoing.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the interval of Time during which the the forgoing occurs.

Hospitality.def: A Host is judged regarding their attitude as a potential host in a guest-host relationship.

roles.Behavior: The Behavior is the action of the Host on which the evaluation of the Host's character is based.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Expressor: The Expressor is the body part or action by a body part which indicates the character of the Host.
roles.Guest: The Guest is the entity which is positively or negatively treated by the Host.
roles.Host: The Host is the person whose Behavior towards others as a (potential) host is evaluated.
roles.Judge: The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the evaluation.
roles.Manner: The Manner is the way in which the Host embodies the characters of a good or poor host.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Topic: The Topic is the situation or person that the Host's Behavior responds to or is related to.

Hostile_encounter.def: This frame consists of words that describe a hostile encounter between opposing forces (Side_1 and Side_2, collectively conceptualizable as Sides) over a disputed Issue and/or in order to reach a specific Purpose.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which an event occurs.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Issue: An unresolved question over which the two sides of a hostile encounter are in disagreement.
roles.Manner: Any expression which describes a property of the hostile encounter.
roles.Means: Means describes the way in which a side engages in a hostile encounter.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the hostile encounter takes place.
roles.Purpose: The desired result of the outcome of the hostile encounter for the Side_1 or for all the Sides collectively.
roles.Result: The Result of an event.
roles.Side_1: One of two participants in a hostile encounter.
roles.Side_2: One of two participants in a hostile encounter, usually the second mentioned.
roles.Sides: The jointly expressed sides in a hostile encounter.
roles.Time: The Time at which the hostile encounter occurs.

Hunting.def: A Hunter tries to gain Food by way of outsmarting or tracking a living.

roles.Co-participant: Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the same event as the primary protagonist, regardless of whether the protagonist, and henc
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: For what length of time the Hunter attempted to obtain Food.
roles.Food: Food is the sought-out item by the Hunter.
roles.Frequency: How often the Hunter attempts to obtain Food.
roles.Ground: This is the entity to which the Hunter pays attention.
roles.Hunter: The Hunter is the agent hoping to obtain Food.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument is used by the Hunter as a tool to help obtain Food.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Hunter makes the attempt for Food.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an attempt at achieving a Food obtainment.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The greater geographic location where the Hunter attempts to obtain Food.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Hunter intends to accomplish by seeking Food.
roles.Time: When the Time seeking action occurs.

Hunting_success_or_failure.def: A Hunter succeeds or fails at capturing his sought-out or tracked Food.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Food: Food is the item obtained by the Hunter.
roles.Frequency: How often the Hunter obtains Food.
roles.Hunter: The Hunter is the agent that has successfully obtained Food.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument is used by the Hunter as a tool to obtain Food.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Hunter obtains the Food.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Food is obtained.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The greater geographic location where the Hunter obtains Food.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Hunter intends to accomplish obtaining Food.
roles.Time: When the Food seeking action occurs.

Identicality.def: A Current_instance of a certain Type is under discussion.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Current_instance: The instance of the Type that is currently under discussion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Previous_context: The situation in which another instance of the Type was encountered earlier.
roles.Previous_instance: An instance of the Type that was encountered previously and which is now compared for identity with the Current_instance.
roles.Set_of_instances: The complete set of instances of the Type involved in the mentioned contexts.
roles.Time: The Time when the Current_instance is the same or different.
roles.Type: The kind of thing of which instances are under discussion.

Identity.def: An Instance of some type is conceived of as having an Identity, defined as the unique feature that distinguishes each Instance from all other instances of its type.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Identity: The feature of each Instance that distinguishes it from all others.
roles.Instance: The instance of a type or out of a set that is currently under discussion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Idiosyncrasy.def: A certain Idiosyncrasy belongs to an Entity distinguishing it from other entities.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity that has a certain distinguishing Idiosyncrasy.
roles.Idiosyncrasy: An entity or characteristic belonging to the Entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Imitating.def: An Agent displays a Characteristic of a Standard in his or her own way of behaving.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person that borrows a Characteristic behavior from a Standard.
roles.Characteristic: The Characteristic is a behavior or property that the Standard possesses and which the Agent adopts in his or her own behavior.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the imitation event logically follows.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compa
roles.Means: An act performed by the Agent that accomplishes the imitation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Agent imitates some entity which acts as a Standard.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by performing the imitation.
roles.Standard: The Standard is the entity that exhibits a certain Characteristic that the Agent models their own behavior on.
roles.Time: The time at which the imitation occurs.

Immobilization.def: The Agent immobilizes a Patient optionally, to an Anchor.

roles.Agent: The Agent immobilizes the Patient. 'Lisa handcuffed Mike to the refridgerator.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: The instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Manner: Any description of the immobilizing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comp
roles.Means: An act performed by the Agent that accomplishes the immobilization.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is immobilized by the Agent, optionally to an Anchor.
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent immobilizes a Patient.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Impact.def: While in motion, an Impactor makes sudden, forcible contact with the Impactee, or two Impactors both move, mutually making forcible contact.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The reason for which an Impact occurs.
roles.Impactee: The entity which is hit by the Impactor. 'The rock hit the sand with a thump.'
roles.Impactor: The entity that hits the Impactee. 'The rock hit the sand with a thump.'
roles.Impactors: The multiple entities that collide. 'The car and truck collided at a combined speed of over 100MPH.'
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Result: Result of an event
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Import_export_scenario.def: An Agent moves Goods (or some other useful item) from an Exporting_area, across a boundary or border to a different area, the Importing_area.

roles.Agent: The conscious entity, generally a person, that moves the Goods.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in performing the action.
roles.Exporting_area: The place where the Goods are initially, before the action.
roles.Goods: The items of value whose location is changing.
roles.Importing_area: The FE Importing_area is the place that the Goods end up as a result of motion.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which the Agent moves the Goods.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent moves the Goods.

Importance.def: A Factor affects the outcome of an Undertaking, which can be a goal-oriented activity or the maintenance of a desirable state, the work in a Field, or something portrayed as affecting an Interested_party.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for which the Factor is important to the Undertaking.
roles.Factor: Factor is used for the concrete or abstract entity whose importance is assessed.
roles.Field: A Factor may be generally important to the people or the activities in a field of endeavour.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Interested_party: Interested_party identifies the people who are affected by a particular Factor.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the Factor is important.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Factor is important to the Undertaking.
roles.Undertaking: The Undertaking is a process or state or field of activity in which the Interested_party has a stake.

Importing.def: An Importer receives Goods from an Exporting_area, across a boundary or border to a different area, the Importing_area.

roles.Beneficiary: This FE applies to participants who derive a benefit from the occurrence of the act of importation.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
