roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that explains the Importer's importation of the Goods.
roles.Exporting_area: The place where the Goods are initially, before the being moved.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Goods: The items of value whose location is changing.
roles.Importer: The conscious entity, generally a person, that brings the Goods into the Importing_area.
roles.Importing_area: The FE Importing_area is the place that the Goods end up as a result of motion.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Importer that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which the Importer moves the Goods.
roles.Result: The Result is the final state of the Goods when brought into the Importing_area.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Importer moves the Goods.

Imposing_obligation.def: A Duty is imposed on a Responsible_party according to a Principle which regulates how the Responsible_party should respond to a Situation.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duty: The action that the Responsible_party is obligated to perform.
roles.Manner: Any holistic description of the details of the action, either comparing to another event or describing the action in terms of characteristics of the Obligator t
roles.Means: An event which brings about the obligation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Obligator: The Obligator is the person who imposes the Duty on the Responsible_party.
roles.Place: A location in which the Responsible_party has a specified Duty .
roles.Principle: A regulating idea (which may be instantiated as a document) that the Responsible_party is subject to.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Obligator hopes to bring about by imposing the obligation.
roles.Responsible_party: The person who must perform the Duty. 'The winning bid committed her to paint an oil portrait for the high bidder.'
roles.Situation: A state of affairs that results in the Responsible_party being obligated to carry out the Duty in accordance with the Principle.
roles.Time: The time interval during which the Duty is imposed on the Responsible_party by the Obligator or the Situation.

Impression.def: This frame describes the Impression which a Figure, which can be a person, an organization, or an object, leaves with an Audience.

roles.Audience: A person or group of people who have an Impression of a Figure.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Figure: The entity (a person, organization, product, or event) for which the Audience has an Impression.
roles.Impression: A generalized conception of a Figure presented to or shared by an Audience.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Imprisonment.def: The Authorities put a Prisoner in Prison as punishment for an Offense.

roles.Authorities: The Authorities are the institution or actors carrying out the imprisonment.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Authorities maintains the confinement of the Prisoner.
roles.Explanation: The act or state of affairs that the Authorities respond to by imprisoning the Prisoner.
roles.Manner: Any description of the imprisoning event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and ge
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Authorities that brings about the imprisonment.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Prisoner is kept.
roles.Prison: The Prison within which the Prisoner comes to be confined.
roles.Prisoner: The person who is confined in a penal institution.
roles.Purpose: The purpose of the imprisonment. 'City officials later release the blacks and say they imprisoned them in order to protect them from rioters.'
roles.Time: The time when the imprisonment happens.

Improvement_or_decline.def: An Entity improves from a less desirable Prior_state to a more desirable Post_state.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period over which the improvement occurs.
roles.Entity: The object that undergoes change. 'Improvements in marketing techniques have since rendered it obsolete.'
roles.Explanation: An event or state of affairs that brings about the improvement of the Entity.
roles.Frequency: How often the Improvement event occurs.
roles.Manner: A description of the improvement, generally a description comparing events (the same way).
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Improvement occurs.
roles.Time: The time at which the improvement occurs.

Improvised_explosive_device.def: An improvised explosive device is a Bomb or similar device used in non-conventional warfare.

roles.Bomb: The Bomb explodes, injuring or damaging a Target.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Inclination.def: Due to internal forces/properties, an Entity is inclined towards a particular Behavior, which may be to perform an action or to maintain a state.

roles.Behavior: The FE Behavior marks expressions that indicate which state or action the Entity tends towards.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: TheFrame Element Entity identifies the person or thing that has a tendency towards some Behaviour.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Inclusion.def: A Total has a Part, either as a member of an aggregate or as a constituent part of a simple entity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: This FE identifies the frequency with which the Part is included int he Total.
roles.Manner: Any description of the inclusion event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part: A component or constituent that is specified to form part of the Total.
roles.Place: The location at which the Total includes the Part.
roles.Purpose: This FE indicates the purpose for which some implicit (non-expressed) agent causes the inclusion of the Part within the Total.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Total includes the Part.
roles.Total: A complex entity, either an aggregate or a unit, of which a Part, a constituent or a component, is specified.

Increment.def: A member or members of a Class have just been mentioned or are present in the discourse setting and now a different instance (or group of instances) of the same class is referred to.

roles.Added_set: The instance of the Class that is added to the Initial_set of entities in the Class.
roles.Class: The general category of entity which has been referred to.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Initial_set: The previously mentioned group of entities of the Class.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Indicating.def: A Communicator or Medium assigns linguistic meaning to an Unresolved_referent thereby identifying the specific actor or entity which fulfills the answer to this question.

roles.Communicator: The person who uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey the Unresolved_referent to another person.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration is the length of time during which the indicating takes place.
roles.Explanation: The reason why the Communicator is indicating the Unresolved_referent.
roles.Frequency: How often the Communicator or Medium indicates the Unresolved_referent.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Communicator makes the indication.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Communicator makes the indication.
roles.Medium: The physical or abstract setting in which the Unresolved_referent is conveyed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Communicator or Medium indicates the Unresolved_referent.
roles.Purpose: To what end the Communicator or Medium makes the indication.
roles.Time: When the the Communicator is makes the indication.
roles.Unresolved_referent: The thing to which the Communicator or Medium refers for identification purposes.

Indigenous_origin.def: An Entity began its existence in the context of a location of Origin, which is a discourse-salient place, or culture.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The item whose Origin is under discussion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Origin: The discourse-salient place or culture where the Entity was produced.

Individual_history.def: This scenario describes a series of Events, associated with a single Participant, i.e., the history of the Participant.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration, often expressed in calendric units, of the history of the Participant.
roles.Events: The Events which the Participant is a part of.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Participant: The Participant is either an active participant in all of the Events (e.g., Agent or Patient), or is more peripherally associated with the Events (e.g., Locatio
roles.Time: When the Events concerning the Participant occured.

Ineffability.def: A Stimulus inspires a feeling of awe and interest in a (generally implicit or generic) Experiencer due to desirable qualities which are difficult to explain.

roles.Attribute: An expression of the attribute of ineffability.
roles.Circumstances: This FE marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions under which the Stimulus is able to bring about the emotion.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Stimulus: The entity which inspires a feeling of amazement at its exceptionality.

Infecting.def: The action of spreading some Infection to an Infected_entity, intentionally or otherwise.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Infected_entity: This FE labels the recipient of the Infection.
roles.Infection: An invasion, typically undetected, of an entity's system.
roles.Infection_cause: This FE labels the cause of the Infection which affects the Infected_entity.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Infecting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification, force, secondary effects, and general descri
roles.Means: An act by an Infection_cause that enables them to act upon the Infected_entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place at which the Infecting event occurs; or, the location of the Infection_cause.
roles.Result: The Result of an Infection.
roles.Time: When the infection occurs.

Information.def: A Cognizer knows or comes to know some piece of Information about a Topic.

roles.Cognizer: The Cognizer is aware of the Information.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Information: The Information that the Cognizer possesses or comes to posess.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Source: The Cognizer obtains the Information from the Source.
roles.Topic: The Topic is what the Information is about in general.

Information_display.def: A man-made artifact, digital or physical, which is used to display information presented via the object.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Display: This FE identifies the entity or substance that is designed to have a particular Use.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Infrastructure.def: A group of entities exist (as an infrastructure) such that a particular type of Activity is either enabled or facilitated.

roles.Activity: The Activity which is enabled or facilitated by the infrastructure.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Infrastructure: The collection of entities and/or institutions that help to promote an Activity of a public character.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location of the infrastructure. 'Much of the transportation infrastructure in the US was developed when there was no need for private money.'
roles.Possessor: The organization, institution, or individual who owns the infrastructure.
roles.Resource: The infrastructure may be conceived of as consisting of Resources that can be made use of by Users in performing an Activity.
roles.User: The people for whom the infrastructure is designed to be used by.

Ingest_substance.def: In this frame an Ingestor takes a Substance into his or her body.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Delivery_device: The Delivery_device is the means by which the Substance is ingested.
roles.Duration: The Duration is the length of time for which the Ingestor ingests.
roles.Frequency: The Frequency with which the Ingestor ingests.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Ingestor ingests the Substance.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Ingestor ingests the Substance.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the Ingestor ingests the Substance.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Ingestor ingests the Substance.
roles.Substance: The Substance is the drug or other substance that is ingested by the Ingestor.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Ingestor ingests the Substance.

Ingestion.def: An Ingestor consumes food or drink (Ingestibles), which entails putting the Ingestibles in the mouth for delivery to the digestive system.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time spent on the ingestion activity.
roles.Ingestibles: The Ingestibles are the entities that are being consumed by the Ingestor.
roles.Ingestor: The Ingestor is the person eating or drinking.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action.
roles.Means: An act performed by the Ingestor that enables them to accomplishes the whole act of ingestion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The action that the Ingestor hopes to bring about by ingesting.
roles.Source: Place from which the Ingestor takes the Ingestibles
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Ingredients.def: A Material is used to make a Product. 'These cooking ingredients are readily available.' 'An aberrant hemoglobin precursor has been discovered to be implicated.'

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Material: The entity which is used to make a Product.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Product: The entity or substance that is created out of the Material.
roles.Use: The purpose for which the Material is intended.

Inherent_purpose.def: The universe is considered through a teleological perspective and natural phenomena are seen to exist for the purpose of fulfilling some ultimate aim.

roles.Apparatus: An entity that was not created by a living thing that is conceptualized to exist to fulfill some Goal.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goal: The ultimate aim of the Apparatus.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Inhibit_movement.def: An Agent restricts the movement of a Theme to within the vicinity of the Holding_location, despite the Theme's desire, plan, or tendency towards motion; the Agent may also use an Instrument.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person intentionally restricting the movement of the Theme.
roles.Cause: The Cause is the non-sentient entity which is responsible for restricting the movement or location of the Theme.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Agent maintains the confinement of the Theme.
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in performing the action.
roles.Holding_location: The area within which the Theme comes to be confined.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which the confinement is carried out.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose of the confinement. 'John was locked in his room so he could think about what he had done wrong.'
roles.Theme: The entity which is confined. 'He confined 340 mutineers in Burford Church for the next three days under general sentence of death.'
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Inspecting.def: An Inspector directs his/her perceptual attention to a Ground to ascertain whether the Ground is intact or whether an Unwanted_entity is present.

roles.Circumstances: The circumstances under which the Inspector examines the Ground.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Desired_state_of_affairs: The desirable state of affairs which the Inspector hopes to find to obtain when inspecting the Ground.
roles.Ground: The entity that the Inspector inspects with his senses to ascertain whether it is intact.
roles.Inspector: The person who inspects the Ground to see if it is intact or without blemish.
roles.Instrument: An entity used by the Inspector to scrutinize the Ground.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Inspector scrutinizes the Ground.
roles.Means: This FE is used for the Means by which the Inspector examines the Ground.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: Some of the words in this frame occur with a constituent that expresses the desired outcome of the inspection.
roles.Time: The Time when the Inspector examines the Ground.
roles.Unwanted_entity: An entity whose presence would impair the acceptability or usefulness of the Ground.

Installing.def: An Agent places a Component in a Fixed_location so that the Component is attached and interconnected and thereby functional.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person (or other force) that installs the Component.
roles.Co-participant: This is a second component that is installed alongside the primary Component or an individual performing the installation together with the Agent.
roles.Component: The Component is the object that is placed in a Fixed_location.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation indicates why the installation occurs.
roles.Fixed_location: The Fixed_location is the location where the Component is placed and to which it is attached so as to be useful.
roles.Manner: Any description of the installation event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comp
roles.Means: The Means is an act whereby the Agent achieves the installation of the Component.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place indicates where the installation occurs.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by perform the installation.
roles.Time: The time period in which the Component is installed.

Instance.def: This frame concerns transparent nouns that denote Instances of Types of entities or events.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instance: A thing or episode of a certain Type.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Type: The category of thing or event of which an Instance is picked out.'I collected two specimens of this rare species.'

Institutionalization.def: A Patient is committed to the care of a medical Facility by a proper Authority.

roles.Authority: The Authority is the actor carrying out the institutionalization with proper legal authorization, either invested into them in general by the government or gran
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the occurrence of the institutionalization event logically follows.
roles.Facility: The facility where the Patient is taken for treatment.
roles.Frequency: This FE marks the amount of times the Patient is committed to the Facility per unit of time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the institutionalization event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Authority that brings about the institutionalization of the Patient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The person who is committed to a facility with a view towards helping them mentally or physically.
roles.Place: The location in which the Facility is situated.
roles.Purpose: The purpose of the institutionalization. 'His squabbling parents would rather institutionalize him to rid themselves of their problem.'
roles.Time: The time interval during which the institutionalization happens.

Institutions.def: This frame concerns permanent organizations (the Institutions) with a public character, meaning that they are intended to affect the lives of the public at large in a particular Domain.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Domain: The concern of the Institution-- broadly speaking, the aspect of society that they affect.
roles.Institution: A permanent organization with a socially important purpose.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the Institution is located.
roles.Purpose: The goal of the Institution. 'We're trying to figure out the quality indicators of an institution for addiction care.'

Intentional_deception.def: A Deceiver performs some action so that the Victim ends up with an incorrect understanding about some Topic.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Deceiver: The person who acts so as to give the Victim an incorrect idea about a Topic.
roles.Means: The action performed by the Deceiver to fool the Victim.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the deception occurs.
roles.Time: The time at which the deception occurs. 'Some, looking for decent employment, said they were deceived soon after getting off the train.'
roles.Topic: The entity to which the misleading idea relates, what it is about.
roles.Victim: The person who receives an incorrect idea because of the Deceiver's actions.

Intentional_traversing.def: A Self_mover intentionally moves in a Directionon a Path relative to landmark that is neither the Source nor the Goal of the overall motion.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Direction: The direction in which the Self_mover goes.
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Self_mover spends in motion.
roles.Explanation: A factor which explains the particular motion or manner of motion of the Self_mover.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that an action occurs in a given time.
roles.Goal: Any expression which indicates where the Self_mover ends up as a result of the motion expresses the frame element Goal.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and gene
roles.Means: An event involving the Self_mover that results in their moving in the specified way.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: Any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal expresses the frame element Path, excluding directional expressions: 'We decided
roles.Path_shape: The configuration formed by the entire Path of the Self_mover, taken simultaneously.
roles.Place: The Place is where the motion (which is specified by a Source, Path or Goal) is located.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Self_mover wishes to bring about.
roles.Self_mover: This is a sentient being or a vehicle steered by a sentient being which moves.
roles.Source: Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source.
roles.Time: The time at which the motion takes place.

Intentionally_act.def: This is an abstract frame for acts performed by sentient beings.

roles.Act: This FE identifies the Act that the Agent performs intentionally.
roles.Agent: The Agent performs the intentional act. 'We have not yet acted .'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: The Frequency with which the Agent does the Act in a given period of time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent acts intentionally.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the intentional act occurs.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent performs an intentional act.
roles.Result: The Result of an act.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent acts intentionally.

Intentionally_affect.def: An Agent causes a Patient to be affected, sometimes by a particular Means or by use of an Instrument.

roles.Agent: The conscious entity, generally a person, that performs the intentional act that affects the Patient.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: This FE identifies the act that the Agent performs intentionally.
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in performing the action.
roles.Instrument: An entity directed by the Agent that interacts with an Patient to accomplish the action indicated by the target.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: Patient is the entity acted on and that may, but need not, undergo a change.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Agent performs the intentional act.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent intentionally affects a Patient.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent intentionally affects the Patient.

Intentionally_create.def: The Creator creates a new entity, the Created_entity, possibly out of Components.

roles.Co-participant: A secondary agent with whom the Creator intentionally creates the Created_entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Created_entity: This FE identifies the entity that the Agent intentionally creates.
roles.Creator: The Creator creates a created entity.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the instrument with which an Agent intentionally creates a Created_entitiy.
roles.Manner: Any description of the creation event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compari
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which a Creator intentionally creates a new entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place ehere the Agent intentionally creates the new entity.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent intentionally creates a new entity.
roles.Role: The role of Created_entity. 'This particular book was created as an introductory text.'
roles.Time: This FE identifes the Time when an Agent intentionally creates a new entity.

Intercepting.def: A volitionally acting Interceptor takes control, without being authorized to do so by the sender, of a Theme that is underway from a sender to a recipient.

roles.Circumstances: The circumstances under which the interception takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Interceptor: The volitional agent who without authorization of sender or recipient takes control of a Theme that is en route to a destination.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Intercepting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), and
roles.Means: The action performed by the Interceptor that results in success.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the Interceptor takes control of the Theme.
roles.Purpose: The state of affairs that the Interceptor hopes to bring about by intercepting.
roles.Theme: The entity, physical or abstract, construed as traveling from a sender to a goal location, which is taken hold of by the Interceptor without permission.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Interceptor takes control of the Theme.

Interior_profile_relation.def: A Figure is located in the interior (the Profiled_region--see Locative_relation frame) of the Ground.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Figure: The Figure is the entity located with respect to the Ground.
roles.Ground: The Ground is the area that the Figure is located in.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Profiled_region: The area or zone interior to the Ground. This FE excludes Figure and is only used in particular constructions such as the following: 'Inside the cupboard was a
roles.Time: The time during which the Figure was located in the Ground.

Interrupt_process.def: A Cause (or associated Actor) causes an ongoing Process to temporarily stop.

roles.Actor: An entity which participates in a Cause, perhaps volitionally and perhaps not, but effectively causing the interruption.
roles.Cause: A force, process, or event that produces the interruption.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: How often the interruption occurs.
roles.Manner: Any holistic description of the event, including overall depictions (the same way) and descriptions pertaining to the Actor or Cause's influence on the characte
roles.Means: An action or sub-event through which the Actor or Cause interrupts the Process.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the interruption takes place.
roles.Process: The Process goes into a paused state due to the Cause or Actor.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the interruption occurs.

Intoxicants.def: An Intoxicant is ingested in order to achieve an altered state of consciousness.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Intoxicant: The Intoxicant is ingested. ' We smoke marijuana every day.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Intoxication.def: This frame concerns people being in an altered mental state that is induced by an Intoxicant.

roles.Cognizer: The mental state of the Cognizer is changed by an Intoxicant .
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the intoxication holds.
roles.Intoxicant: The Intoxicant alters the Cognizer's mental experience.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Cognizer is intoxicated.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The Time when the Cognizer becomes intoxicated.

Invading.def: The Invader enters a Land in an aggressive attempt to cripple or dominate its people and its government.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: For how long the Land is invaded by the Invader.
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Invader is responding to that leads them to make an assault on the Land.
roles.Frequency: How often the Invader invades the Land.
roles.Invader: The army or other self-directed entity that is entering the Land in a hostile manner.
roles.Land: The political area that is being crippled by the Invader's entry.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Invader that accomplishes the assault.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the location where the Invader invades the Land.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Invader attacks the Land.
roles.Result: The Result of the invasion on the Land by the Invader.
roles.Source: The starting-point of the motion of the Invader or projectiles of the Invader as they move toward the the Place that the Land is occupying in the attack.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Invader invades Land.

Irregular_combatants.def: A Combatant is declared or loyal to a Side in a military Conflict.

roles.Combatant: The Combatant is the human being involved in combat.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: The desired result of the outcome of the hostile encounter for Side_1.

Isolated_places.def: A Place is located far off from centers of population, culture, and/or trade.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The town or area that is in a remote location.

Judgment.def: A Cognizer makes a judgment about an Evaluee.

roles.Cognizer: The Cognizer makes the judgment. This role is typically expressed as the External Argument (or in a by-PP in passives). 'The boss appreciates you for your dilig
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: Evaluee is the person or thing about whom/which a judgment is made.
roles.Expressor: Expressor is the body part or action by a body part that conveys the judgment made by the Cognizer.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner of judging.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Cognizer judges the Evaluee.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Reason: Typically, there is a constituent expressing the Reason for the Judge's judgment.
roles.Result: The Result of the judgement event.
roles.Role: Role is used for the capacity in which the Evaluee is judged, and is expressed in as-PPs.

Judgment_communication.def: A Communicator communicates a judgment of an Evaluee to an Addressee.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee hears the judgement from the Communicator.
roles.Communicator: The Communicator uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey his or her evaluation of the Evaluee to another person.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: A judgment is made about the Evaluee With verbs this FE is typically expressed as Object: 'Jon belittled Madie to her colleagues.'
roles.Expressor: Expressor is the body part or action by a body part that conveys the judgment made by the Communicator.
roles.Frequency: This FE describes the frequency with which the specified communication occurs
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the judgmental communication occurs.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which a judgmental communication is accomplished.
roles.Medium: Medium identifies the physical or abstract setting in which the evaluation is conveyed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the communication of the judgment takes place.
roles.Reason: Typically, there is a constituent expressing the Reason for the Communicator's judgment.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of an event.
roles.Role: Role is used for the capacity in which the Evaluee is judged, and is expressed in as-PPs.
roles.Time: When the communication of the judgment takes place.
roles.Topic: Topic identifies the entity to which the proposition or propositions conveyed relate.

Judgment_direct_address.def: In this frame, a Communicator judges the Addressee and then communicates that appraisal directly to the Addressee.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee is jduged by the Communicator and receives the message of approval or disapproval.
roles.Communicator: The Communicator communicates a judgment to the Addressee.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Expressor: An action or entity under the control of the Communicator that expresses the criticism or praise directed towards the Addressee.
roles.Manner: The Manner is the way in which the judgment is communicated.
roles.Means: The Means is the method employed to communicate the judgment.
roles.Medium: The Medium identifies the physical or abstract entity in which the judgment is conveyed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Communicator admonishes the Addressee.
roles.Reason: The Reason is why the Communicator forms the type of judgment they form.
roles.Role: The laudable or reprimandable status held by the Addressee.
roles.Time: The point in time at which the Communicator berates or compliments the Addressee.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the subject on which the Addressee is being judged.

Judgment_of_intensity.def: A speaker characterizes the intensity of an Attribute of an Entity by a Degree.

roles.Attribute: The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Value for the Attribute.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: A modifier expressing the deviation of the intensity of the Attribute from the norm or from the value for another Entity.
roles.Entity: The Entity for which a particular gradable Attribute is appropriate and under consideration.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Entity is has the Attribute to a given Degree.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular Value for the Attribute.

Judicial_body.def: A Source_of_authority, typically a government, relies upon a set of institutions specialized for the administration of justice.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Domain: The concern of the Judicial_body-- broadly speaking, the aspect of society that they affect.
roles.Judicial_body: A permanent organization with the socially important purpose of administering justice.
roles.Jurisdiction: The geographical area within which the Judicial_body has authority and responsibility.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the Judicial_body is located.
roles.Task: The responsibility that a Judicial_body has, either defined in terms of the type of cases that they can hear, or more specifically by reference to an action tha

Jury_deliberation.def: The Jury discuss the Case and its Charges in order to evaluate the Possible_sentence of the accused.

roles.Case: The Case which a trial is convened to decide.
roles.Charges: The legal label for the crime that the defendant is accused of.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the deliberation is ongoing.
roles.Jury: The group that debates the case.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the deliberation takes place. 'The jury deliberated for several hours in the Oakland courthouse.'
roles.Possible_sentence: A sentence that the jury considers during deliberation.
roles.Time: When the deliberation takes place. 'The jury deliberated for three hours last Tuesday..'

Just_found_out.def: An Experiencer, Expressor, or State can be described as having a surprised emotion as evoked by a Stimulus or concerning a Topic.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.
roles.Expressor: The body part, gesture, or other expression of the Experiencer that reflects his or her emotional state.
roles.Manner: Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, lo
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State: The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
roles.Stimulus: The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
roles.Time: The Time when the Experiencer, Expressor, or State can be described as having said emotion.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the general area in which the emotion occurs.

Justifying.def: An Agent has done or omitted to do an Act or is responsible for the obtaining of a State_of_affairs, which a Judge deems to constitute a violation of an obligation or a moral guideline.

roles.Act: An action for which the Agent is held responsible, frequently one that the Agent has taken themself.
roles.Agent: The person or organization that is held responsible for a prior Act or for a State_of_affairs.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The set of facts or circumstances that the Agent offers in explanation of their earlier Act or of the State_of_affairs 'Mr De Klerk justified his decision on th
roles.Frequency: This FE denotes the number of times the Act or State_of_affairs are justified.
roles.Means: An intentional action, typically an act of speaking, which the Agent performs in order to justify an Act or State_of_affairs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State_of_affairs: A State_of_affairs that the Agent is held responsible for.
roles.Time: The Time of the justifying event.

Key.def: This frame is for objects, physical or otherwise, which are used to grant access to some location or function.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Function: The function that the Key grants access to.
roles.Key: This FE identifies the object that is designed to grant access to a location or function.
roles.Location: The location that the Key grants access to.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Object: The artifact that the key operates on. 'My car keys are locked inside.'

Kidnapping.def: The words in this frame describe situations in which a Perpetrator carries off and holds the Victim against his or her will by force.

roles.Co-participant: An additional abductee taken along with the Victim.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period of time for which the Victim is held by the Perpetrator 'Two young man abducted her for about two hours'
roles.Explanation: The Explanation expresses why the Perpetrator commits the kidnapping.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that the Victim is kidnapped.
roles.Goal: Goal is the place in which the Victim ends up.
roles.Manner: Manner in which the kidnapping takes place.
roles.Means: An act performed by the Perpetrator that helps them accomplish the kidnapping.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Perpetrator: The Perpetrator is the person (or other agent) who carries off and holds the Victim against his or her will.
roles.Place: Where the kidnapping takes place.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose is what the Perpetrator hopes to accomplish by kidnapping.
roles.Source: Source is the initial location of the Victim before it changes location.
roles.Time: When the kidnapping occurs.
roles.Victim: The Victim is the person who is carried off and held against his/her will.

Killing.def: A Killer or Cause causes the death of the Victim.

roles.Beneficiary: This extra-thematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate.
roles.Cause: An inanimate entity or process that causes the death of the Victim.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The preexisting state of affairs that the Killer is responding to.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Instrument: The device used by the Killer to bring about the death of the Victim.
roles.Killer: The person or sentient entity that causes the death of the Victim.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descrip
roles.Means: The method or action that the Killer or Cause performs resulting in the death of the Victim.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the death took place. 'Apparently there were two murders in Atherton in one week.'
roles.Purpose: The state of affairs that the Killer is trying to bring about by killing.
roles.Result: The state of the Victim that results from being killed.
roles.Time: The point or period of time within which the Victim is killed.
roles.Victim: The living entity that dies as a result of the killing.

Kinship.def: This frame contains words that denote Kinship relations.

roles.Alter: The person who fills the role named by the Kinship term with respect to the Ego.'John is my cousin.''I met his brother last year.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Ego: The person from whose perspective the Kinship relationship is defined.'Bill is Sue's son.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Relatives: The combination of Alter and Ego together.'John and I are brothers.'

Knot_creation.def: An Agent creates a Knot (possibly in a Place and/or with an Instrument).'Loretta ties the most beautiful bowline I've ever seen.''If you can tie a half-hitch around the table leg with only that much string...'

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person performing the intentional act.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which a Knot is produced..
roles.Knot: The stable configuration of a String which results from tying.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act performed by the Agent by which the creation of the Knot is accomplished.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Labeling.def: A Speaker uses as a Label to refer to an Entity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The concrete or abstract thing with which the Speaker has associated a particular linguistic sign.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Label: The linguistic sign that the Speaker uses to designate the Entity.
roles.Medium: A text whose author applies a particular Label to an Entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A physical space whose occupants use the Label to refer to the Entity.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker is the person who conventionally uses a linguistic sign to refer to an Entity.
roles.Time: A time period in which a Speaker uses the Label.

Labor_product.def: An Agent or a Cause mentally or physically expends energy rendering an Input, whether implicit or explicit, into a Output.

roles.Agent: A sentient entity whose physical and mental faculties are directly expended on the Input to create the Output.
roles.Beneficiary: The entity for whom the Output is created.
roles.Cause: A non-sentient entity whose physical faculties are directly expended on the Input to create the Output.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Input: The mental or physical faculties onto which the Agent or Cause expends energy.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Output: The end product, either a concept or physical object onto which the Agent or Cause has exerted its mental or physical faculties from the rudimentary state of In
roles.Place: The place where the Output was birthed.
roles.Time: The time at which the Output was committed into reality.

Launch_process.def: An Agent acts to begin the life of a Process.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the actor responsible for starting the Process.
roles.Beneficiary: The party for who's benefit the Process is launched.
roles.Circumstances: The state of the world at the time when the Agent produces the Process.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The reason why or the way in which the Agent initiates the Process.
roles.Frequency: How often the Process is launched.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Agent initiates the Process.
roles.Means: The Means is the way in which the Agent initiates the Process.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Process is initiated.
roles.Process: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate the process that the Agent initiates.
roles.Purpose: To what end the Agent initiates the Process.
roles.Time: This FE is for the Time when the Agent initiates the Process.

Law.def: A Law regulates activities or states of affairs within a Jurisdiction, dictating what Required states should be the case and what Forbidden states should not.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Forbidden: The state-of-affairs which is disallowed by the Law.
roles.Law: This FE identifies the rule designed to guide activity, deprecating some types of activity and/or requiring other types of activity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Required: A state-of-affairs which the Law declares must be maintained.

Law_enforcement_agency.def: A law enforcement Agency is tasked by a government with guaranteeing compliance with the laws in a particular Jurisdiction.

roles.Agency: The Agency is a part of the government dedicated to enforcing the laws of the government's jurisdiction.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Jurisdiction: The Agency is charged with enforcing the laws of and within a particular Jurisdiction.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE describes the general location where the Agency operates, but does not indicate the jurisdiction of the Agency.
roles.Purpose: The reason for which the Agency is formed or the purpose to which it is dedicated.

Leadership.def: These are words referring to control by a Leader over a particular entity or group (the Governed) or an Activity.

roles.Activity: The Leader directs the Activity. 'The captain's cousin led the mutiny.' 'John Cage is one of the leaders of the minimalist music movement.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Leadership by any particular individual is frequently limited in time, which is noted here as Duration.
roles.Governed: The entity whose actions or beliefs the Leader directs in the context of a joint activity or movement.
roles.Leader: The Leader is the one who has the role of leading.
roles.Manner: Manner refers to the style/way in which the leadership is asserted.
roles.Means: Means identifies act(s) performed by the Leader through which leadership is maintained.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The locale from which the Leader leads the Governed or the Activity.
roles.Role: The role played by the Leader in a given situation, often an official title; incorporated in most noun LUsin this frame.
roles.Time: Time refers to the point in time that the leadership took place.

Leaving_traces.def: A piece of Evidence indicates that an Event occured, or metonymically, Entity had formerly existed, in a Location.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The thing whose former existence in a Location can be deduced from the Evidence.
roles.Event: An event whose details are revealed through the discovery of Evidence.
roles.Evidence: The thing that indicates an Entity was in a Location.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: A description of the time that an Event occurs or an Entity exists at a place.

Left_to_do.def: A Process of using or modifying is scheduled to be applied to a group or mass.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Process: The activity that is being applied to the mass or the set of entities.
roles.Remainder: The mass or group that has not yet been processed.
roles.Time: The time when the Remainder is assessed. 'Now only three more items remain to be sold'

Legal_rulings.def: An Authority with the power to make decisions hands down a Finding over a question presented in a formal or informal Case.

roles.Authority: The Authority (which may be the jury, judge, magistrate or court) decides on the Finding.
roles.Case: This FE describes the question on which the Authority gives a Finding.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the ruling was reached.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Defendant: The person about whom the Authority passes a judgment or Finding.
roles.Duration: The amount of time that a Finding holds.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for the Finding.
roles.Finding: This FE identifies the outcome of the Authority's deliberation or consideration.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Authority acts.
roles.Means: This FE identifies an action that the Authority performs in order to return the verdict.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the Finding takes place.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose why the Authority returns a particular Finding.
roles.Time: When the Authority gives his Finding.

Legality.def: Words in this frame describe the status of an Action with respect to a Code of laws or rules.

roles.Action: The Action is the behavior which complies with or violates the Code.' Illegal drug use is on the rise.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Object: The Object complies with or violates the Code by virtue of its existence, location or possession.

Lending.def: The Lender gives the Theme to the Borrower with the expectation that the Borrower will return the Theme to the Lender after a Duration of time.

roles.Borrower: The person or institution who receives the Theme from the Lender for a Duration.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amout of time in which the Borrower has possession of the Theme.
roles.Lender: The person or institution who gives the Theme to the Borrower for a Duration.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Lender lends the Theme.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Lender lends the Theme to the Borrower.
roles.Purpose: The aim of the Lender which they believe will be accomplished by lending the Theme to the Borrower.
roles.Theme: The object that is transferred from the Lender to the Borrower for a Duration.
roles.Time: The time when the lending event occurs. 'I lent him my car on Friday.'

Level_of_force_exertion.def: An Exerter, Action, or Force is capable of exerting or does exert a physical force at a level specified by the target.

roles.Action: The Action that can or does exert a force of the level specified by the target.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the Exerter, Action, or Force can or does exert a force.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Exerter: The Exerter that can or does exert a force of the level specified by the target.
roles.Force: The Force that can or does exert a force of the level specified by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Exerter, Action, or Force can or does exert its force.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Exerter, Action, or Force can or does exert its force.

Level_of_force_resistance.def: A Resisting_entity is capable of resisting or does resist a physical Opposing_force to a level specified by the target.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the Resisting_entity resists an external force.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Opposing_force: The Opposing_force is the item placed in opposition to the Resisting_entity.
roles.Place: The location where the Resisting_entity resists an external force.
roles.Resisting_entity: The Resisting_entity is the item that resists the Opposing_force to the level specified by the target.
roles.Time: The Time when the Resisting_entity resists an external force.

Level_of_light.def: There is a gradable amount of light in a particular Location.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Location: The place whose amout of light is being described.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Source: The entity from which the light eminates.

Light_movement.def: An Emitter emits a Beam of light from a Source, along a Path, and/or towards a Goal.

roles.Beam: The light that travels from a Source along a Path to a Goal.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Emitter: This FE identifies the entity at the Source from which the Beam originates.
roles.Goal: Goal is the location the Beam ends up in.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: Path refers to where the Beam travels over or to a landmark the Beam travels by.
roles.Result: Result of an event
roles.Source: The Source is the location the Beam occupies initially before its change of location.

Likelihood.def: This frame is concerned with the likelihood of a Hypothetical_event occurring.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the Hypothetical_event is likely.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE expresses a reason the speaker has for making judgment about the likelihood of an event.
roles.Hypothetical_event: The state of affairs or occurrence whose likelihood is assessed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place. 'There is a high chance of rain in Seattle.'
roles.Time: When the event occurs. 'There is a high chance of rain today.'

Limitation.def: An Entity that would be expected to have a characteristic to a certain degree (typically based on comparison to other entities of the same type) instead has a more limited degree of that characteristic.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity would normally be expected to have a set of possibilites, but instead exhibits only certain possibilites, or exhibits them on fewer situations than e
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Limiting.def: An Agent or Cause limits a Range_of_options to having a certain Characteristic.

roles.Agent: The Agent consciously places limits upon the Range_of_options.
roles.Cause: The Cause is a natural occurrence or state-of-affairs that limits the Range_of_options.
roles.Characteristic: The Characteristic indicates the subtypes or situations to which the Range_of_options is limited.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time over which the Range_of_options is limited.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Agent of Cause limits the Range_of_options.
roles.Means: An act performed by the Agent or Cause that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Agent or Cause limits the Range_of_options.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Agent or Cause limits the Range_of_options.
roles.Range_of_options: The Range_of_options would normally be expected to have a set of possibilites, but is limited by an Agent or Cause to particular subtypes, situations or charact
roles.Time: The time at which the limiting takes place.

Linguistic_meaning.def: A linguistic Form has a particular Meaning, possibly restricted to a particular Context.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Form: Form is the formal pole of a linguistic sign.
roles.Meaning: Meaning is the sense of a linguistic Form.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Referent: Referent identifies an object in the real (or a hypothetical) world that a linguistic expression is used to talk about.

Lively_place.def: A Location is characterized by a high amount of (often goal-oriented) Activity, or metonymically, with Individuals who are engaged in the activity.

roles.Activity: The Activity that is conceptually filling the Location.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the circumstances under which the Location has some degree of activity or liveliness.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Individuals: The Individuals are engaged in the Activity, creating a lively Location.
roles.Location: The Location where a lot of activity is taking place, or prototypically takes place.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Individuals or Location is engaging in the Activity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The larger or general area where the Location is lively.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Location is characterized by a lot of activity.

Living_conditions.def: An Experiencer must cope with some Condition for a prolonged period, usually against his or her will.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Experiencer must cope with the Condition.
roles.Experiencer: A person who experiences the effects of some situation or Condition for a long period of time.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the Experiencer is located when he or she faces the Condition.
roles.Time: A general description of the temporal location of the Experiencer while coping with the Condition.

Locale.def: This frame contains general locale words, and is mostly a place-holder in the hierarchy.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Locale: A stable bounded area. It is typically the designation of the nouns of Locale-derived frames. 'There used to be a forest in that area.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Locale_by_characteristic_entity.def: A Locale is characterized by the type of entity associated with the Locale.

roles.Characteristic: A property or characteristic of the entities in the Locale.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Locale: A stable bounded area characterized by properties of the entities who are typically located there (e.g., work and/or live there).
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Locale_by_collocation.def: A Profiled_region is identified as being the region where an Entity is located.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The entity is located at the Profiled_region.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Profiled_region: The region where the Entity is located. 'If you sign up for this new service, we can get a fix on your phone's location if you lose it or it is stolen.'
roles.Time: The Time at which the Entity is at the Profiled_region.

Locale_by_event.def: A place defined in terms of an event which occurred (or will occur) there.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Defining_event: The event for which the locale is known or is named 'The driver died at the scene of the accident.'
roles.Locale: A stable bounded area. It is typically the denotation of the nouns in Locale_by_event, which will be annotated on the target word. 'We need to find a suitable v
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Locale_by_ownership.def: A place defined by an Owner. 'Get off my property!'

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Locale: A stable bounded area. It is typically the designation of the nouns of Locale-derived frames.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Owner: The individual or group of individuals who hold posses the Locale.

Locale_by_use.def: Geography as defined by its use. 'You must land in the next airfield, as this one is currently having difficulties.' 'The new sports complex was the tallest building on campus, oddly enough.' 'Cities of the Northeast tend to be dingier.'

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent Locale itself and any of its participants.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Locale: A stable bounded area. It is typically the designation of the nouns of Locale-derived frames. 'There used to be a carnival every summer in that city.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Use: The activity that is carried out in the Locale.

Locale_closure.def: A building or location that can be sealed to prevent entrance, the Locale, ceases to be open for use.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances that caused closure. Compared to Explanation, this describes situations or environments that lead to failure, not a specific reason for failur
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Locale remains closed.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for the closure, if any. 'The oldpost office closed so they could build a new one.'
roles.Locale: The Locale is the entity that ceases to be available for use.
roles.Manner: The Manner describes the way in which the Locale closed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place of the failing locale. 'Every park closed in New York City last week for the fireworks.'
roles.Time: The Time of the closure. 'The fire department closed in 2008 after the city ceased to be incorporated.'

Locating.def: A Perceiver determines the Location of a Sought_entity within a Ground.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Ground: The general set of entities that the Perceiver examined in order to find the Sought_entity.
roles.Location: The position of the Sought_entity. 'I found him under the bed.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Perceiver: The individual that determines the Location of the Sought_entity.
roles.Sought_entity: The entity that the Perceiver succeeds in finding.
roles.Time: The time when the Sought_entity is located.

Location_in_time.def: The word(s) in this frame detail a particular moment in time.These often occur with demonstratives such as this and that.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Focal_time: The particular, salient point in time. If a specified time is present, it is the focal time. Otherwise, the unit is the focal time. If there is an appositive th
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Location_of_light.def: A perceptible Figure shows up against a Ground location due to Light shining on/from it, its salience possibly dependent on a Cause_of_shine.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period for which the Figure shows up against the Ground due to Light falling on it.
roles.Figure: The percept which is perceived at a certain Ground location.
roles.Ground: The location of the phenomenon.'Hot coals glowed behind the fire grate.'
roles.Light: The Light which is emitted. In this frame, it is usually incorporated in verbs and adjectives, and is the denotation of many of the nouns. 'The fire glowed.' 'T
roles.Manner: Manner of Light emission. 'In the dim light the gold and strong colours glittered and glowed intensely.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The spatial setting in which the Figure shows up against a Ground location.
roles.Result: The Result of the emission of the Light .
roles.Time: The Time when the Figure is observed against the Ground location due to Light shining on it.

Location_of_object.def: Where a specific object is kept or was left.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: Since or when.

Locative_relation.def: A Figure is located relative to a Ground location.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Figure: The Figure is perceived as located relative to a certain Ground location.
roles.Figures: The Figures are items which mutually serve to identify the location of the other items.

Make_compromise.def: Two (or more) people (the Parties, also encodable as Party_1 and Party_2) come to an agreement committing them to carrying out an Obligation.

roles.Means: The Means by which the Agent or Entity become sufficient in regards in to the Standard.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Member_of_military.def: A Person is a member of an organized military organization belonging to a nation-state or similar body.

roles.Time: The Time is when the remembering or forgetting of mental Content occurs.
