Mental_stimulus_exp_focus.def: An Experiencer has an emotion as caused by a Stimulus or concerning a Topic.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration is the amount of time for which the Experiencer is affected by the Stimulus, Topic, or State.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.
roles.Expressor: The body part, gesture, or other expression of the Experiencer that reflects his or her emotional state.
roles.Manner: Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, lo

roles.State: The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
roles.Stimulus: The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.

Mental_stimulus_stimulus_focus.def: A Stimulus serves to bring about an emotion of mental stimulation in an Experiencer.

roles.Stimulus: The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
roles.Time: The Time when the Experiencer can be described as having said emotion.

Mention.def: A Communicator or Medium briefly references something in a Message, in which only a subpart of the full content is profiled.

roles.Initial_element: The type of Element that begins the process.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Change event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the nuclear process occurs.
roles.Time: The time at which the Element undergoes the transformation.

Objective_influence.def: An Influencing_entity, an Influencing_situation, or an Influencing_variable has an influence on a Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or a Dependent_variable.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: The Degree to which the Influencing_entity effects the Dependent_entity.
roles.Dependent_entity: An entity, usually a thing, that is influenced in its behavior by an Influencing_entity or an Influencing_situation.
roles.Dependent_situation: A situation that whose temporal or other characteristics are influenced by an Influencing_entity, Influencing_situation, or Influencing_variable.
roles.Dependent_variable: A scalar variable, whose value depends on the behavior of an Influencing_entity, a Influencing_situation, or an Influencing_variable.
roles.Influencing_entity: A thing or person whose behavior has an effect on an Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or Dependent_variable.
roles.Influencing_situation: A situation whose temporal or other characteristics have an effect on a Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or Dependent_variable.
roles.Influencing_variable: A scalar variable (with unspecified value) which has an effect on the Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or Dependent_variable.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descrip
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the influencing occurs.
roles.Time: The Time at which the influence occurs.

Obscurity.def: An Entity is obscure, unnotable, and in general little-known.

roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity is considered not to be famous.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time during which the Entity is not famous.
roles.Entity: The Entity which is not widely known and rather obscure.
roles.Explanation: The reason that the Entity is not famous.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Entity is not famous.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Entity is not well known.

Obviousness.def: A Phenomenon is portrayed with respect to the Degree of likelihood that it will be perceived and known, given the (usually implicit) Evidence, Perceiver, and the Circumstances in which it is considered.

roles.Attribute: The gradable aspect of a Phenomenon which concerns how likely it is that the Phenomenon be known.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the conditions under which the Phenomenon is likely to be known.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: A modifier expressing the deviation of the Phenomenon from the norm or from the value for another Phenomenon in terms of how likely the Phenomenon would be know
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomenon: The entity or facts that are undeniable given the Evidence.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Phenomenon is obvious 'It is obvious now that Senator O.

Occupy_rank.def: This frame is about Items in the state of occupying a certain Rank within a hierarchy.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dimension: The dimension along which the ranking is defined.
roles.Item: The Item which occupies the Rank in the hierarchy.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Rank: The Rank which the Item occupies.
roles.Time: The time at which/period over which the Item occupies the Rank 'Jim ranked as thirty-second degree Mason in 1970.'

Offenses.def: Words in this frame describe acts in violation of a legal code.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Offense: The illegal act. 'He was charged with assault.'
roles.Perpetrator: The individual who commits the Offense
roles.Victim: This FE denotes the person or entity that is badly affected by the Offense.

Offering.def: An Offerer indicates that he or she is able and willing to give a Theme to a Potential_recipient.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are the conditions under which the Theme is offered.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
roles.Manner: The Manner is the manner in which the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Offerer: The person that begins in possession of the Theme and offers it to the Potential_recipient .
roles.Place: The Place where the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
roles.Potential_recipient: The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
roles.Theme: The object which is offered for transfer.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.

Offshoot.def: This frame refers to a part of an organization that becomes separate from the main body.

roles.Branch: The offshoot or branch of the original body which differs from it in some important respect.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place in which the Branch is locate or where it first forms.
roles.Time: The time at which the Branch forms or thrives.

Omen.def: One phenomenon, the Predictive_phenomenon is an indication of the future or current (but still uncertain) existence of another phenomenon, the Future_phenomenon.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Predictive_phenomenon indicates a particular Future_phenomenon or Outcome.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Predictive_phenomenon is an omen for the Future_phenomenon or the Outcome.
roles.Future_phenomenon: Future_phenomenon is that phenomenon that is predicted to occur or have a particular quality.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Outcome: The FE Outcome identifies those expressions that indicate how the Future_phenomenon is expected to turn out based on the evidence of the Predictive_phenomenon.
roles.Place: The location where something good or bad might occur.
roles.Predictive_phenomenon: Predictive_phenomenon provides evidence for the existence or the nature of the Outcome of Future_phenomenon.
roles.Time: The Time at which the omen is occuring.

Ontogeny.def: An Entity develops from a Prior_state to a Post_state.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Domain: The relevant dimension of development. Usually expressed by an entity-denoting adjective. ' Embryonic development had been stunted by the disease. '
roles.Duration: The period over which the Entity develops.
roles.Entity: The part of the Organism which is undergoing biological development.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the development occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Organism: The living thing whose Entity is undergoing development.
roles.Place: The location where the Entity develops. 'The cells were developing rapidly in the Petri dish.'
roles.Time: The Time when the Entity develops. 'Someday this bud will grow into a rose.'

Openness.def: A Useful_location is accessible to some (possibly generic) Theme despite a potential Barrier, or is not accessible because of the Barrier.

roles.Barrier: An entity that (at least potentially) prevents the Theme from getting to the Useful_location.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Theme: The Theme whose motion is blocked or free.
roles.Time: The time when the Useful_location is or is not accessible.
roles.Useful_location: The place or thing that the Theme is headed towards, despite a potential or actual Barrier.

Operate_vehicle.def: The words in this frame describe motion involving a Vehicle and someone who controls it, the Driver.

roles.Area: This frame element is used for expressions which describe a general area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular and not to co
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Driver: This is the being, typically human, that controls the Vehicle as it moves.
roles.Duration: The length of the time interval during which the Driver operates the Vehicle.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Operate_vehicle event occurs.
roles.Frequency: "How often" the Operate_vehicle event occurs.
roles.Goal: Any expression which tells where the moving object(s) ends up as a result of the motion expresses the frame element Goal.
roles.Manner: Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion expresses the frame element Manner.
roles.Means: The action performed by the Driver by which the Driver achieves directed Transportation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: Any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal expresses the frame element Path.
roles.Place: The Place describes the location of a more specific motion (which has Source, Path or Goal).
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Driver tries to bring about by the way that they direct the Vehicle.
roles.Source: Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source.
roles.Time: The Time when the Driver operates the Vehicle 'Yesterday, Smithers paddled his boat across the lake and back'
roles.Vehicle: This is the means of conveyance controlled by the Driver.

Operating_a_system.def: An Operator manipulates the substructure of a System such that the System performs the function it was created for.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of the time interval in which the Operator runs the System.
roles.Manner: Any description of the running of the System which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Operator runs the System.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Operator: The invididual who manipulates the substructure of the System.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Operator runs the System.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Operator runs the System.
roles.System: The entity that the Operator gets to perform its intended function.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Operator runs the System.

Operational_testing.def: A Tester uses a concrete or conceptual Product in order to determine either whether it works or to find out how well or in which manner it works.

roles.Circumstances: The FE Circumstances is used for circumstances that obtain during the test procedure.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Desired_state_of_affairs: The desirable state of affairs which the Tester hopes to find to obtain when using the Product.
roles.Duration: The length of the time period during which the Tester continuously or repeatedly operates the Product to determine its operational characteristics.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Tester uses the Product in order to evaluate its functioning.
roles.Means: This FE is used for a Means action which the Tester carries out in testing the Product.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the test is carried out.
roles.Product: The entity that the Tester uses to ascertain whether it is intact.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Tester intends to accomplish subjecting the Product to a test of its functioning.
roles.Result: The Result of the Operational_testing.
roles.Tested_property: A variable of behavior of the Product which is specifically evaluated.
roles.Tester: The person who uses the Product to see if it is intact or to ascertain its characteristics during operation.
roles.Time: The Time when the Tester uses the Product to evaluate its functioning.
roles.Unwanted_characteristics: An entity or property whose presence would impair the acceptability or usefulness of the Product.

Opinion.def: Someone states an opinion, like, dislike or judgement about something.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Topic: What it is about.

Opportunity.def: An Agent has a choice of whether or not to participate in some Desirable_event because of an Opportunity, a situation not completely under the Agent's control and usually of a limited duration.

roles.Agent: The sentient agent that may or may not participate in the Desirable_situation.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Desirable_situation: A situation or event that the Agent can participating in during the period of the Opportunity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Opportunity: The situation during which the Desirable_situation is possible.

Optical_image.def: This frame describes non-artifact Images resulting from an interation between light and some kind of matter, usually a Source entity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Image: The optical representation of the Source.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Source: The entity from which the Image's form is based on.

Ordinal_numbers.def: An Item is picked out either by the order in which the members of a set would be encountered by an implicit cognizer, or by the order in which the members of a set participate in an event or state which serves as the Basis_of_order.

roles.Basis_of_order: A kind of event in which the members of the Comparison_set, including the Item, participate in a certain order.
roles.Comparison_set: A set of entites of which the Item is a member and which are ordered either by the Basis_of_order or by the order in which the implicit cognizer focuses attenti
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Item: The entity picked out by the implicit cognizer as occupying a certain place in the ordered Comparison_set.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Starting_point: A usually spatial reference point from which the implicit cognizer scans across the members of the Comparison_set.
roles.Type: The kind of entity that the Item belongs to.

Organization.def: This frame describes intentionally formed human social groups (here termed Organizations) with some definite structure and Members.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Members: A person belonging to an Organization.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Organization: The entity of which the individuals are Members.
roles.Place: This FE describes the general location where the Organization operates, but does not indicate the possessor of the Organization.
roles.Purpose: The reason for which an Organization is formed.

Origin.def: An Entity began its existence in the context of a Origin, which can be a place, culture, time period, text, etc.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The item whose Origin is under discussion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Origin: The place or culture where the Entity was produced.

Others_situation_as_stimulus.def: An Experiencer feels an emotion as evoked as an Other.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Other evokes its response.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the explanation for why the Other evokes a certain emotional response.
roles.Frequency: How often the Other gets sympathy from the Experiencer.
roles.Manner: Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the feelings of the Other which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Other: The Other is the person that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
roles.Situation: The Situation is the circumstances or topic about which the Experiencer feels an emotion.
roles.Time: The Time when the Experiencer feels for the Other.

Out_of_existence.def: An Entity has ceased to exist. 'Theses termites are history.' 'Hillary is toast after Texas and Ohio.' 'They are gone because you killed them all.'

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the length of time before the Entity comes into existence again.
roles.Entity: Concrete or abstract entity that does not exist after the event.
roles.Explanation: This FE labels the Explanation of the destruction or disappearance of the Entity.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Entity disappears.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This is the Place where the Entity (saliently) does not exist.
roles.Role: The aspect of the Entity which no longer exists.
roles.Time: A point at which the Entity (saliently) does not exist.

Pardon.def: An Authority excuses an Offense that an Offender has committed, with the effect of ending or preventing any punishment.

roles.Authority: Authority is the organization or person taht grants the pardon.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: Explanation is the cause for pardoning an Offender.
roles.Manner: Any description of the act of pardon which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Authority that accomplishes the pardon.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Offender: This FE denotes the offender that seeks or gets the pardon.
roles.Offense: This FE denotes the the illegal act that the Offender is pardoned for.
roles.Place: The location at which the pardoning takes place.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Authority intends to accomplish by pardoning 'U.S.
roles.Time: This FE denotes the time when the pardon is given 'The families demanded a posthumous pardon for the executed soldiers.'

Part_edge.def: This describes a part_whole relationship where the Part provides the boundary between the Whole and what is not that object.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part: Part is that which forms a boundary between the Whole and what is not the object.
roles.Whole: An undivided entity having all its Parts.'The show takes place on the western edge of town.'

Part_inner_outer.def: This frame concerns Parts of objects that are defined relative to the center or edge of the object.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part: This element describes the Part of the larger Whole.'She only ate the skin of the apple.'
roles.Whole: An undivided entity having all its Parts.'She eats only the thick skin of the banana.'

Part_ordered_segments.def: In this frame a Part is part of a larger Whole comprised of parts that are ordered.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Ordinality: This is the number of the sequence of Parts.' I sat through the first interminable act of the play .
roles.Part: A part of a larger Whole. ' I sat through the first interminable act of the play . '
roles.Whole: An undivided entity having all its Parts.

Part_orientational.def: In this frame, there is a Part of a Whole in which the Part is defined with respect to the canonical or inherent orientation of the Whole.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part: A piece of a larger Whole.'The top shelf of the bookcase was lying on the floor.'
roles.Whole: An undivided entity having all its Parts.'The show takes place in the West wing of the White House.'

Part_piece.def: This frame is concerned with transparent nouns denoting a Piece of a Substance.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Piece: A Piece made of a substance.'Sergey had a few morsels of bread for breakfast.' The specific whole entity from which the Piece comes is not specified.
roles.Substance: The Substance is what the Piece is made of and may describe the type of larger whole from which it came.'Sue ate a big piece of cake.'

Part_whole.def: This frame is concerned with nouns denoting a part or parts of a Whole entity .

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part: A Part of a larger Whole.'Sergey had half of the pizza for breakfast.'
roles.Whole: An undivided entity having all its Parts.

Partiality.def: This frame has to do with the bias or lack of bias of a Judge making an assessment concerning two or more Sides.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Decision_maker: This Frame Element marks the person whose objectivity in making assesment is being evaluated.
roles.Dispute: The Dispute is the situation in which there is some conflict between two sides.
roles.Explanation: The reason for the partiality.
roles.Expressor: The Expressor is the body part or action by a body part which indicates the character of the Decision_maker.
roles.Judge: The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.
roles.Manifestation_of_bias: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate how the bias of the Judge expresses itself in their behavior or actions.'The judge made a biased decision.''T
roles.Manner: The Manner is the way in which the Decision_maker embodies the bias associated with him or her.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Side_1: This Frame Element marks one of the Sides in a dispute or one of the alternatives in a situation of choice.'The umpire was partial to the home team.'
roles.Side_2: The second-mentioned of the Sides to a dispute or alternatives in a situation of choice.'The judge favored the defendant over the plaintiff.'
roles.Sides: This Frame Element marks phrases jointly expressing both Sides in a dispute or all of the alternatives in a situation of choice.'The judge was neutral between t
roles.Time: This FE denotes the time when the partiality occurs.

Participation.def: An Event with multiple Participants takes place.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE describes the length of time for which participation occurs (usually appears as a for-PP)
roles.Event: An Event with multiple Participants, who may or may not be involved intentionally.
roles.Institution: A group, location, or institution conventionally associated with an Event.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), second
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by Participant_1 or the Participants that contributes to bringing off the Event.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Participant_1: Participant_1 is the grammatically more prominent participant in an Event with multiple Participants.
roles.Participant_2: A grammatically less prominent participant of an Event with multiple Participants.
roles.Participants: The individuals or entities that have been participants in an Event.
roles.Place: The location where the Event involving multiple Participants occurs.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Participants or Participant_1 intend to accomplish by performing the action indicated by the Event.
roles.Time: The Time when the multiple-participant Event occurs.

Partitive.def: A Subset is profiled against the Group it belongs to.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Group: The Group of entities which includes the Subset.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Subset: A Subset belonging to the Group.

Passing.def: An Agent physically transfers a Theme to a Recipient.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the one who passes the Theme.
roles.Area: The FE Area is used for expressions which describe a general area in which passing takes place when the passing is understood to be irregular or not to consist
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE denotes a proposition from which the main clause logically follows.
roles.Initial_state: A previous state that the Theme was in before the beginning of its motion.
roles.Instrument: An entity saliently involved in the transmission of force from an Agent to a Theme.
roles.Manner: The FE Manner is any expression which describes a property of the motion of the Theme which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion.
roles.Means: The FE Means indicates the action that is taken that results in the motion of the Theme
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: The FE Path is any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor Goal.
roles.Place: The Place is the general area that provides a setting for a specific motion (with Source, Path, or Goal).
roles.Recipient: The FE Recipient is the entity which possesses the Theme as a result of the passing.
roles.Result: A resultant state that the Theme is in at the end of its motion.
roles.Source: The FE Source is the starting point of the passing action 'Pat passed the ball from behind the defensemen.'
roles.Theme: The FE Theme is generally an NP Object that is passed to the Recipient.
roles.Time: The time at which the passing of the Theme occurs.

Passing_off.def: An Agent acts in such a way as to cause others to think that an Item is an instance of a particular kind of Simulated_entity.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person who acts in a misleading way to create the impression that the Item is a particular (kind of) Simulated_entity.
roles.Audience: The Audience denotes the people that the Agent intends to mislead into thinking that the Item is a particular (kind of) Simulated_entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the passing-off event logically follows.
roles.Item: The Item is the concrete or abstract entity that the Agent misleadingly represents as a particular (kind of) Entity.
roles.Manner: Any description of the passing off event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient c
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent that contributes to the Item being perceived as a (particular kind of) Simulated_entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the location that is the setting for the passing off event.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by passing the Item off as a (particular kind of) Simulated_entity.
roles.Simulated_entity: The Simulated_entity is a particular individual or a token of a particular type that the Item is represented as.
roles.Time: The time at which the Agent gives the impression that the Item is the Simulated_entity.

Path_shape.def: The words in this frame describe the "fictive" motion of a stationary Road.

roles.Area: This frame element is used for expressions which describe a general area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular and not to co
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").

Path_traveled.def: A Path, a series of connected locations, is traversed by a Theme, moving under its own power or under the influence of a physical force.

roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: The series of interconnected locations that the Theme traverses.
roles.Source: The Source is one of the Endpoints treated as a source.
roles.Theme: The moving object whose motion describes the Path.

Patrolling.def: An individual or group, the Patrol moves through and examines a Ground in order to ensure that it is in a generally Desired_state_of_affairs, particularly that it is safe and contains no dangerous Unwanted_entity.

roles.Circumstances: The circumstances under which the Patrol examines the Ground.
roles.Co-participant: The Co-participant patrols along with the Patrol.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Desired_state_of_affairs: The desirable state of affairs which the Patrol hopes to ensure by visiting Ground.
roles.Duration: The length of time of the patrol. 'We've been patrolling for hours and haven't even seen anyone.'
roles.Ground: The area that the Patrol inspects with to ensure its safety.
roles.Instrument: An entity used by the Patrol to scrutinize the Ground.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Patrol inspects the Ground.
roles.Means: This FE is used for the Means by which the Patrol examines the Ground.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patrol: The person (or group) who inspects the Ground to see that it is safe.
roles.Purpose: The desired outcome of the patrolling. Normally this constituent is a PP Complement headed by for, or a to-marked VP Complement. 'Patrol all unlit areas to ensu
roles.Time: >The Time when the Patrol examines the Ground.
roles.Unwanted_entity: An entity whose presence would impair the desirability or safety of the Ground.

Pattern.def: This frame describes the interrelation of a collection of Entities; they may be physical entities or shapes in a recognizable configuration, a pattern of events, or a relation among abstract entities.

roles.Entities: The entities whose interrelations form the pattern.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Perception_active.def: This frame contains perception words whose perceivers intentionally direct their attention to some entity or phenomenon in order to have a perceptual experience.

roles.Body_part: Body_part identifies the part of the body used as a sensory organ of the Perceiver_agentive, typically expressed in a with-PP.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Direction: Direction is used for all path-like expressions that describe how the perceiver's attention is directed during the act of perception, with the exception of thos
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Perception takes place.
roles.Manner: Manner expressions may be of lexicographic interest if they describe properties of active perception as such: closely, carefully, etc.
roles.Means: The Means indicates the tool or method the Perceiver_agentive is using to actively perceive the Phenomenon.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Perceiver_agentive: The Perceiver_agentive performs some action in order to have a perceptual experience.
roles.Phenomenon: Phenomenon indicates the entity or phenomenon to which the Perceiver_agentive directs his or her attention in order to have a perceptual experience.
roles.Place: The general location within which the act of perception takes place.
roles.Purpose: Some action that the Perceiver_agentive is trying to accomplish by directing their own attention.
roles.Time: When the activity of attempting to perceive occurs.

Perception_body.def: This frame contains words describing physical experiences that can affect virtually any part of the body.

roles.Body_part: This FE is the location on the body where the physical experience takes place, typically expressed as External Argument, often as PP complement: My legs are a l
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the being who has a physical experience on some part of his or her body, or internally.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation describes the cause of the perception the body is experiencing.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Perception_experience.def: This frame contains perception words whose Perceivers have perceptual experiences that they do not necessarily intend to.

roles.Body_part: The Body_part is the location on the Perceiver_passive's body where the perceptual experience takes place.
roles.Circumstances: A situation which pertains during the event.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Frequency: An expression of how often the event occurs.
roles.Manner: Manner expressions may be of lexicographic interest if they describe properties of perception as such: clearly, loudly, etc.
roles.Means: The action whereby the Perceiver perceives.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Perceiver_passive: This FE is the being who has a perceptual experience, not necessarily on purpose.
roles.Phenomenon: This FE is the entity or phenomenon that the perceiver experiences with his or her senses.
roles.Place: The general location within which the act of perception takes place.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Perceiver_passive or the Body_part perceives the Phenomenon.

Performers.def: This frame contains words for Individuals as viewed in terms of their participation in artistic performances.

Performers_and_roles.def: A Performer has a certain Role in a Performance and plays their part by following the directions in the Script for that particular Role.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: How long the Performer is in the Performance.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing.
roles.Medium: Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Performer to transmit the Performance to the Audience.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Performance: The Performers generates the Performance which the Audience perceives.
roles.Performer: The Performer provides an experience for the Audience.
roles.Performer1: The person that performs alongside Performer2.
roles.Performer2: The person that is also in the Performance, alongside Performer1.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place an event occurs.
roles.Role: Role identifies one of the possible relations that the Performer can have to the Performance.
roles.Score: The music which may be performed in the Performance, either in isolation or accompanying actions and speech.
roles.Script: The (usually written) directions which instruct the Performers on what actions to perform, when, and how.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when an event occurs.
roles.Type: This FE indicates the subtype of Performance, including dance, theater, film, etc.

Performing_arts.def: The Performers, together with behind the scenes Personnel, execute a Performance according to a Script and/or Score.

Personal_relationship.def: The words in this frame have to do with people and the personal Relationships they are or can be a part of.

roles.Partner_2: That partner in the Relationship who is not expressed as the external argument.
roles.Partners: The joint construal of both Partners in the Relationship.

Personal_success.def: A Person is in a state of prosperity and/or renown after some period of development or hardship in an Endeavor.

roles.Explanation: An explanation of why the Person or Endeavor achieves its goal of prosperity or renown.

Physical_artworks.def: A physical object, the Artifact, is produced by a Creator to stimulate the perceptions, emotions, or cognition of an audience.

Piracy.def: The words in this frame describe situations in which a Perpetrator forcibly seizes control over a Victim's Vehicle to gain some end.

roles.Goal: This is the place to which the vehicle is directed.

roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act performed by the Perpetrator by which the seizure of the Vehicle is accomplished.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

roles.Vehicle: This is the means of transportation which gets under the control of the perpetrator.
roles.Victim: This FE describes the people that are suffering as a result of the Perpetrator's action.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person (or other force) that causes the Theme to move.
roles.Beneficiary: This extrathematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate.
roles.Cause: 'Grass , which is sown with clover , provides rich pasture for cattle in summer and the clover is another plant which puts nitrogen into the soil .'

roles.Explanation: The Explanation indicates why the Placing occurs.

roles.Place: The Place indicates where the Placing occurs.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by perform the placing action.

roles.Behavior: This FE indicates the Behavior on which the assessment of praiseworthiness is based.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: The Behavior of the Evaluee is being judged as worthy of a particular reaction.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Prank.def: A Joker, by means of a Prank, arranges to deceive a Victim, with the result that some harm or embarrassment comes to the Victim.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Joker: The Prank is orchestrated by a Joker.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Prank: The Prank is a device, strategy, or system designed to mislead and cause harm and amusement to a Victim (and possibly others observing the prank).
roles.Victim: The Joker intends to mislead and cause harm to the Victim by means of the Prank.

Precariousness.def: A Theme has the potential of falling from its current Location, which would likely result in damage.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dangerous_entity: An entity which may cause the Theme to fall.
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the state of precariousness of the Theme logically follows.
roles.Falling_event: The event of falling, incorporated in the LUs of this frame.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the holistic properties of the balancing situation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A particular location in which the Theme is at risk of falling.
roles.Result: An event or state that results from the instability of the Theme.
roles.Theme: A valuable entity which might fall and be damaged.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Theme is in danger of falling.

Precipitation.def: Water in some solid or liquid form (the Precipitation) falls from the sky at a particular Place and Time, lasting for a particular Duration.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the precipitation event lasts.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the reason for the precipitation event.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: The way in which the precipitation falls.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The area which experiences precipitation.
roles.Precipitation: The water in liquid or solid form that falls from the sky is the Precipitation.
roles.Time: When the event occurs. 'It will probably be raining at five o'clock.'

Predicament.def: An Experiencer is in an undesirable Situation, whose Explanation may also be expressed.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is in an undesirable Situation.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation of the Situation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Situation occurs. 'The trouble in America is only going to get worse.'
roles.Situation: This FE identifies the undesirable Situation the Experiencer is in.
roles.Time: Thiis FE identifies the Time when the Situation is in effect.

Predicting.def: A Speaker states or makes known a future Eventuality on the basis of some Evidence.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Eventuality: This FE marks expressions that indicate an event or state that is predicted to occur or hold at a future time.
roles.Manner: Manner marks any description of the Speaker's prediction making that is not covered by more specific FEs.
roles.Means: An act whereby the Speaker makes a prediction.
roles.Medium: The Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Speaker to transmit the prediction.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the Speaker makes the prediction.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker makes a prediction. 'The institute forecast an increase in leisure spending of 15 per cent.'
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the prediction is made.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the subject matter to which the prediction pertains.

Preference.def: An Experiencer has a greater desire to participate in some Event, as against another (contextually recoverable) event which exhibits a specific Contrast with the Event.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Contrast: An alternative Event or Focal_participant that is less desirable for the Experiencer.
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the Experiencer has desired something.
roles.Event: The change that the Experiencer would like to see.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer is the person (or sentient being) who wishes for the Event to occur.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation shows why the Experiencer wants the Event to occur.
roles.Focal_participant: This is the entity that the Experiencer wishes to be affected by some Event.
roles.Location_of_event: The Location_of_event is the place involved in the desired Event.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Experiencer desires something.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place. Note that this FE is of extremely rare occurrence in this frame.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Experiencer desires something.

Preliminaries.def: This frame describes means actions (Preparatory_acts) that are taken by an Agent for the purpose of preparing for a later act.

roles.Agent: The Agent uses the Preparatory_act to acheive a Purpose.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the Preparatory_act takes place.
roles.Preparatory_act: The action performed by the Agent that is a preliminary to the achievement of the Purpose.
roles.Preparatory_phase: The part of the larger process that is preliminary to the achievement of the Purpose.
roles.Purpose: The ultimate goal or purpose of the Agent, which the Preparatory_act enables.
roles.Time: The time at which the Preparatory_act takes place.

Presence.def: An Entity exists at a particular Location, at a particular Time, as observed by an implicit observer.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The time period during which the Entity is present.
roles.Entity: The Entity whose existence at the Location is confirmed.
roles.Location: The Location of the Entity. The Location is conceived as a ground for an event of inspection to determine the presense of the Entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: The purpose of the Entity. 'Mr. Jones will be present to answer your questions.'
roles.Time: The time when the Entity is present at the Location.

Presentation_of_mitigation.def: A Mitigating_situation is presented as occurring against the backdrop of a more preferable situation and a less preferable situation that, while expected, feared, or hoped for, did not or will not occur; the Mitigating_situation is thus, so

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Mitigating_situation: The Mitigating_situation is the situation that actually occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Preserving.def: In this frame an Agent preserves a Patient in order to prevent it from decaying.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person performing the intentional act that leads to the preservation.'Arlene pickled the cucumbers.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of Time for which the process of Preserving is ongoing.'...oak cured for eight years.'
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which an an Agent performs the Preserving.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Agent preserves the Patient.'Jake painstakingly embalmed the next body.'
roles.Means: The Means by which the Agent preserves the Patient.'Hannah cured the shrimp by injecting them with brine.''This salami was cured naturally in salt.'
roles.Medium: Medium is the substance in which the Patient might be submerged to be preserved.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is organic matter that undergoes the preservation.'Tess pickled the beets in vinegar.'
roles.Place: The Place where the preserving occurs.'Mr.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Agent preserves the Patient.'Jude pickled the onions to increase their potency.'
roles.Result: Result of an action.
roles.Time: The Time when the Agent preserves the Patient.'Mr.

Prevarication.def: A Speaker communicates about a Topic in such a way as to mislead an Addressee, either by telling outright lies or by presenting a message in a misleading form.

roles.Addressee: The person that receives a Message from the Speaker.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of Time that the Speaker spends on the Topic.
roles.Frequency: This FE describes how often the Speaker discusses the Topic with the Addressee.
roles.Means: The (communicative) action performed by the Speaker in order to deceive the Addressee.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the deception occurs.
roles.Purpose: The goal of the Speaker's deceit of the Addressee
roles.Speaker: The person who uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey a deceptive Message to the Addressee.
roles.Time: The time at which the deception occurs.
roles.Topic: Topic is the entity to which the proposition or propositions relate, that they are about.

Prevent_or_allow_possession.def: An Agent or Potential_hindrance keeps a Protagonist from having a State_of_affairs that they need or desire, or, despite the possibility of preventing the possession, they allow the Protagonist to have the State_of_affairs.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person who keeps the Event from happening.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time for which the Protagonist is denied the State_of_affairs.
roles.Explanation: How it is possible that the deprivation event occurs.
roles.Frequency: This FE marks the frequency with which the Protagonist is prevented from having the State_of_affairs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is where the Potential_hindrance keeps the Event from taking place.
roles.Potential_hindrance: The Potential_hindrance is the force which keeps the Event from happening, or does not prevent it.
roles.Protagonist: The Protagonist is the person who is kept from having the State_of_affairs.
roles.Purpose: The reason why the Agent keeps the Protagonist from having the State_of_affairs.
roles.State_of_affairs: The is the situation, state-of-affairs, or state of having a possession that the Protagonist is kept from having.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Potential_hindrance keeps the Event from taking place.

Preventing_or_letting.def: A Potential_hindrance or an Agent (via their actions) keeps an Event from taking place, or despite the possibility of prevent the Event, do not do so.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the sentient being which keeps the Event from happening.
roles.Circumstances: A situation that accompanies the preventing or allowing.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The Event is prevented from occurring by the Preventing_cause or the Agent.
roles.Explanation: This FE denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: How often the event occurs.
roles.Manner: Any description of details of the event that influence the overall understanding and impression, such as the attitude of an Agent (casually) or the overall natu
roles.Means: The action performed by an Agent that brings about the prevention or allowing.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is where the Potential_hindrance or Agent keeps the Event from taking place.
roles.Potential_hindrance: The Potential_hindrance is the force which keeps the Event from happening, or does not.
roles.Purpose: The situation that the Agent hopes to bring about with their action.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Potential_hindrance or Agent keeps the Event from taking place.

Price_of.def: What something costs or cost someone.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: When.

Price_per_unit.def: A Product is offered by a Seller at a particular Price such that some total cost for the Buyer in the transaction is a multiple of the Price.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Price: The amount of money that the Seller charges the Buyer for a Product.
roles.Product: A commodity, item, or service being sold by the Seller at a certain Price.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Penal_institution: The locale which serves to confine individuals, generally for the purpose of punishment.

Probability.def: This frame characterizes the likelihood that a Hypothetical_event will happen as a position on a scale of impossible to inevitable.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Hypothetical_event: The event that is expected to happen with a certain likelihood.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Odds: A numerical representation of the probability that a Hypothetical_event will occur.
roles.Position: A metaphorical representation of the position on the scale of likelihood that the Hypothetical_event will occur.

Process.def: This frame describes a complex event which lasts some amount of time, consisting of a beginning stage, a stage where the process is ongoing, and a finish or end.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
roles.Explanation: The Reason for which an event occurs.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Process: Name of the Process which occurs.
roles.Result: Result of an event
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Process_completed_state.def: A Process is finished and can no longer proceed.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Process: This FE identifies the name of the Process that occurs.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Process_continue.def: An Event continues at a certain Place through Time.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time over which the Event is ongoing.
roles.Event: Name of the Event which is continuing.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Event occurs.
roles.Manner: Manner in which the Event is continuing.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the Event takes place.
roles.Time: When the Event occurs.

Process_end.def: A Process comes to an end. 'The project came to a close.'

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time it takes for the Process to end.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the event ends.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that the event is repeated.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing the event.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Process: Name of the event which occurs.'Let the carnage end.'
roles.Result: Result for the event.
roles.Time: When the event ends.

Process_resume.def: An event resumes at a certain Place and Time.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of Time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which an event occurs.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that the Process resumes.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), second
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Process: The Process which is being resumed.'The meeting resumed after the bomb threat passed.'
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Process_start.def: An Event begins at a certain Time and Place.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period of time for which the Process is ongoing after it has started.
roles.Event: Name of the Event which occurs. ' The crying began after sunset.'
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which an Event occurs.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that the specified type of Event begins.
roles.Manner: Manner in which an action is performed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the Event takes place.
roles.Result: Result of the Event.
roles.Time: When the Event occurs.

Process_stop.def: A Process stops at a certain Time and Place.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time that a process remains stopped.
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation of an event occur.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that the Process stops., 'Mining activities on the opal fields ceased twice in the last two weeks due to heavy rain storms'
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Result: The Result of an event.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Processing_materials.def: An Agent alters some Material in some useful way by means of some chemical or physical Alterant.

roles.Agent: The Agent is a person who applies the Process to the Material.
roles.Alterant: The Alterant causes a change in the Material.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time during which the application of the Alterant is applied to the Material
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in processing the Material.
roles.Manner: A holistic description encompassing all the details of an act of processing, often indicated by giving a characteristic of the Agent that affects the action.
roles.Material: The Material is altered by the Agent in some useful way.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Materials are processed, often a purpose-built facility such as a tannery or water treatment plant.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Agent processes the Material.
roles.Result: The result of the processing action, whether intended or not.
roles.Time: The point in time or period during which the treatment of the Material takes place.

Procreative_sex.def: This frame exists to define a type of Sex where the intended result is procreation.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE describes the length of time that an entire sexual encounter can last, including but not necessarily implying the length of all stages of the encounter.
roles.Manner: A description of the sex act which is not covered by more specific FEs.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which Participants accomplish a sexual act.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Participant_1: One party present for procreative sex.
roles.Participant_2: Another party present for procreative sex.
roles.Participants: The set of entities engaged in or subjected to procreative sexual contact.
roles.Place: To be clear: the place FE describes the overall location of the Participants of the sexual activity and nothing else.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the justification of a sexual act, for at least one of the Participants.
roles.Time: This FE relates the relative time of occurrence of the sexual activity.

Product_development.def: An Developer develops a Product, in some cases for a Company.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Developer: The person who develops the Product. 'Elsa developed a new line of facial products.'
roles.Manner: The manner in which the Product is developed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Product is developed by the Developer.
roles.Product: The entity which is developed by the Developer.
roles.Time: The Time when the Product is developed by the Developer.

Product_line.def: A specified Designer or a Brand creates and distributes a Collection of related Products.

roles.Brand: The company that produces the Collection of Products.
roles.Collection: The set of Products produced by the Brand.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Designer: The person who designs the Collection. 'Did you see Louis' new line?'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Products: The individual items produced by the Brand.

Progression.def: An Entity changes from a Prior_state to a Post_state in a sequence that follows a pre-defined plan, expectation, or model of change.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The period over which the progress occurs.
roles.Entity: The object that undergoes change. 'Advances in marketing techniques have since rendered it obsolete.'
roles.Explanation: An event or state of affairs that brings about the development of the Entity.
roles.Frequency: How often the Progress event occurs.
roles.Manner: A description of the progress, generally a description comparing events (the same way).
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Progress occurs.
roles.Time: The time at which the progress occurs. 'When did the X-wing progress beyond the drawing board?'

Prohibiting_or_licensing.def: In this frame a State_of_affairs is prohibited (or allowed) by a Principle.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are the conditions under which the State_of_affairs is prohibited.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the State_of_affairs is prohibited.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is where the prohibiting occurs.
roles.Principle: A moral, legal, or social norm which rules a State_of_affairs to be inadmissible behavior or an outcome of behavior.
roles.Time: The Time is when the prohibiting occurs.

Project.def: An Agent, which may be an individual or group, is engaged in a complex Activity.

roles.Activity: What the Agent (an individual or the members of an organization) are dedicated to doing.
roles.Agent: The individual or organization that carries out the project.
roles.Co-participant: Co-participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the Activity of the project as the Agent.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time over which the project is lasts or is slated to last.
roles.Field: An area of human endeavor, typically scientifc in nature, in which the Agent's Activity falls.
roles.Goal: The larger aim that the Agent is pursuing by carrying out certain coordinated measures.
roles.Manner: A description of the manner in which the Agent performs the Activity associated with the program.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where a Project is pursued.
roles.Project: The ongoing plan of action which allows the Agent to pursue the Activity.
roles.Salient_entity: An entity (abstract or concrete) which is involved in an implicit Activity.
roles.Time: The time at which the Project is ongoing.

Proliferating_in_number.def: The number of entities that make up the Set changes from an Initial_number to a Final_number.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the proliferation takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Difference: The number of entities by which the Set increases or decreases.
roles.Duration: The length of time over which the change takes place.
roles.Final_number: The number of entities in the Set afterwards.
roles.Final_state: A description that presents the Set's state after the change in the Attribute's value as an independent predication.
roles.Initial_number: The initial number of entities in the Set.
roles.Initial_state: A description that presents the Set's state before the change in the number of entities making it up as an independent predication.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing event
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A location where the Set changes in number.
roles.Set: The group of entities, possibly construed as a collective, whose number changes.
roles.Time: The Time is the time-frame in which the change in number occurs.

Prominence.def: An Entity stands out perceptually in comparison to other members of its type.

roles.Attribute: The feature of the Entity which is under discussion, namely perceptual salience.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity has a particular degree of prominence.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity for which the saliency Attribute is appropriate and under consideration.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE refers to the location where the Entity has a prominence of some Attribute.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular salience.

Proper_reference.def: A speaker marks explicitly that he intends to describe an Entity in a more restricted sense than it was used in the immediately preceding discourse, and that therefore his Intended_referent is different from the one that the hearer might ha

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The name of a particular entity that otherwise might be interpreted as having a broader reference.
roles.Intended_referent: The entity that the speaker intends to refer to using the Entity in a more restricted sense.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Proportion.def: Criteria exist that identify a particular Subset of a Group of things into members and non-members.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Criteria: A representation of the conditions upon which membership to a Subset of a Group is determined.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Ratio: The numerical representation of the size of the Subset relative to the size of the Group.
roles.Subset: The members of a Group that fulfill particular Criteria to belong to a Subset of the Group.

Proportional_quantity.def: The Denoted_quantity is (generally) an imprecise characterization of the quantity of Individuals or a Mass, made with reference to a relatively easily and precisely imaginable Reference_quantity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Denoted_quantity: The quantity denoted by phrases headed by the Target.
roles.Individuals: A collection of entities, either quantifiable physical beings (e.g.
roles.Mass: A substance that is being quantified.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Reference_quantity: A relatively precise quantity in some oft-used form that is used as the basis for defining the Denoted_quantity.

Protecting.def: Some Protection prevents a Danger from harming an Asset.

roles.Asset: Something desirable possessed by or directly associated with the Protection which might be lost or damaged.
