roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Danger: A situation that could damage the Asset. 'Other nations tended to muffle or modulate their occasional annoyance with the country that was their shield against t
roles.Duration: FN: This FE denotes the length of time in which the Asset is protected.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the act of protecting logically follows.
roles.Instrument: An entity directed by a volitional agent acting as a Protection which interacts with an undergoer to accomplish the security of the Asset from harm by the Dange
roles.Manner: Any description of the protecting event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly
roles.Means: An event involving the Protection that removes the Asset from potential harm through the Danger.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the Danger threatened the Asset.
roles.Protection: The person, entity, or action that prevents harm to an Asset.
roles.Time: The time when the Danger threatens. 'Regardless of the distribution media, USPTO information is safeguarded before, during, and after dissemination from imprope

Protest.def: A Protester (or Protesters) expresses a strong opinion either in support of or against an Issue, or the Action(s) of a Side which relate to the Issue.

roles.Action: An action taken by a Side or a view that the Side takes on an issue which the Protester either supports or opposes.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time of the protest. 'The month-long protest is slowly losing momentum.'
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is a proposition denoting a state of affairs from which the Protester's expressing his or her views on the Issue logically follows.
roles.Frequency: The frequency with which the protest occurs.
roles.Issue: The matter, usually concerning a course of action, which the Protester has an positive or negative opinion about.
roles.Manner: Any description of the a Protest which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general de
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Protester takes Sides on an Issue .
roles.Protester: The individual (or individuals) who holds an opinion on an Issue or Side.
roles.Side: The party or individual (generally associated with a particular position on an Issue) that the Protester sides with.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Protesters express their opinions.

Provide_lodging.def: A Host provides a temporary Residence for a Lodger.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are the conditions under which the Host provides lodging.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the cognitive cause of the Host's granting of permission.
roles.Host: The Host is the individual (or group of individuals) that own or control the Residence and allow the Lodger to temporarily stay there.
roles.Lodger: The Lodger is the individual who is given permission to lodge in the Residence.
roles.Manner: Any description of the provision of lodging which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions c
roles.Means: An action of the Host whereby they communicate or enact the granting of permission to stay in the Residence.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is where the Host provides a temporary Residence.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose is the goal of the Host in allowing the Lodger to stay.
roles.Residence: The location controlled by the Host which the Lodger stays at temporarily.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Host provides a Residence to the Lodger

Public_services.def: This frame concerns permanent organizations (the Institutions) that are intended to help members of the Target_group in a particular Domain with a Service_action.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Domain: The concern of the Institution-- broadly speaking, the aspect of society that they affect.
roles.Institution: A permanent organization with a socially important purpose.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Service_action: The action performed or enabled by the Institution for the Target_group.
roles.Target_group: The members of the public whom the Institution is intended to serve.

Publishing.def: A Publisher makes a Work of an Author (or authors) available to some public Audience for general enjoyment, examination, and reference.

roles.Author: The person or entity that is responsible for the detailed construction of the content of the Work.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Any description of the action that clarifies, in a holistic way, the details of how the publication event unfolded, including comparisons to other events ('the
roles.Means: The action taken by the Author or Publisher that makes the Work publicly available.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Publisher releases the work.
roles.Publisher: The entity that acts on behalf of the Author to release the Work to the public.
roles.Purpose: The situation that the Author or Publisher hopes to bring about by publishing.
roles.Time: The date when the Work is available or is expected to be available.
roles.Work: The creation of the Author that is made public by the Publisher.

Punctual_perception.def: A Perceiver briefly perceives a Phenomenon, often resulting in partial or uncertain perception.

roles.Body_part: The Body_part is the location on the body where the perceptual experience takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Manner: Any description of properties of perception, such as: clearly, loudly, etc.
roles.Means: The action whereby the Perceiver perceives.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Perceiver: The being who has a perceptual experience, generally construed to be not on purpose.
roles.Phenomenon: The entity or phenomenon that the perceiver experiences with his or her senses.
roles.Time: The Time, generally construed as punctual, at which the Perceiver or the Body_part perceives the Phenomenon.

Purpose.def: An Agent wants to achieve a Goal, or an object.

roles.Agent: The volitional actor who intends to achieve a goal.
roles.Attribute: This FE marks expressions that indicate an Attribute for which it is the Agent's goal that it have or reach a particular Value .
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goal: The action or state of affairs that the Agent wants to achieve.
roles.Means: A Means is an object or action that is used or designed to achieve a particular Goal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: This Frame Element expresses a time period during which an Agent had a particular Goal.
roles.Value: This FE marks expressions that indicate which Value the Agent wants the Attribute to reach.

Putting_out_fire.def: An Agent causes a Fire to no longer burn.

roles.Agent: The individual or group that causes the Fire to no longer burn.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Fire: The combustion process that the Agent causes to end.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the state of an Agent that affects the nature of the event as the Agent brings about the end of the Fire.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent puts out a Fire
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Agent puts out the Fire.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent puts out the Fire.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of the event.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Fire goes out.

Quantified_mass.def: This frame contains transparent nouns (and some adjectives) denoting quantities of a Mass or of Individuals.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Individuals: A collection of entities. 'A number of concerned citizens have raised objections.'
roles.Mass: A substance that is being quantified. 'A modicum of seepage on the floor is to be expected.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Quantity: The Quantity-denoting Target word. 'I had a heap of troubles.'

Quantity.def: This frame contains nouns denoting Quantities of a specified Entity and their numerical Values.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: Entity identifies the concept or substance being quantified by a Quantity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Value: Value identifies the numerical amount of the Entity.

Quarreling.def: A group of Arguers (also expressible as Arguer1 and Arguer2) express incompatible opinions or beliefs about an Issue.

roles.Arguer1: A person who is arguing with Arguer2.
roles.Arguer2: The person who is being argued with by Arguer1.
roles.Arguers: A group of people in an argument.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time that the Arguers spend in the altercation.
roles.Frequency: The frequency with which the Arguers have a disagreement.
roles.Issue: The the thing the the Arguers are arguing over or about.
roles.Manner: A description of the dispute which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events
roles.Means: The action that the Arguers perform in order to quarrel with each other.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the Arguers quarrel
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Arguers or Arguer1 hope to bring about.
roles.Time: The time when the argument takes place.

Questioning.def: The words in this frame have to do with a Speaker asking an Addressee a question which calls for a reply (as opposed to making a request which calls for an action on the part of the Addressee).

roles.Addressee: The Addressee is most frequently the NP Object of a target verb.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Manner of performing the request. 'I slowly asked the question again.'
roles.Message: The Message, or content of the question, usually takes the form of a direct quote or an embedded question with a verb target: '"What are you doing?" Kim inquire
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Speaker: The person asking a question generally occurs as the External Argument of verb and noun targets: 'Pat quizzed me about where I had been.' 'Pat's question surpri
roles.Time: The time at which the questioning occurs.
roles.Topic: Topic occurs very frequently in this frame with both noun and verb targets.

Quitting.def: An Employee voluntarily leaves the service of an Employer.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Employee: The person who is obligated to perform some task in order to receive compensation.
roles.Employer: The person (or institution) in whose employ the Employee stood.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Employee quits.
roles.Field: The Field that one works in. 'He might quit showbusiness for years.'
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Employee leaves the job.
roles.Means: The means whereby the act of quitting is accomplished 'Lately, many workers have been quitting by simply not showing up for work.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Employee quits the employment of the Employer.
roles.Position: The label given to a particular type of service that the employer quits.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Employee quits the employment of the Employer.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when an Employee quits the employment of the Employer.

Quitting_a_place.def: A Self_mover leaves an initial Source location.

roles.Circumstances: The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the departing event itself and any of its participants, and is mere
roles.Co-participant: A second moving object that moves in coordination with the Self_mover.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A factor which explains the particular motion or manner of motion of the Self_mover.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that an action occurs in a given time.
roles.Manner: Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion expresses the frame element Manner.
roles.Means: An event involving the Self_mover that results in the Self_mover moving in the specified way.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is where the motion (which is specified by a Source, Path or Goal) is located.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Self_mover wishes to bring about.
roles.Result: The state of the Self_mover at the end of the event.
roles.Self_mover: This is the entity which moves under its own power.
roles.Source: Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source.
roles.Time: The time at which the motion takes place.

Race_descriptor.def: This frame covers LUs that describe the race of a Person.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Range.def: There is a certain physical Distance within which some other entity can participate in an Event (typically perception or manipulation) with the Participant.

roles.Circumstances: The conditions under which the description of a Participant's range holds.

roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Rank.def: This frame contains nouns denoting a rank or level within an established hierarchy.

roles.Item: An entity which holds a particular Rank.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Rank: The Rank itself, usually denoted by the noun.

Ranked_expectation.def: An Entity is rated as unexpected for its context in terms of its magnitude.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The item which is described in terms of its expectedness in the context.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Rape.def: The words in this frame describe situations in which the Perpetrator has sexual intercourse with the Victim forcibly (or by threatening the use of force) and without his or her consent.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
roles.Event: The rape of a Victim by the Perpetrator.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that a rape event takes place.
roles.Instrument: This FE is any object used to commit the crime.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act performed by the Perpetrator by which the sexual crime is accomplished.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Perpetrator: This is the person who forces another person to have sexual intercourse with him or her against the other person's will.

Rashness.def: A Protagonist performs some Action without fully considering the circumstances under which he or she acts, or the possibly (negative) consequences of the Action.

roles.Action: The Action is carried out by the Protagonist with or without regard for the circumstances under which it is performed or consideration of possible consequences.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

roles.Time: The period of time when the Protagonist acts with (or without) consideration regarding an Action.

Rate_description.def: The LUs in this frame describe the level that a Rate, or the variation in some quantity over a period of time, deviates from the norm.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The Event whose Rate is being described. 'He was rapidly losing his patience.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Rate: The Rate at which something happens during an Event.

Rate_quantification.def: An Event occurs that can be characterized by a given Rate.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: A participant in the Event who is responsible for the indicated Rate.
roles.Event: The Event that occurs at a certain Rate. 'Production rates have risen in the last year.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Rate: How much a particular salient quantity involved in an Event changes over time.

Ratification.def: A Ratifier responds to a Proposal constructed by another party to make it binding over the Ratifier's jurisdiction or constituency.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the cognitive cause of the Ratifier's ratification.

roles.Place: The Place is where the Ratifier ratifies the Proposal.
roles.Proposal: The idea or course of action proposed by another individual or body which the Ratifier endorses and makes binding.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose is the goal of the Ratifier when they ratify the Proposal.
roles.Ratifier: The individual or body that confirms a Proposal negotiated or created by another party, causing it to become binding in a jurisdiction represented by the Ratifi
roles.Time: The Time is when the Ratifier makes the Proposal binding.

Reading_activity.def: A Reader visually examines a Text, typically in a linear order, to understand its content.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: An assessment of how many iterations of (the specified kind of) reading occur per time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the reading event that implicates details of how the event unfolds or is carried out (e.g.
roles.Means: An act that allows the Reader to read in the specified manner.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the reading event takes place. 'Surprisingly, few of the students read much at all in the designated reading rooms.'
roles.Purpose: The Purpose is the reason for which the Reader reads the Text.
roles.Reader: The one who examines a Text to understand it.
roles.Text: The entity that contains linguistic symbols.
roles.Time: When the reading event takes place. 'Charlie often reads the newspaper at night.'
roles.Topic: The idea that an implicit Text or texts focuses on.

Reading_aloud.def: A Speaker interprets a written Text and speaks the contents, usually to an Addressee.

roles.Addressee: The person or people to whom the Speaker is directing the reading of the Text.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: The way that the Speaker reads the Text aloud.
roles.Means: The method by which the Text is read aloud by the Speaker.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the reading takes place.
roles.Purpose: The result that the Speaker is trying to achieve by reading aloud.
roles.Source: The medium from which the Text is read.
roles.Speaker: The person who reads the Text aloud.
roles.Text: The source from which the Speaker reads.
roles.Time: When the reading takes place.

Reading_perception.def: The Reader attends to a Text to process its information.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act that allows the Reader to read in the specified manner.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the reading event takes place. 'Surprisingly, few of the students read much at all in the designated reading rooms.'
roles.Purpose: The Purpose is the reason for which the Reader reads the Text.
roles.Reader: The one who examines a Text to understand it.
roles.Text: The entity that contains linguistic symbols.
roles.Time: When the reading event takes place. 'Charlie often reads the newspaper at night.'

Reason.def: A volitional Agent is responding to a State_of_affairs by performing some Action.

roles.Action: The action that the Agent performs in response to a State_of_Affairs.
roles.Agent: The person who responds to a State_of_Affairs by performing some Action.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State_of_affairs: The eventuality that motivates the Agent"s performing a particular Action in response to it.

Reasoning.def: An Arguer presents a Content, along with Support, to an Addressee.

roles.Addressee: Addressee is the entity before whom the Arguer presents a Content.
roles.Arguer: The Arguer presents the Content before the Addressee.'Jan argued that the evidence was inadmissable.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: The Arguer wants the Addressee to entertain the Content, which can be a proposition to be believed or a course of action to be taken, based on the Support prese
roles.Duration: The period of time for which the Arguer presents his or her reasoning to the Addressee.
roles.Manner: This FE identifes the Manner in which an Arguer argues.'Jan argued convincingly that the evidence was inadmissable.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Arguer presents Content to an Addressee.'Jan argued the evidence was admissable by waving the warrant in the air.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the location where an argument is made by an Arguer.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of an arguing event.
roles.Time: The Time at which an Arguer makes an argument for the Content.

Reassuring.def: A Speaker conveys a Message to an Experiencer in order to reassure them about a Situation; Medium and the Means of the communication also may be expressed.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer receives reassurance from the Speaker.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Speaker reassures the Experiencer.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Speaker reassures the Experiencer.
roles.Message: The Message is a proposition or set of propositions that the Speaker wants the Experiencer to believe in order to feel reassured.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Situation: The Situation is the problem plaguing the Experiencer, about which the Speaker reassures them.
roles.Speaker: The sentient entity that uses language in the written or spoken modality to reassure another person.
roles.Time: The Time at which the reassurance takes place.

Rebellion.def: An individual or group, the Rebel, rejects the authority of the Current_leadership, and attempts to bring them out of power.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Current_leadership: The people currently in power, whom the Rebels attempt to overthrow.
roles.Current_order: The currently-existing system of authority or government.
roles.Duration: The length of time of the rebellion. 'The months-long insurgency has taken its toll on an already-reeling nation.'
roles.Manner: A description of the Rebel or the rebellion not covered by more specific FEs.
roles.Means: The means by which the Rebel rebels against the authorities.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location of the rebellion. 'It seems probably that rebellion in East Anglia was as rigorously suppressed as in Kent.'
roles.Rebel: The individual or group within a society that attempts to overturn the Current_leadership, and possibly also the Current_order of governance.
roles.Result: A result of the rebellion. 'The old guard is trying furiously to put an end to what has been an extremely headly rebellion.'
roles.Time: The time when the rebellion takes place. 'Did you support the insurrection of 1854?'

Receiving.def: A Recipient comes into possession of the Theme as a result of the joint action of the Donor and the Recipient.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Donor: The person who gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Manner: The character of the Recipient which saliently affects the action, or a general description of the action itself.
roles.Means: The act that the Recipient performs which brings about their reception of the Theme.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the Recipient comes into possession of the Theme.
roles.Recipient: The person who acts to come into possession of the Theme.
roles.Role: A role that the Theme is intended to fill by the Donor.
roles.Theme: The entity that changes possession, beginning in the possession of the Donor and ending up with the Recipient.
roles.Time: The time at which the Recipient comes into possession of the Theme.

Recording.def: An Agent sets down in permanent form information about the occurrence of a Phenomenon.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the sentient entity that creates a permanent record of the Phenomenon.
roles.Attribute: That feature of the Entity which is under discussion.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Entity: An Entity for which the Agent records the Value of an Attribute.
roles.Frequency: The amount of times the Agent records something per unit of time.
roles.Instrument: The Agent uses an Instrument in order to create a record of the Phenomenon or to measure an Entity's Value for a specified Attribute.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly), and general descriptions comparing events (the sa
roles.Means: This FE identifes the action whereby the Agent creates a record of the Phenomenon.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomenon: The Phenomenon is the entity or situation in the world of which a Agent becomes aware.
roles.Place: The location where the Agent sets down the facts.
roles.Purpose: The goal that the Agent has in mind in creating a record of the Phenomenon.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Agent creates the record of the Phenomenon.
roles.Value: The Value of the Entity that is recorded for the specified Attribute.

Records.def: A Record that contains a permanent account of Data.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The region where the Record is sold, circulated, or otherwise popular
roles.Record: The Record is the entity in which events or accounts are permanently recorded.

Recovery.def: These words describe the recovery or healing of a Patient from an Affliction without reference to the influence of any Treatment or Healer (see the Cure frame).

roles.Affliction: This FE is the injury, pain or disease experienced by the Patient.
roles.Body_part: Where Body Part is expressed as a separate constituent (rather than in phrases such as the wound on Pat's arm), it occurs as an External Argument: 'Pat's arm he
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act of the Patient that results in their recovery.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient may either be expressed as the External Argument or, as in Health.Cure, may occur as the possessor of the Affliction (an example of FE conflation):
roles.Place: The location where the recovery takes place.
roles.Time: The time at which the recovery takes place.

Redirecting.def: An intentional Agent or a causing event (Cause) event causes a Theme which is already in motion to take a different Path or Direction, or reach a different Goal than the Original_path.

roles.Agent: An individual that determines the change in course of the Theme.
roles.Cause: An event that brings about the change in the Path of the Theme.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Direction: This FE is used for expressions that indicate motion along a line from the current deitic center towards a reference point (which may be implicit) that does not
roles.Goal: The location the Theme ends up in after being redirected.
roles.Manner: Any description of the redirection which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing
roles.Means: The method by which the Agent redirects the Theme.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Original_path: The route that the Theme was originally headed for.
roles.Path: The Path refers to (a part of) the ground over which the Theme ends up travelling after being diverted.
roles.Place: The Place is the location at which the redirection occurs.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Agent intends to bring about by redirecting the Theme.
roles.Theme: The entity that is in motion, and changes path due to the action of an Agent or due to a Cause.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the redirection of motion occurs.

Reference_text.def: In a text, a Source_of_information is given that provides a reader of the text with further Information relevant to the text.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Source_of_information: The Source_of_information is referred to as a source of information related to the current text.

Referring_by_name.def: A Speaker uses a particular linguistic form, a Name to refer to an Entity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The entity that is designated by the Speaker with the Name used.
roles.Name: The linguistic form used by the Speaker to refer to the Entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Speaker: The person who uses the Name to refer to the Entity.
roles.Time: The point of time or interval when the Speaker uses the Name.

roles.Agent: The sentient entity that effects a change in the Entity.
roles.Cause: This FE is for non-human causes, such as a processes or institutions, responsible for reform.
roles.Circumstances: This FE describes the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the reform process.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time over which reforming takes place
roles.Entity: This FE denotes a complex, abstract, human-created entity with interdependent parts which has either deteriorated or is no longer adequate for its purpose given
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which reform event logically follows.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event causing the change of the Entity which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly), general descript
roles.Means: This FE identifies the steps or actions directly enabling reform.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the reformation occurs.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by effecting a change in the Entity.
roles.Time: The time at which the change of the Entity is caused.

Regard.def: A Cognizer has a Judgment of an Evaluee, expressing how high or low their regard for the Evaluee is.

roles.Cognizer: The Cognizer is the one that makes a Judgment.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: Evaluee is the person or thing that a judgment is made with respect to.
roles.Explanation: There may be a constituent expressing the Explanation for the Cognizer's judgment.
roles.Judgment: A description (from the point of view of the Cognizer) of the position of the Evaluee on a scale of approval.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Cognizer's judgment which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions of events (the same way, presumptuously, se
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Role: Role is used for the capacity in which the Evaluee is judged, and is expressed in as-PPs.

Rejuvenation.def: The action of an Agent or the occurrence of a Cause event returns an Entity to an earlier state of vigor and strength.

roles.Agent: The Agent puts the Entity into a state of renewed vigor.
roles.Cause: An event or state whose occurrence brings about the Entity's return to a vigorous state.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The concrete or abstract thing that is brought into an earlier state in which it was more effective and powerful.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Instrument: The device used by the Agent to help accomplish the action indicated by the target.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: This FE identifies the action that the Agent performs in order so as to bring about the reinvigoration of the Entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Agent brings about the change in the Entity's state.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent brings about the revitalization of the Entity.
roles.Result: The end state of the Rejuvination action.
roles.Role: Role is used for the capacity in which the Entity is Rejuvinated, and is expressed in as-PPs.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent causes the renewal of the Entity.

Relating_concepts.def: A Concept_1 is related to Concept_2 by some Evidence.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the connection exists.
roles.Concept_1: The concept which is linked to Concept_2.
roles.Concept_2: The concept which is tied to Concept_1. 'Skid marks on the street connects my neighbor's car to my broken mailbox.'
roles.Concepts: The two concepts expressed jointly. 'Ample evidence is able to connect the two.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evidence: The phenomenon that points to or proves the connection between Concept_1 and Concept_2.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Relation.def: A relation holds between Entity_1 and Entity_2.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entities: The things that are related to each other.
roles.Entity_1: An entity with a relationship to Entity_2.
roles.Entity_2: The entity with a relationship to Entity_1.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Relation_type: A characterization of the relation that determines what model is active for further reasoning.

Relational_natural_features.def: The Focal_feature is defined in relation to a Landmark_feature, either as a particular part, or as an immediately bordering entity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Focal_feature: A stable bounded area defined by its relation to another landform.
roles.Landmark_feature: The landform with respect to which the Focal_feature is defined.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Relational_political_locales.def: A Locale is defined politically to be the head of state of another, larger political locale, the Container_possessor.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Container_possessor: The political locale that the Locale is a the head of.
roles.Locale: The politically or administratively-defined locale that functions as the head of state for the containing entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Relational_quantity.def: A quantity, the Numerator, can be understood in terms of how it relates to another quantity, the Denominator; the comparison of these two numbers is called the Rate.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Denominator: The quantity whose magnitude is determined relative to the Numerator.
roles.Focal_entity: The set of things to which the Rate pertains.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Numerator: Identifies the quantity whose magnitude is determined relative to the Denominator.
roles.Rate: The number which represents the relative quantities of the Numerator and the Denominator.

Relative_time.def: These words relate to the relative ordering of two events or times.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE is used for the Explanation or explanation for the Focal_occasion being early or late.
roles.Focal_occasion: The Focal_occasion is the event which is being located in time with respect to some other event: The Focal_occasion is profiled, in contrast to the Landmark_occ
roles.Focal_participant: The Focal_participant is the participant in the Focal_occasion which is profiled as being in a relation of relative time to the Landmark_occasion.
roles.Landmark_occasion: The Landmark_occasion is the event with respect to which the Focal_occasion is located.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Releasing.def: A Captor ends the captivity or inhibition of the motion of a Theme from the Location_of_confinement.

roles.Captor: The Captor is the individual who ends the confinement or captivity of the Theme.
roles.Circumstances: The state of the world when the Releasing event occurs.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation identifies the reason for which the Captor are releasing the Theme.
roles.Location_of_confinement: The location to which the Theme's motion was formerly inhibited.
roles.Manner: Any description of the release which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing even
roles.Means: The action of the Captor which brings about the release.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Theme ceases to be confined.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose identifies the purpose for which the Captor release the Theme.
roles.Theme: The Theme is the person or object in motion released by the Captor.
roles.Time: The Time identifies when the Captor release the Theme .

Reliance.def: A Protagonist needs a Means action performed for their Benefit.

roles.Benefit: An action or state that the Means action brings about and from which the Protagonist profits.
roles.Circumstances: The conditions when the Protagonist needs to rely on an Instrument or Intermediary.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: An object that the Protagonist uses to realize a Benefit.
roles.Intermediary: The person or thing that performs a Means action to the Benefit of the Protagonist.
roles.Means: An action performed either by the Protagonist or an Intermediary that has a Benefit for the Protagonist attached to it.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Protagonist: The person or thing whose needs are served by the Means action.
roles.Purpose: An action or state that the Protagonist wants to bring about.

Reliance_on_expectation.def: A Cognizer takes a certain Expectation to be a reliable fact, such that their plans can be based on it.

roles.Circumstances: The situation in which the Cognizer can count on the Expectation.
roles.Cognizer: An individual that considers the Expectation certain.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Expectation: The fact which the Cognizer depends on in planning for the future.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Religious_belief.def: A Believer has faith in a piece of Content or an Element which fits into a religious belief system made up of many articles of faith.

roles.Believer: The Believer is the person whose religious beliefs are in question.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: The Content is the object of the Believer's religious conviction.
roles.Element: A predefined, fixed idea to which reference is made throughout the belief system.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Believer knows or thinks something.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Role: Role is a function that an Element of the faith is believed to serve.

Remainder.def: A Resource is depleted by some process, resulting in there being only a Remainder in existence some time into or after the process.

roles.Beneficiary: An individual who may use the Remainder for his benefit.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Original_context: A temporal setting or event which metonymically stands for the entities that were in existence then.
roles.Original_owner: The individual who owned the Resource that is being depleted.
roles.Remainder: The part of the Resource that the Process has not yet applied to.
roles.Resource: The original set of items to which the Depletive_process applies one after the other.
roles.Time: The Time when the amount of the Resource that is let is assessed.

Remembering_experience.def: A Cognizer calls up an episodic memory of past Experience or an Impression of a Salient_entity formed on the basis of past experience.

roles.Cognizer: A person who recalls memories of past experience or impressions.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the Cognizer remembers the experience.
roles.Experience: A past event or state that the Cognizer witnessed and is now recalling.
roles.Impression: A property that the Cognizer attributes to the Salient_entity based on their past experience of the Salient_entity or a category to which the Salient_entity is
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and gen
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Salient_entity: A person or thing that the Cognizer remembers as being involved in some state or event or as having some property.
roles.State: A property or role that a Salient_entity actually held and which frames the memories that the Cognizer has of the Salient_entity.
roles.Time: The time when the Cognizer remembers the experience.

Remembering_information.def: A Cognizer retains facts in memory and is able to retrieve them.

roles.Cognizer: The person who retains and retrieves information.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Mental_content: Mental_content stored by and accessible to the Cognizer.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The time when the Cognizer retrieves Mental_content or forgets it.

Remembering_to_do.def: A Cognizer thinks of and performs an Action that is a self- or other-imposed task or some other kind of desirable behavior.

roles.Action: An Action that the Cognizer is supposed to carry out.
roles.Cognizer: The person who thinks of or fails to think of an obligatory or desireable Action.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: This FE describes how often the Action is performed by the Cognizer.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Salient_entity: The Salient_entity is a person or thing that the Cognizer needs to affect or effect when carrying out the Action.
roles.Time: A Time when the Cognizer remembers or fails to carry out an Action.

Removing.def: An Agent causes a Theme to move away from a location, the Source.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person (or other force) that causes the Theme to move.
roles.Cause: The non-Agentive cause of the removing event.
roles.Circumstances: The state of the world when the Agent or Cause removes the Theme from the Source.

roles.Means: The Means is an act whereby the Agent achieves the removal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the removal takes place.
roles.Purpose: To what end the Agent or Cause removes the Theme.
roles.Result: Result of an event
roles.Source: The Source is the initial location of the Theme, before it changes location.
roles.Theme: Theme is the object that changes location.
roles.Time: The time at which the removal takes place.

Render_nonfunctional.def: An Agent affects an Artifact so that it is no longer capable of performing its inherent function.

roles.Agent: The sentient entity causes the Artifact to not function.
roles.Artifact: The device that no longer works.
roles.Cause: An inanimate entity or force that renders the Artifact non-functional.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Artifact is (or has been) rendered nonfunctional.
roles.Frequency: Meaning: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.

roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place at which the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: An event that the Agent hopes to bring about by breaking an Artifact.
roles.Time: The time at which the event takes place.

Renting.def: A Lessee gains the use of Goods owned by a Lessor by payment to the Lessor.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Goods are (or have been) in the Lessee's possession.
roles.Explanation: A state-of-affairs from which the renting logically follows.
roles.Goods: The FE Goods is an item which is temporarily exchanged for Money in a transaction.
roles.Lessee: The individual that gains temporary use of the Goods by paying the Lessor 'We 've been renting from him for years .'
roles.Manner: Any description of the purchasing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compa

roles.Place: The location the renting takes place. 'I rented the car right next to the airport .'
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the renting is performed.
roles.Recipient: The individual intended by the Lessee to receive the Goods.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Renting_out.def: A Lessor who owns some Goods allows a Lessee to use the Goods temporarily in exchange for Money.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Goods are (or have been) in the Lessee's possession.
roles.Explanation: A state-of-affairs from which the renting logically follows.
roles.Goods: The FE Goods is the item which is temporarily exchanged for Money.
roles.Lessee: The Lessee has Money and wants the Goods.
roles.Lessor: The Lessor has possession of the Goods and temporarily exchanges them for Money from a Lessee.
roles.Manner: Any description of the renting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparin

roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the leasing takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Result: The state of the Lessor after the sale has occurred.
roles.Time: The time at which the renting takes place.

Renunciation.def: A Speaker declares that they will no longer be involved with the Content.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee is the person to whom the Speaker is communicating.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: The idea that the Speaker no longer associates with, whether it be an activity, a propostion, or a group.
roles.Manner: Any description of the renunciation which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing
roles.Means: An act whereby the Speaker makes a statement of renunciation.
roles.Medium: Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Speaker to transmit the statement of renunciation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The FE specifies the place where the statement takes place.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker is the person who communicates their cessation of association with the Content.
roles.Time: The time when the statement is made.

Reparation.def: The words in this frame describe the process of making amends for some (wrongful) action (the Injury) committed by the Wrongdoer.

roles.Benefiting_action: The Benefiting_action is performed by the Wrongdoer to make amends.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Gift: Gift identifies the entity that the Wrongdoer gives to the Injured_party.
roles.Injured_party: The Injured_party was affected by some previous wrongful act of the Wrongdoer and who should benefit from the reparations.
roles.Injury: The Injury is the injurious action that the Wrongdoer committed against the Injured_party.
roles.Manner: Manner marks any description of the Wrongdoer's making of reparations not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification, (e.g.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Wrongdoer makes amends.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Wrongdoer makes restitution to the Injured_party.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when amends are made.
roles.Wrongdoer: The Wrongdoer makes amends to the Injured_party for the Injury.

Repayment.def: A Debtor gives a Loaner Money in return for having borrowed Money at an earlier time.

roles.Circumstances: The state of the world when the Money is transfered.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Debtor: The person who is giving Money to the Loaner to return an earlier borrowed amount.
roles.Loan: A situation or a representative of a situation prior to repayment in which the Debtor uses the Loaner's money.
roles.Loaner: The person who is owed Money by the Debtor.
roles.Manner: How the Debtor gives Money to the Loaner.
roles.Means: What the Debtor does in order to repay the Loaner.
roles.Money: The amount of Money that the Debtor gives to the Loaner, which may or may not be the full amount of the Loan.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The physical location where the repayment takes place.
roles.Time: When the Debtor gives the Loaner money. 'Don't worry, I'll pay you back later.'

Repel.def: A Defender successfully repels the aggressive attempt of takeover by an Enemy.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Defender: The Defender is the land, government, and its people that the Enemy fails to seize.
roles.Enemy: The Enemy is the entity that fails to overtake the Defender.
roles.Instrument: The tool used by the Defender to repel the Enemy.
roles.Invasion_act: This FE refers to the Invasion_act perpetrated by the Enemy.
roles.Manner: The manner in which the Defender repels the Enemy.
roles.Means: The action by which the repelling event is made possible through the efforts of the Defender.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Defender repels the Enemy.
roles.Purpose: The reason why the Defender repels the Enemy.
roles.Result: This FE describes the outcome of the repelling event.
roles.Time: The Time when the Defender succeeds to repel the Enemy.

Replacing.def: An Agent changes the filler of a Role by placing a New filler in the position after the Old filler ceases to occupy the position.

roles.Agent: The conscious entity, generally a person, that performs actions resulting in the New entity occupying the position.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in placing the New filler in a position.
roles.Instrument: An entity directed by the Agent that interacts with an New entity so that it ends up in the position.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descri
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the replacement.
roles.New: The New entity is the person or thing that the Agent sets to fill a Role.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Old: The entity that formerly occupied the position.
roles.Place: This FE identifies where the Agent installs the New entity.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent places the New entity in a position.
roles.Role: The category that the New and Old entities fit into as a result of the function they serve.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent installs the New entity.

Reporting.def: In this frame an Informer informs the Authorities of the illegal or otherwise improper Behavior of the Wrongdoer.

roles.Authorities: The Authorities are the officials, government or otherwise, who handle misbehavior.
roles.Behavior: The Behavior is the action or actions for which the Wrongdoer is reported.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Informer: The Informer reports the activities of the Wrongdoer to the Authorities.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the location where the reporting occurs.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose is the purpose for which the Informer reports the Wrongdoer.
roles.Time: The Time when the Informer reports the Behavior of the Wrongdoer.
roles.Wrongdoer: The Wrongdoer has his or her activities reported to the Authorities.

Representative.def: A Representative is authorized by a Represented to communicate on behalf of the Represented.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Representing.def: An Entity represents some Phenomenon through its existence and/or defining characteristics.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: An object that has some association with a Phenomenon.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the represenation logically follows.
roles.Frequency: The Frequency denotes how often the Entity is associated with the Phenomenon.
roles.Means: This FE describes the means through which the representing occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomenon: The event, idea, or emotion evoked by the Entity.
roles.Place: The Place where the representing event occurs.
roles.Time: The time period in which the representing occurs.

Request.def: In this frame a Speaker asks an Addressee for something, or to carry out some action.

roles.Addressee: In this frame the Addressee can either occur as an NP Object (usually with a following complement clause) or as a PP Complement of verbs or nouns.
roles.Beneficiary: This extra-thematic FE applies to participants that are expected to derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Manner indicates the manner in which the Message is delivered.
roles.Means: An act performed by the Speaker that results in a request being made and received.
roles.Medium: The Medium is the physical entity or channel used to transmit the Message.
roles.Message: The Message is the content of the request that can be expressed as a quote, in a finite or non-finite clausal Complement, an NP Object or PP Complement.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Speaker: The Speaker, as in other communication frames, is generally an External Argument.
roles.Time: The interval during which the Speaker makes the request.

Request_entity.def: A Customer requests an Entity from a Supplier.

roles.Beneficiary: The person or organization which benefits from the Entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Customer: The Customer is the person or business ordering the Entity from the Supplier.
roles.Entity: The object ordered by the Customer. 'Liz ordered a new espresso maker for the office.' 'His order did not arrive on time.'
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the request is placed.
roles.Means: An action performed by the Customer that results in a request being made.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Supplier: The person or organization from whom the Customer orders the Entity.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Customer requested the Entity.

Required_event.def: Unless a particular Required_situation obtains, Negative_consequences will follow.

roles.Circumstances: The FE Circumstances encodes a setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the requirement holds.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The reason why the Required_situation is necessary.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location within which the Required_situation is required.
roles.Purpose: The event or state of affairs that is achieved by bringing about the Required_situation and which entails the non-occurrance of Negative_consequences.
roles.Time: The period during which the Required_situation is necessary to prevent negative consequences.

Rescuing.def: An Agent saves a Patient or an Asset from a Harmful_situation.

roles.Agent: The sentient being who rescues the Patient or Asset from the Harmful_situation.
roles.Asset: The entity that is judged to be valueable which might be lost or damaged by the Harmful_situation.
roles.Circumstances: The setting in which the rescuing act takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in performing the action.
roles.Harmful_situation: An event that occurs which could result in injury or harm to the Patient or Asset.
roles.Instrument: The tool with which the Agent saves the Patient or Asset.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Agent rescues the Patient or Asset.
roles.Means: The means by which the Agent rescues the Patient or Asset.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The living being who is rescued by the Agent.
roles.Place: The location at which the Agent rescues the Patient or Asset.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Agent rescues the Patient or Asset.
roles.Time: The time at which the Agent rescues the Patient or Asset.

Research.def: A Researcher (an individual a group or institution) attempts to answer a Question by means of consulting literature, observation, or conducting experiments in a particular Field pertinent to the Question.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), genera
roles.Means: The experimentations, observations, or other procedures performed by the Researcher in order to find an answer to the Question.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The physical place where the research is carried out.
roles.Purpose: Purpose indicates an action that the Researcher intends to accomplish by performing research.
roles.Question: A significant unanswered open proposition which the Researcher is attempting to resolve.
roles.Researcher: The people engaged in a research endeavor.
roles.Time: The time when the research is carried out.
roles.Topic: A phenomenon or idea involved in a Question.

Reserving.def: In this frame, a Booker brings about a situation where an Organization plans to provide Services to a Client at a particular Scheduled_time.

roles.Booker: The entity that contacts the Organization directly.
roles.Client: The entity that is intended to receive the Services of the Organization.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Any description of the event as a whole ("the same way") or a characteristic of the Booker during the action that holistically affects the event ("sloppily").
roles.Means: An action or methodology used by the Booker to bring the reservation about.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Organization: The entity that enters into its records the request of the Client to retain Services in the future.
roles.Place: The location the Booker performs the action.
roles.Purpose: The situation that the Booker intends to bring about by reserving.
roles.Scheduled_time: The future point in time when the Client arranges for the Organization to provide Services.
roles.Services: The goods or labor that the Client requests the Organization preserve for future consumption or rendering.
roles.Time: The time at which the reserving event takes place.

Reshaping.def: In this frame a Deformer deforms a Patient possibly against a Resistant_surface such that it undergoes a shape-change from its canonical or original shape into the Configuration, a new shape.

roles.Cause: The Cause is an animate or inanimate entity, a force, or event that produces an effect.
roles.Circumstances: The conditions under which the Patient is shaped.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Configuration: A state that holds of the Patient or a relation that holds among the constituent parts of the Patient as a result of the arranging action.
roles.Deformer: The Deformer is the one who does the reshaping.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation indicates a state of affairs that the Deformer is responding to in performing the reshaping.
roles.Goal: The location that the Patient ends up in.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument with which the Deformer affects the Patient.
roles.Manner: The FE Manner identifies the manner in which an Deformer intentionally affects the Patient.
roles.Means: The FE Means identifies the means by which the Deformer intentionally affects the Patient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is the entity acted on and that undergoes a change.
roles.Place: The Place indicates where the Deformer intentionally affects the Patient.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which the Deformer intentionally affects the Patient.
roles.Result: The Result is the shape the Patient becomes.
roles.Time: The FE Time identifies when the Deformer intentionally affects the Patient.

Residence.def: This frame has to do with people (the Residents) residing in Locations, sometimes with a Co-resident.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Co_resident: A person or group of people that the resident is staying with or among.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: Frequency at which event occurs.
roles.Location: The place in which somebody resides. 'Sue lives in Berkeley.'
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act of the Resident that enables them to reside in the Location.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Resident: The individual(s) that reside at the Location.
roles.Time: This FE refers to the Time when the Resident resides.

Resolve_problem.def: An Agent resolves an outstanding Problem by finding its solution, explanation, answer, etc.

roles.Agent: The Agent finds the solution or explanation to the outstanding mystery or Problem.
roles.Beneficiary: This FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the resolution of a Problem .
roles.Cause: The Cause is the non-Agentive event or state of affairs that brings about the resolution of the Problem.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the circumstances under which the Problem is resolved.
roles.Co-participant: A person who participates in resolving a Problem along with the Agent.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the length of time taken to resolve a Problem .
roles.Frequency: Frequency describes how often the Agent or Cause resolves this problem.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument is an entity used for resolving the Problem .
roles.Manner: Any description of the resolution, such as secondary effects ( quietly ) or comparisons of events ( the same way ).
roles.Means: The Means is an intermediate action taken by the Agent in order to resolve the Problem.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE indicates the location at which the Problem is resolved.
roles.Problem: The Problem is the predicament or mystery that is resolved.
roles.Purpose: The state of affairs that the Agent is trying to bring about by solving the Problem in the specified way.
roles.Time: This FE indicates the Time at which the Problem is resolved.

Respond_to_proposal.def: A Speaker addresses a Proposal made by an Interlocutor, either agreeing to it or rejecting it.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the success or failure logically follows.
roles.Interlocutor: This is the person who made the Proposal to the Speaker and to whom the Speaker communicates their response.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compa
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by the Speaker responds to the Proposal .
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Speaker makes a verbal response.
roles.Proposal: The Proposal is the prior communication or action to which a response is given.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Speaker intends to accomplish by making a verbal response.
roles.Role: Role denotes the capacity in which the Interlocutor is judged.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker is the person who communicates the reply or response.
roles.Time: The time interval during which the Speaker makes their verbal response.

Response.def: An Agent performs a Response action in consequence of a Trigger event.

roles.Agent: The intentional Agent that is impinged upon by a Trigger event to which they respond.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: A characterization of the Responding_entity, Agent, or their Response action.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Response action takes place.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by performing the Response action.
roles.Responding_entity: A non-agentive entity that is impinged upon by a Trigger event to which they respond.
roles.Response: The means action whereby the Agent responds to the Trigger.
roles.Role: The capacity of of the Agent is their Response act.
roles.Time: The point in time when the Agent or Responding_entity manifests its Response to the Trigger .
roles.Trigger: An event that impinges upon the Agent or Responding_entity and produces a Response from it.

Responsibility.def: An Agent is responsible for having intentionally performed an Act or for being the or a primary instigator behind the Act.

roles.Act: This FE identifies the Act that the Agent performs intentionally.
roles.Agent: The Agent performs the intentional act.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: The Frequency with which the Agent does the Act in a given period of time.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the intentional act occurs.
roles.Result: The Result of the Agent performing the Act.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent acts intentionally.

Rest.def: One Part of a larger Whole has been mentioned, is inferrable, or is available in the discourse setting and the previously unmentioned part, the Rest, is now mentioned.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part: A Part of a larger Whole that has been mentioned in prior discourse or is available in the discourse setting.
roles.Rest: The previously unmentioned part of the Whole.
roles.Whole: The larger entitiy or group that is fully made up of the Part and the Rest.

Resurrection.def: A Protagonist which had been dead returns to life.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: An explanation of how the state-of-affairs came to pass.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the Protagonist returns from the dead.
roles.Protagonist: The being or entity that becomes living again.
roles.Result: The state of the Protagonist which results from resurrection.
roles.Time: The time at which the resurrection occurs.

Retaining.def: In this frame an Agent continues to possess a Theme for a Duration of time.

roles.Agent: The person who has possession of the Theme.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the Agent is in possession of the Theme.
roles.Manner: The way the Agent retains possession of the Theme.
roles.Means: The means by which the Agent retains the Theme.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Agent keeps the Theme.
roles.Theme: The entity which the Agent possesses for a Duration.
roles.Time: The time at which the Agent has possession of the Theme.

Reveal_secret.def: A Speaker reveals Information that was previously secret to an Addressee.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee is the person to whom the Information is revealed.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: Frequency is defined as the number of times the Reveal_secret event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Information: Information identifies the content that the Speaker reveals to the Addressee.
roles.Manner: Manner is any description of the revelation which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), se
roles.Means: An act whereby the Speaker makes a revelation.
roles.Medium: Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Speaker to transmit the statement.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The FE specifies the Place where the Information is revealed.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker is the sentient entity that reveals the Information (whether spoken or written).
roles.Time: The Time when the revelation is made.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the subject matter about which the Speaker is speaking.

Revenge.def: This frame concerns the infliction of punishment in return for a wrong suffered.

roles.Avenger: The Avenger exacts revenge from the Offender for the Injury.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
