roles.Duration: The length of time that the Avenger seeks revenge for the Injury.
roles.Injured_party: This frame element identifies the constituent that encodes who or what suffered the Injury at the hands of the Offender.
roles.Injury: The Injury is the injurious action committed by the Offender against the Injured_Party.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument with which the revenge is performed.
roles.Manner: This frame element refers to the Manner in which the Avenger exacts their revenge from the Offender.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Offender: The Offender has committed the earlier Injury for which the Avenger seeks revenge.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the revenge occurs.
roles.Punishment: The Avenger carries out a Punishment in order to exact revenge on the Offender.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the revenge is performed.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of inflicting punishment for a wrong suffered.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the revenge occurs.

Revolution.def: An Agent brings about a radical change in leadership by removing the Current_leadership and potentially dismantling the Current_order, outside recognized means of doing so (e.g., elections).

roles.Agent: The individual or group within a society that overturns the Current_leadership.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Current_leadership: The people currently in power, whom the Agent attempts to overthrow.
roles.Current_order: The currently-existing system of authority or government.
roles.Manner: A description of the Agent or revolution not covered by more specific FEs.
roles.Means: The means by which the revolution is carried out.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location of the revolution. 'A series of revolutions in the eastern part of the continent made long-distance travel all but impossible.'
roles.Time: The time when the revolution takes place.

Rewards_and_punishments.def: An Agent (the punisher or rewarder) performs a Response_action on an Evaluee for a Reason, the Evaluee's actions or beliefs.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person doing the rewarding or punishing.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: Evaluee is the person or thing about whom/which a judgment has made and to whom reward/punishment is dealt.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which the reward or punishment is carried out.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing the reward or punishment.
roles.Means: The action that is taken that results in punishement/reward.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose of the reward or punishment.
roles.Reason: Typically, there is a constituent expressing the Reason for the Agent's judgment.
roles.Response_action: The reward or punishment given to the Evaluee by the Agent.
roles.Result: Result of the reward or punishment.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Ride_vehicle.def: In this frame a Theme is moved by a Vehicle which is not directly under their power.

roles.Area: The Area is the location where the motion takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration is the amount of time the motion takes.
roles.Goal: The Goal is the endpoint of the trajectory of motion.
roles.Manner: The Manner describes a property of the motion not related to its trajectory.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: The Path describes the trajectory of the motion.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Theme rides a vehicle.
roles.Source: Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source.
roles.Theme: The Theme is the entity which moves by means of the Vehicle.
roles.Time: When the riding takes place. 'We will fly back to New York in September.'
roles.Vehicle: The Vehicle is the means of conveyance of the Theme.

Rising_to_a_challenge.def: A Protagonist, by exerting great effort, comes to meet the pre-conditions for participating in an Activity that is judged to be difficult for them to participate in, either due to their inherent properties or due to temporary Circumstances.

roles.Activity: The Activity that the Protagonist expends efforts towards.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the Protagonist exerts effort to meet the pre-conditions necessary for engaging in the Activity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: An entity, event, or state of affairs that causes the Protagonist to expend the effort necessary to meet the pre-conditions for participating in the Activity.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), genera
roles.Means: An action performed by the Protagonist which enables them to overcome the difficulties and engage in the Activity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Protagonist expends effort to become capable of engaging in the Activity.
roles.Protagonist: The Protagonist who is exerting effort to meet the pre-conditions for participating in the Activity.
roles.Time: The time at which the Protagonist through expenditure of effort becomes capable of engaging in the Activity.

Risky_situation.def: A particular Situation is likely (or unlikely) to result in a harmful event befalling an Asset.

roles.Asset: Something judged to be desirable or valuable which might be lost or damaged.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances in which an Asset is at risk.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dangerous_entity: A concrete or abstract entity which may come to cause the loss of, or damage to the Asset.
roles.Frequency: How often the Asset encounters the Risky_situation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A particular location for which the Situation is safe.
roles.Situation: The Situation which may lead to a harmful event.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Situation has the specified level of safety.

Rite.def: This frame concerns rituals performed in line with religious beliefs or tradition.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Desired_state_of_affairs: This FE identifies the state which the rite is hoped or intended to bring about.
roles.Guardian: The Guardian is the member of the Organization who instigates the rite for someone of which they are a guardian.
roles.Instrument: This FE identifies the Instrument used to perform a particular rite.
roles.Leader: This is the religious or cultural leader who performs and/or leads the rite.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing the rite
roles.Means: The action that is taken to perform the ritual.
roles.Member: The FE Member describes the member of the religious or cultural group who participates in/undergoes the rite.
roles.New_status: Rites may confer a New_status on a participant (e.g.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Object: This FE indicates an object on which a rite is performed.
roles.Organization: Organization identifies the institution in which the rite is prescribed.
roles.Place: Where the rite takes place.
roles.Time: When the rite is performed
roles.Type: The type of ritual or ceremony being performed.

Roadways.def: This frame involves stable Roadways which connect two stable Endpoints, the Source and the Goal.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goal: The Goal is one of the Endpoints of the Roadway treated as a goal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Roadway: The Roadway is the roadway that connects locations.
roles.Source: The Source is one of the Endpoints treated as a source.

Robbery.def: These are words describing situations in which a Perpetrator wrongs a Victim by taking something (Goods) from them.

roles.Co-participant: Co-participant denotes a person that participates in a coordinated way in robbery event as the primary protagonist, the Perpetrator.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The state of affairs that the Perpetrator has in mind which leads to the decision to commit the robbery.
roles.Frequency: The number of times a robbery event occurs.
roles.Manner: The Manner describes the way in which the Robbery took place.
roles.Means: The Means indicates the means by which the Robbery takes place.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Perpetrator: The Perpetrator is the person (or other agent) that takes the Goods away by force or threats.
roles.Place: The Place is where the Robbery occurs. 'They robbed a bank in North Berkeley.'
roles.Purpose: The action that the Perpetrator is trying to accomplish by the robbery.
roles.Source: Source is the initial location of the goods, before they change location.
roles.Time: The Time indicates when the Robbery occurs.
roles.Victim: The Victim is the person (or other sentient being or group) that owns the Goods before they are taken away by the Perpetrator.

Rope_manipulation.def: An Agent manipulates a linear entity (the Rope) to form a Knot.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the sentient being who manipulates the Rope.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
roles.Instrument: The Instrument with which the Rope is manipulated.
roles.Knot: The stable configuration of a Rope which results from tying.
roles.Manner: Manner in which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
roles.Means: The Means by which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
roles.Rope: The basically linear object which is manipulated by the Agent to produce a Knot.
roles.Time: When the manipulation of the Rope takes place.

Rotting.def: In this frame a Patient, which is an organic substance, undergoes the natural process of decaying from an Initial_state to a Result.

roles.Circumstances: A state of affairs that entails the Patient decaying.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration indicates the amount of time for which the Patient rots.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation indicates the reason for which the Patient rots.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that a rotting event takes place.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Rotting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Patient: The Patient is the entity that undergoes a change.
roles.Place: The Place is where the rotting occurs. 'Any traces of uneaten food will decompose in your tank and foul the water.'
roles.Result: The Result is the result of the change of phase of the Patient.
roles.Time: The Time indicates when the rotting occurs.

Run_risk.def: A Protagonist is described as being exposed to a potentially dangerous situation that may end in a Bad_outcome for him- or herself.

roles.Action: The Action that creates the risk. 'Implementing this program runs the risk of offending our core constituents.'
roles.Asset: Something desirable possessed by or directly associated with the Protagonist which might be lost or damaged.
roles.Bad_outcome: A situation that the Protagonist would like to avoid.
roles.Beneficiary: The Protagonist intends for his/her actions to benefit Beneficiary in some way.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances indicates the state of affairs under which the risky situation holds.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: An Explanation for why the Protagonist has put the Asset is in a dangerous situation.
roles.Frequency: The Frequency with which the Protagonist runs risks.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where there is risk. 'There is always some danger to rich men in a bar like this.'
roles.Protagonist: The person who is at risk of some Bad_outcome
roles.Purpose: The desired action or goal that the Protagonist hopes to bring about.
roles.Time: The time when the risk pertains. 'Even after the end of Apartheit we still run the risk of letting racism continue forever.'

Sacrificing_for.def: An Agent sacrifices an (often abstract) Asset in exchange for a Benefit which is deemed better or more worth having.

roles.Agent: The Agent gives up the Asset in hopes of receiving a greater Benefit.
roles.Asset: The item which is sacrificed by the Agent.
roles.Benefit: The Agent hopes to receive or gain advantage from the Benefit as a result of giving up the Asset.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Agent gives up the Asset.
roles.Manner: The way that the Agent sacrifices the Asset.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: This FE indicates the Time when the Agent gives up the Asset.

Satisfying.def: This frame describes an Agent or an Entity meeting or not meeting a Standard.

roles.Agent: The volitional Agent who is in line with a Standard.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The non-agentive Entity that is in line with a Standard.
roles.Event: An occurrence or action that brings about the satisfaction or nonsatisfaction of a Standard.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Standard is satisfied.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Standard is satisfied.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Standard: The condition or requirement that the Agent, Entity, or Event satisfy (or not).
roles.Time: The Time in which satisfaction of the Standard occurs.

Scarcity.def: The Quantity of a Collection occurring in a Place has a particular Measure, which is related to the amount generally needed.

roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the circumstances under which the Collection has a particular Measure for the Quantity.
roles.Collection: The Collection whose Quantity is under consideration.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Collection occurs.
roles.Quantity: The feature of an Collection which is under discussion.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Collection is in the state of having a particular Measure for the Quantity.

Scheduling.def: An Agent schedules an Event to take place at a specified Scheduled_time and Place.

roles.Agent: The sentient being who schedules an Event to take place at a Time and Place.
roles.Beneficiary: The person for whom the Event was scheduled by the Agent.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The incident that the Agent has scheduled to take place at a Time and Place.
roles.Explanation: The cause for the scheduling of the Event.
roles.Frequency: The frequency with which the Agent schedules and Event.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Agent schedules the Event.
roles.Means: The means used by the Agent in order to schedule the Event.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Agent has scheduled the Event to take place.
roles.Purpose: The Agent's motivation for scheduling the Event.
roles.Scheduled_time: The time at which the Event is scheduled to take place.
roles.Time: This FE describes the time at which the scheduling occurs.

Scope.def: An Event is described in terms of the diversity of entities that are affected or considered in the Event.

roles.Attribute: The feature of an Salient_entity which is under discussion.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The state-of-affairs that affects a set of entities.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Salient_entity: The entity which enables or causes the Event being judged.

Scouring.def: A Searcher looks all over a Ground in order to find a Sought_entity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE specifies the length of the interval during which the scouring activtiy takes place.
roles.Ground: The location that the Searcher covers in looking for the Sought_entity.
roles.Instrument: An entity manipulated by the Searcher to examine the Ground.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Searcher scrutinizes the Ground.
roles.Means: The action of the Searcher that allows them to search the Ground.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Searcher hopes to bring about by searching a Ground.
roles.Searcher: The person who is looking all over the Ground for the Sought_entity.
roles.Sought_entity: The entity that the Searcher wants to find.
roles.Time: The Time when the Searcher scoures the Ground.

Scrutiny.def: This frame concerns a Cognizer (a person or other intelligent being) paying close attention to something, the Ground, in order to discover and note its salient characteristics.

roles.Cognizer: The Cognizer pays attention to an entity in order to discover something about it.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Ground: The Cognizer pays attention to the Ground, so named because it serves as the background or context for the Phenomenon.
roles.Instrument: An entity directed by the Cognizer that interacts with the Ground to accomplish the scrutiny.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Cognizer scrutinizes the Ground.
roles.Means: This FE is used for the Means by which the Cognizer to scrutinize the Ground.
roles.Medium: The Medium is the piece of text or work in which the Cognizer pays attention to an entity in order to discover something about it.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: Some of the words in this frame occur with a constituent that expresses the desired outcome of the Scrutiny.
roles.Time: The Time when the Cognizer is scrutinizing the Ground.

Secrecy_status.def: A Phenomenon, which may be an activity, state or object, is purposefully hidden from the awareness of a potential Cognizer.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phenomenon: The Phenomenon is the activity, state or object that is purposefully hidden from the awareness of a potential cognizer.
roles.Time: A period of Time during which the Phenomenon is hidden from the awareness of potential cognizers.

See_through.def: A Cognizer realizes that a State_of_affairs (or Focal_entity within the State_of_affairs) is meant to deceive (the Cognizer is not necessarily the intended victim of the deception).

roles.Cognizer: The Cognizer realizes the existence of a deception and is not misled by it.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Focal_entity: The Focal_entity is a part of the deception (possibly also the agent behind it) which is perceived by the Cognizer to be misleading.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act performed by the Cognizer which enables them to figure something out.
roles.Medium: Medium is the text created by the Cognizer to communicate that they came to believe a specified State_of_affairs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the Cognizer realizes the State_of_affairs.
roles.State_of_affairs: The State_of_affairs is intended to be perceived and taken to be true even though it is not.
roles.Time: The time at which the Cognizer discovers the State_of_affairs.
roles.Topic: Some verbs in this frame may occur with postverbal Topic expressions

Seeking.def: A Cognizer_agent attempts to find some Sought_entity by examining some Ground.

roles.Cognizer_agent: The person who attempts to find the Sought_entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: The Manner of performing an action.
roles.Means: An act of the Cognizer_agent that allows them to look for the Sought_entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A spatial setting larger than the Ground in which the Seeking event occurs.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Cognizer_agent intends to accomplish by performing the search.
roles.Sought_entity: This is the entity that the Ground may contain.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Seeking occurs.

Seeking_to_achieve.def: An Agent intends and takes steps towards bringing about a State_of_affairs or, metonymically, towards acquiring a Sought_entity .

roles.Agent: The Agent makes an attempt to achieve a State_of_affairs or to obtain a Sought_entity.
roles.Beneficiary: This FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the Sought_entity or State_of_affairs .
roles.Circumstances: This FE introduces the underlying situation(s) in which seeking occurs.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The time period over which the attempts at achieving a State_of_affairs or acquiring the Sought_entity take place.
roles.Explanation: A proposition from which the occurrence of the seeking event follows.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Agent makes the attempt.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an attempt at achieving a State_of_affairs or at acquiring the Sought_entity is made.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the Agent is seeking to achieve a particular State_of_affairs or to acquire a Sought_entity.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by bringing about a particular State_of_affairs or acquiring the Sought_entity.
roles.Sought_entity: The entity that the Agent attempts to acquire.
roles.Source: An individual or organization that helps the Agent bring about the State_of_affairs or delivers the Sought_entity to the Agent.
roles.State_of_affairs: A state or event that the Agent wants to bring about.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the attempt occurs.

Self_control.def: An Agent actively (yet not always with success) attempts to keep themselves from participating in an Event.

roles.Agent: The Agent who tries to keep an Event from taking place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Event: The Event is the action or state of affairs that the Agent wishes to prevent.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is where the Agent attempts to prevent the Event from taking place.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Agent prevents the Event from taking place.

Self_motion.def: The Self_mover, a living being, moves under its own direction along a Path.

roles.Area: Area is used for expressions which describe a general area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular and not to consist of a sin
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Direction: The direction that the Self_mover heads in during the motion.
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
roles.Explanation: The state of affairs that leads to the particular motion that the Self_mover adopts.
roles.Goal: Goal is used for any expression which tells where the Self_mover ends up as a result of the motion.
roles.Manner: Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory or rate of motion expresses the frame element Manner.
roles.Means: An act whereby the Self_mover achieves movement.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: Path is used for any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal.
roles.Place: The Place is the location within which a defined motion takes place.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which a Self_mover moves.
roles.Result: Result of an event
roles.Self_mover: Self_mover is the living being which moves under its own power.
roles.Source: Source is used for any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion.
roles.Time: The time when the motion occurs.

Sending.def: A Sender plans the Path (along with Source and Goal) of a Theme and places it in circumstances such that it travels along this Path under the power of some entity other than the Sender.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for the sending. 'Letters are generally forwarded for several months because people are lazy about telling people their new location.'
roles.Goal: The end of the path and intended goal of the sending.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A spatial setting encomnpassing the Source location, where the Sending event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose of the sending. 'Rachel sent the letter to her mother to let her know about the marriage.'
roles.Recipient: This is the recipient of the sent Theme. Tess mailed a letter to Abby
roles.Sender: This is the person who initiates the movement of the Theme and, unlike Carrying, does not accompany it.
roles.Source: The beginning of the path, similar to source except that it serves to define the path.
roles.Theme: The objects being sent. I mailed the books to Alaska. Note that Theme may be multiply instantiated. They maileda questionnaire with a return envelope.
roles.Time: When the sending takes place 'I sent the letter to you last week.'
roles.Transport_means: The mode of sending employed. I shipped the crops by bigrig .

Sensation.def: This frame contains nouns that refer to sensations in different modalities.

roles.Body_part: This FE is assigned to phrases expressing the body part in which a sensation is located.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Ground: This FE is the perceptual background against which the Phenomenon is experienced by the Perceiver.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Perceiver_passive: This FE is only expressed with certain nouns in this frame, and then only with the help of a support verb, such as have: 'I have a tingling sensation in my hand
roles.Percept: The FE Percept is used for phrases that express the characteristic property of a sensation.
roles.Source: This is the entity or phenomenon which gives rise to the sensation.
roles.Time: The Time when the sensation is perceived.

Sent_items.def: A Sent_item is prepared for, received after, or involved in a process of Sending, which may involve a particular kind of Transport_means.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goal: The end of the path and intended goal of the sending.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place in which the Sent_item is located.
roles.Recipient: This is the recipient of the sent Sent_item 'He went to the study and examined his mail'
roles.Sent_item: The objects being sent. 'Today the post contained a pair of brand new tyres from Continental.'
roles.Source: The beginning of the path, similar to source except that it serves to define the path.
roles.Time: When an interaction with the Sent_item occurs.

Sentencing.def: During a court appearance, a Sentence, generally a punishment, is imposed on the Convict by a Court, usually represented by a judge.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Convict: The Convict is given a Sentence by the Court.
roles.Court: The Court imposes a Sentence on a Convict.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Offense: The illegal action of which the Convict has been found guilty and for which they are punished.
roles.Place: The location of the sentencing Court. 'Biancaniello will be sentenced in San Francisco later this summer.'
roles.Sentence: The Sentence is imposed on the Convict by the Court.
roles.Term_of_sentence: This FE denotes the duration of the sentence.
roles.Time: The Time when the Convict is sentenced. 'He will be sentenced at a later date.'

Separating.def: These words refer to separating a Whole into Parts, or separating one part from another.

roles.Agent: With causative uses of these verbs, an Agent separates or divides something.
roles.Cause: The Cause is the non-agent that brings about the separation.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: The Instrument used to cause the separation.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act of the Agent that accomplishes the separation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part_1: Part-1 is the first of two Parts mentioned.
roles.Part_2: Part_2 is the second of two Parts mentioned.
roles.Parts: This refers collectively to the Parts resulting from separation of a Whole: 'The directors split the company in two.' 'The teacher divided the children into gro
roles.Place: Where the separation occurs. 'You should separate the yolks from the whites over the sink.'
roles.Purpose: The Agent's intent for separating the Whole.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of an event.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the separation occurs.
roles.Whole: The Whole is a single entity or an aggregate of entities which is separated into Parts.

Sequence.def: The words in this frame describe entities that occur in some temporally-ordered sequence.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entities: Entities that occur in some temporal order.
roles.Entity_1: This entity occurs in some sequence with Entity_2.
roles.Entity_2: This entity occurs in some sequence with respect to Entity_1.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Relation_type: A characterization of the sequence in which the entities occur.

Serving_in_capacity.def: An Agent occupies a Role in some institution.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the entity that occpuies the Role.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration of time that the Agent occupies the Role.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Agent served in the Role.
roles.Role: The Role that the Agent occupies.
roles.Time: The Time when the Agent served in the Role.

Set_of_interrelated_entities.def: A group of Component_entities along with their interrelations is viewed as a Complex.

roles.Complex: The unit formed by the Component_entities.
roles.Component_entities: The entities that function together as a unit.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Setting_back_burn.def: A Firefighter sets a controlled fire to remove fuel from a currently incompletely controlled fire.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Firefighter: The Firefighter is the person making the firebreak.
roles.Flame: The Flame is what is created by the Firefighter.
roles.Flammables: The Flammables is the the object that is burned in the back fire.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: An event brought about by the Firefighter that actually makes the Flammables catch fire.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the event takes place.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.

Setting_fire.def: This frame describes either the creation of a Flame by a Kindler or non-sentient Cause, or the igniting of Flammables by a Kindler or a Cause.

roles.Cause: The cause of the fire. 'A spark ignited the curtains.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Flame: The Flame is what is created by the Kindler.
roles.Flammables: The Flamables is the the object that is set on fire by the Kindler.
roles.Kindler: The Kindler is the person performing the intentional act.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: An event brought about by the Cause or the Kindler that actually makes the Flammables catch fire.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the event takes place.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.

Setting_out.def: A Self_mover begins a journey at a Source location, in a particular Directiongenerally setting out with an Intended_goal in mind.

roles.Circumstances: The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the departing event itself and any of its participants, and is mere
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A factor which explains the particular motion or manner of motion of the Self_mover.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that an action occurs in a given time.
roles.Manner: Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion expresses the frame element Manner.
roles.Means: An event involving the Self_mover that results in the Self_mover moving in the specified way.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is where the motion (which is specified by a Source, Path or Goal) is located.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Self_mover wishes to bring about.
roles.Result: The state of the Self_mover at the end of the event.
roles.Self_mover: This is the entity which moves under its own power.
roles.Source: Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source.
roles.Time: The time at which the motion takes place.

Severity_of_offense.def: In this frame an Offense is described in terms of the legal or other punishing action that can be taken in response to the offense.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Offense: The Offense is the action, crime, or event which is described in terms of what legal or punishing action can be taken against the offender.

Sex.def: Participants in a Sex act engage in or are subjected to sexual contact.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE describes the length of time that an entire sexual encounter can last, including but not necessarily implying the length of all stages of the encounter.
roles.Manner: A description of the sex act which is not covered by more specific FEs.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which Participants accomplish a sexual act.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Participants: The set of entities engaged in or subjected to sexual contact.
roles.Place: To be clear: the place FE describes the overall location of the Participants of the sexual activity and nothing else.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the justification of a sexual act, for at least one of the Participants.
roles.Time: This FE relates the relative time of occurrence of the sexual activity.

Shaped_part.def: An entity is a shaped Part of a larger Whole.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part: A shaped Part of a larger Whole. 'Sergey put his arm on the arm of his armchair.'
roles.Whole: A Whole which has a shaped Part. 'The leg of the table came off when we moved it.'

Shapes.def: This frame contains words which describe the dimensional extent and Shape of a Substance.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Shape: This is the Shape that the Substance is in.'I ate a stick of butter.'
roles.Substance: A Substance of which pieces can be extracted.'Sue ate a big square of cake.'

Sharing.def: In this frame Protagonist_1 and Protagonist_2, collectively Protagonists, allow one another to partake jointly the use of an Entity .

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The object that is shared by the Protagonists.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Protagonists partake jointly in the use of the Entity.
roles.Protagonist_1: The participant that is encoded as the subject of an active-form sentence or as a by-PP in a passive, who partakes in the joint usage of the Entity.
roles.Protagonist_2: The participant in the reciprocal event that is coded in a with-PP, who partakes in the usage of the Entity along with Protagonist_1.
roles.Protagonists: The jointly expressed participants in the use of the Entity.
roles.Time: The time when the Protagonists share the Entity.

Sharpness.def: An Entity has a Sharpness characterized by its capability to cut.

roles.Attribute: The sharpness feature of the Entity.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the Circumstances under which the Entity has a particular value for the Sharpness.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: A modifier expressing the deviation of the Sharpness from the norm or from the value for another Entity.
roles.Entity: The Entity to which the Sharpness attribute is related.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Sharpness: The Sharpness value of the Entity. This FE is denoted by the adjectives of the frame.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular value for Sharpness.

Shoot_projectiles.def: An Agent causes a Firearm to discharge which induces the rapid motion of the Projectile.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person performing the intentional act causing the motion of the Projectile.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goal: This FE is the point at which the Theme ends up as a result of the motion.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.Means: An act of the Agent whereby the rapid motion of the Projectile is achieved.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the shooting event takes place.
roles.Projectile: The entity whose rapid, dangerous motion is caused by the Agent and/or Firearm.
roles.Purpose: The Agent's purpose in launching the Projectile 'We mistook a satellite launched to study earthquakes to be a missile, so we shot it down over the Pacific.'
roles.Source: This FE is the starting point of motion. Pat dragged the box out of the cupboard.
roles.Time: The Time when the shooting event takes place.

Shopping.def: A Shopper looks for Goods in order to purchase them.

roles.Co-participant: The Co-participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the shopping event with the Shopper.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goods: This is the entity that the Ground may contain.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the shopping action is done.
roles.Means: An act of the Shopper that allows them to look for (and perhaps purchase) the Goods.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A spatial setting larger than the Ground in which the Shopping event occurs.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Shopper intends to accomplish by performing the search.
roles.Shopper: The person who attempts to find the Goods.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the shopping occurs.

Short_selling.def: Short selling, a common financial market concept, involves an Intermediary selling Assets to the Market, having borrowed these Assets from a (generally implicit) Lender.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Intermediary: The entity that is the borrower to the Lender and the seller and later repurchaser to the Market.
roles.Lender: The original owner and soon to be Lender of the Assets.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Market: The aggregate selling place of many types of financial stocks, bond, securities, etc.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Intermediary acts intentionally.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place at which the short selling occurs.
roles.Purpose: The situation that the Intermediary wishes to bring about by short selling.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time at which the Intermediary engages in short selling.

Sidereal_appearance.def: An Astronomical_entity comes into view above the horizon as part of a regular, periodic process of (apparent) motion of the Astronomical_entity across the sky.

roles.Astronomical_entity: An entity which is periodically visible from the earth's surface.
roles.Circumstances: A setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the appearance of the Astronomical_entity takes place 'The Sun rose with just a few clouds along the eastern
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: FN: The amount of times the Astronomical_entity appears per unit of time.
roles.Goal: The Goal is the location above the horizon that the Astronomical_entity ends up in.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the motion of the Astronomical_entity takes place.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place from which the motion of the Astronomical_entity is viewed.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of the Astronomical_entity's motion.
roles.Source: The Source is the location the Astronomical_entity is construed to occupy before coming above the horizon.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Astronomical_entity appears.

Sign.def: A phenomenon, the Indicator, exists as an indication of another phenomenon, the Indicated.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: This FE depicts how often the Indicated manifests itself.
roles.Indicated: The phenomenon that is signified by the Indicator.
roles.Indicator: The phenomenon that signifies the Indicated.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Sign_agreement.def: A Signatory signs an Agreement document, thereby taking on a commitment encoded in the Agreement.

roles.Agreement: The document which encodes the commitment of the Signatory.
roles.Beneficiary: his extrathematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate.
roles.Co-participant: The Co-participant signs the Agreement along with the Signatory.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for putting signature to paper.
roles.Instrument: An entity directed by the Signatory that interacts with the Agreement document so as to produce the Signature.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably), and general descript
roles.Means: This FE identifies the action whereby the Signatory achieves the signing of the Agreement.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the signing occurs.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Signatory commits to the Agreement.
roles.Role: The category of the Signatory in the Sign_agreement event.
roles.Signatory: The signatory of the Agreement. 'Eisenhower signed a treaty with aliens.'
roles.Signature: The entity signifying the identity of the Signatory, resulting from the act of writing on the Agreement document.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time at which signature is given.

Silencing.def: An Agent causes a Speaker to become silent, sometimes about a particular Topic.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person performing the intentional act.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Expressor: The Expressor is the Speaker's voice or other communicative noise emitted by the Speaker.
roles.Instrument: The instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Manner: Any description of the silencing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and gene
roles.Means: An act whereby the Agent silences the Speaker.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Result: The Result is the final state of the Speaker.
roles.Speaker: The sentient entity that is not communicating.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Similarity.def: Two or more distinct entities, which may be concrete or abstract objects or types, are characterized as being similar to each other.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Differentiating_fact: A fact about Entity_1 or the Entities that reveals how Entity_1 is the same or different from other entities.
roles.Dimension: This FE marks constituents which express a property in respect to which the similarity of the entities is assessed.
roles.Entities: This FE marks constituents that express the set of objects or types whose similarity is at issue.
roles.Entity_1: When there is an asymmetry, Entity_1 is the entity characterized by its similarity to Entity_2, whose characteristics are assumed to be known.
roles.Entity_2: When the Entities are expressed separately, Entity_2 is the one whose characteristics are assumed to be known; it serves as a basis for establishing characteris
roles.Explanation: An inanimate entity or process that causes the similarity.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which Dimension is similar or different
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the general area in which similarity occurs or exists
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the similarity occurs or exists.

Simple_name.def: A Term is the linguistic sign conventionally used by a Speaker to refer to a type of Entity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The type of Entity that is conventionally referred to by a Term.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Term: The linguistic sign that is used for referring to a type of Entity.

Simple_naming.def: A Speaker conventionally uses a particular Term to refer to an Entity.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The type of Entity that is conventionally referred to by a Term.
roles.Explanation: A reason for why the Term used for the Entity is the one chosen.
roles.Frequency: How often the Speaker uses the Term referring to the Entity.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Speaker: The speaker or speech community that uses a Term to refer to a particular Entity.
roles.Term: The linguistic sign that is used for referring to a type of Entity.

Simultaneity.def: Two Events happen at the same time. This may either be construed symmetrically as a relation holding between the Events, or asymmetrically as holding between a Landmark_event whose known occurrence is used to describe when a Profiled_event

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Events: The states-of-affairs which are asserted to be co-timed.
roles.Landmark_event: The event or time period whose timing the Profiled_event is judged against.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Profiled_event: The event which is asserted to occur at the same time as the Landmark_event.

Size.def: The size of an Entity is assessed in terms of the Degree by which it deviates from the norm.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dimension: The feature of an (actual or possible) Entity that is measured.
roles.Entity: The thing whose size is being considered.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Sleep.def: The Sleeper stays in an altered state of consciousness with greatly reduced external awareness.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
roles.Manner: Any description of the sleeping event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondar
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the sleep occurs.

Smuggling.def: The words in this frame describe situations in which the Perpetrator secretly takes Goods into or out of a country or other area which are prohibited by law or on which one has not paid the required duty.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that a smuggling event occurs.
roles.Goal: Goal is the location the Goods end up in.
roles.Goods: The FE Goods is anything (including labor, time, or legal rights) that can be illegally taken into our out of a country.
roles.Manner: A description of the Event not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same
roles.Means: An act of the Perpetrator which allows them to smuggle the Goods.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: The path refers to (a part of the) ground the Goods travel over or to a landmark the Goods travel by.
roles.Perpetrator: This is the person (or other agent) that illegally takes the goods into or out of a country.
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The action that the Perpetrator is trying to accomplish by the act of smuggling.
roles.Source: The source is the location the goods occupy initially before change of location.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Soaking.def: In this frame, an Agent places the Theme in the Medium for an extended period of time, with the intent that the Theme will be affected by and absorb some of the Medium.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person performing the soaking.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the Theme is soaked.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Agent soaks the Theme.
roles.Means: The action of the Agent that brings about the soaking.
roles.Medium: Medium is the substance in which the Theme is submerged.'Bobby soaked the potatoes in water overnight.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the submerging occurs.
roles.Purpose: The situation that the Agent hopes to bring about by soaking the Theme.
roles.Theme: The Theme is the entity that changes location.
roles.Time: The Time when the Agent soaks the Theme.

Soaking_up.def: An Item becomes filled with a Substance as a result of movement of liquid into visible or invisible interstices in the Item.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: For what length of time the Item is imbued with Substance.
roles.Item: The Item is the absorbant friendly thing that takes in the Substance.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Item soaks in the Substance.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Item takes in Substance.
roles.Substance: The Substance is the material that is taken in by the Item.
roles.Time: When the Item takes in Substance.

Sociability.def: These words describe how outgoing or sociable a Protagonist is judged to be by a (usually implicit) Judge, often in a particular context, either with certain people (the Company), or about a particular situation, topic or event (the Content

roles.Company: The Protagonist may be sociable, shy, outgoing, etc.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: The Protagonist may be sociable, shy, outgoing, etc.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Protagonist: The Protagonist is the person whose sociability is being described.

Social_connection.def: A mutual social and personal relationship that keeps people involved in each other's lives comprises a Connection of Individual1 to Individual2 or between Individuals.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Connection: Connection is the personal relationship between Individuals that keeps them involved in each other's lives.
roles.Individual_1: Individual1 has a social Connection to Individual_2.
roles.Individual_2: Individual2 has a relationship to Individual_1.
roles.Individuals: Individuals have a Connection with each other.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Social_desirability.def: This frame contains LUs which are like those of the Desirability frame except the Evaluee incorporates the Parameter as "associated with a percieved place in a social heirarchy" for all LUs.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions under which the quality of the Evaluee is being judged.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: The Evaluee is being judged for its quality.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Social_event.def: A Social_event occurs at which Attendees are present to conduct a social function or joint activity.

roles.Attendee: Attendee is used for the people who come to the Social_event.
roles.Beneficiary: The person for whom the Social_event is held.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Social_event is ongoing.
roles.Frequency: This FE describes how often the Social_event occurs.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Social_event occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Social_event occurs.
roles.Purpose: The reason the Social_event is being held.
roles.Social_event: This FE identifies the Social_event itself.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Social_event occurs.

Social_event_collective.def: This frames describes a social event where there may or may not be a permanent or semi-permanent relationship between participants.

roles.Attendees: The Attendees are the collectively construed participants of the social event.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the social event is ongoing.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the social event occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the social event occurs.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the social event occurs.

Social_event_individuals.def: This frames describes a social event where there may or may not be a permanent or semi-permanent relationship between participants.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the social event is ongoing.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the social event occurs.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Party_1: Party_1 is the grammatically more prominent participant in the social event.
roles.Party_2: Party_2 is the grammatically less prominent participant in the social event.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the social event occurs.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the social event occurs.

Social_interaction_evaluation.def: In this frame an Evaluee is judged by a (usually implicit) Judge to be of a certain character based on her or his Behavior towards other human beings; a specific Affected_party may be overtly mentioned along with the Degree to which the Eva

roles.Affected_party: The Affected_party is the entity which is positively or negatively treated by the Evaluee.
roles.Behavior: The Behavior is the action of the Evaluee on which the evaluation of the Evaluee's character is based.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: The Evaluee is the person whose Behavior towards other human beings is being evaluated.
roles.Expressor: The Expressor is the body part or action by a body part which indicates the character of the Evaluee.
roles.Judge: The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the evaluation denoted by the target.
roles.Manner: The Manner is the way in which the Evaluee embodies the characteristic ascribed to her or him.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Topic: The Topic is the situation or person that the Evaluee's Behavior responds to or is related to.

Sole_instance.def: An Item is the only instance of its Type.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Item: An Item is alone in its category.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Type: Type specifies a category which in principle could apply to multiple items, but which is limited to the Item.

Sound_level.def: An Entity is judged by a sound Attribute of some perceived level of Volume intensity.

roles.Attribute: The feature of an Entity which is under consideration.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Volume for the Attribute.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: A modifier expressing the deviation of the Volume from the norm.
roles.Entity: The Entity for which the sound level Attribute is under consideration.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where an Entity is located.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular Volume for the Attribute.
roles.Volume: A quantity or characterization of the Entity's sound output with repspect to its Attribute.

Sound_movement.def: A Sound emitted by a Sound_source, which construed as a single point, moves along a Path.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goal: A description of the location where the Sound ends up.
roles.Location_of_sound_source: The location of the Sound_source from which the Sound travels 'The Prince 's laugh echoed from the corridor.'
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Sound moves. 'The scream reverberated around the house like the scream of a soul in pain'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: The Path of the Sound's movement is any description of its trajectory of motion which is neither a Location_of_sound_source or a Goal.
roles.Place: A setting in which Sound movement happens.
roles.Sound: A percept produced in hearing organs by vibrations which travel through the air or another medium.
roles.Sound_source: The point-like entity which produces the Sound.
roles.Time: The time when the Sound movement occurs. ' In the mornings the harsh , squawking voices of the gulls echo between the channel walls'

Sounds.def: This frame is concerned with the percepts that vibrations which travel through the air or another medium produce in hearing organs.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE idntifies the Explanation that the Sound_source produces the sound.
roles.Manner: Certain properties of the sound relating to its production, loudness, etc may be of lexicographic interest if they describe properties of a sounds as such: loud
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which sound is produced. This FE differs from Location_of_sound_source in that it does not highlight the sound's spreading from its source to th
roles.Sound_source: An entity that is construed as a single point source emitting sound.

Source_of_getting.def: A Goal has a Source from which it has gotten a Theme.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Goal: An entity or individual that has acquired a Theme from the Source.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Source: A concrete or abstract entity from which the Goal has gotten the Theme.
roles.Theme: The abstact or concrete thing acquired by the Goal from the Source.

Spatial_co-location.def: A Figure is located essentially at the same location as a Ground, which is viewed as point-like, or having no important internal or external structure.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Figure: The Figure is perceived as located relative to a certain Ground location.
roles.Ground: The Ground serves as a basis for describing the location of the Figure.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The period of time during which the locative relation between Figure and Ground obtains.

Spatial_contact.def: A Figure is located in contact with a Ground.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Figure: The Figure is perceived as located relative to a certain Ground location.
roles.Figures: The Figures are items which mutually serve to identify the location of each other.
roles.Ground: The Ground serves as a basis for describing the location of the Figure.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The period of time during which the locative relation between Figure and Ground obtains.

Speak_on_topic.def: A Speaker addresses an Audience on a particular Topic.

roles.Audience: The person or persons to whom the Speaker delivers their text.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: Denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically followes.
roles.Manner: The Manner is a description of the Speaker's speech.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place describes the location where the speaking occurs.
roles.Speaker: The person who orally delivers a text about a Topic to a passive Audience.
roles.Time: The Time describes when the speaking occurs.
roles.Topic: What the text that the Speaker produces is about.

Specific_individual.def: LUs in this frame denote that the Instance of a Type is contextually notable.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instance: The notable case of the Type.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Type: The class of items within which the Instance is made salient.

Speed_description.def: An Entity is in motion at a particular Speed, a momentaneous description of distance traveled per time.

roles.Attribute: The feature of an Entity which is a function of the distance that the Entity moves in a given duration.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the Circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Speed.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: A modifier expressing the deviation of the Speed from the norm.
roles.Entity: The Entity whose Speed is under consideration.
roles.Explanation: The reason why the Entity or Attribute is ata certain speed.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Speed: A quantity or other characterization of the Entity's speed.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular Speed.

Spelling_and_pronouncing.def: A Speaker realizes a Sign, usually a linguistic one, in some Formal_realization.

roles.Addressee: The person that the Speaker is producing the Formal_realization for.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: Denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically followes.
roles.Formal_realization: The written string, gesture, or vocalized sound sequence that the Speaker produces.
roles.Frequency: The amount of times the Sign is spelled or pronounced per some unit of time.
roles.Judgment: An evaluation of whether the Formal_realization that the Speaker produced matches the standard or standard range.
roles.Manner: The way that the Speaker produces the Formal_realization.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part_of_form: A constituent part of the Formal_realization.
roles.Sign: An abstract form-meaning pairing. 'My little nephew can't say prestidigitation'
roles.Speaker: The language user who produces a Sign in some modality.
roles.Time: The time when the Speaker produces the Formal_realization.

Sports_jargon.def: This frame contains LUs that have to do with the terminology used in competitive sports until a more complete, domain specific series of frames are created for the respective sport.

roles.Agent: This FE is used for plural NP participants in a competition.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Stage_of_progress.def: An Entity is at a particular stage of its development.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The object that has reached a particular stage of its development.
roles.Manner: A description of the stage of progress, frequently an evaluation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The time at which the progress occurs.

Standing_by.def: A Protagonist waits for an Expected_request, and is prepared to respond to the request when it comes by engaging in an Activity.

roles.Activity: The Protagonist is prepared to conduct an Activity in response to the Expected_request.
roles.Co-participant: Co-participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the waiting event with the Protagonist.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the waiting to its end.
roles.Expected_request: The Expected_request is what triggers the Protagonist to proceed with an appropriate action.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the occurrence of the waiting event logically follows.
roles.Manner: Any description of the waiting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient chara
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Protagonist is waiting.
roles.Protagonist: The sentient being who delays action until an Expected_request has been received.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Protagonist intends to accomplish by standing by.
roles.Salient_entity: A concrete or abstract entity that the Protagonist expects to participate in an Expected_request, typically the party that makes the request of the Protagonist.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Protagonist is waiting for the request.

State_continue.def: Despite some implication that a State would be interrupted, the Entity remains in the specified State.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the State continues.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The time period over which the State continues to hold of the Entity.
roles.Entity: A concrete or abstract Entity.
roles.Explanation: The state of affairs that explains why the State persists.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Entity is in the State.
roles.Time: The Time when the State is found to still persist.

State_of_entity.def: An Entity is in a specified State. When not explicitly specified, the State usually concerns the Entity's health, repair, or functioning. The State is also often assessed with an Evaluation and it may be specified to apply only to a particu

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The entity whose State is specified and/or evaluated.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State: A relation in which the Entity participates or a property that the Entity possesses.

Statement.def: This frame contains verbs and nouns that communicate the act of a Speaker to address a Message to some Addressee using language.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee is the person to whom the Message is communicated.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: This FE is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: The Manner of performing an action.
roles.Means: An act whereby the Speaker makes a Message.
roles.Medium: Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Speaker to transmit the statement.
roles.Message: The Message is the FE that identifies the content of what the Speaker is communicating to the Addressee.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The FE specifies the location where the Message takes place.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker is the sentient entity that produces the Message (whether spoken or written).
roles.Time: The Time at which the Message is made.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the subject matter to which the Message pertains.

Stimulus_focus.def: In this frame either a Stimulus brings about a particular emotion or experience in the Experiencer or saliently fails to bring about a particular experience.

roles.Circumstances: This FE marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions under which the Stimulus is able to bring about the emotion.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Stimulus: The Stimulus is the object or event which brings about the emotion in the Experiencer.

Stinginess.def: In this frame, a Resource_controller is judged by a Judge (who is usually implicit) according to how freely they allow the Recipient access to their Resource.

roles.Behavior: The Behavior is an action of the Resource_controller which is judged to be generous or stingy.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Expressor: The Expressor is the body part or action by a body part which indicates the character of the Resource_controller.
roles.Manner: A characterization of the way in which the Resource_controller exhibits stinginess.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Recipient: The Recipient is the individual or individuals who receive or should receive the Resource from the Resource_controller.
roles.Resource: The Resource_controller controls the Recipient's access to the Resource.
roles.Resource_controller: The Resource_Controller is the individual who controls access to the Resource.

Store.def: A Supply of a Resource is kept safe and available for a future Use.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
