roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Possessor: The entity that possesses the Supply. 'In 1997, France's stock of unirradiated civil plutonium increased to 72 tons.'
roles.Resource: The goods or commodity that is being stored in a Supply.
roles.Supply: This FE denotes the Supply of Resources. It is incorporated into each LU in this frame.
roles.Use: The future Use for the Resource. 'Due to restrictions imposed by our export control, the Japanese have begun to use a portion of their war reserve of petroleum.

Storing.def: An Agent has placed a Theme in an accessible but somewhat out of the way Location for the purposes of maintaining it free from harm and illegitimate use while it is not being used.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person who has placed the Theme in the Location.
roles.Co-participant: Co-participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the storing event either as a co-agent or a co-theme.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The Duration is the amount of time for which the Theme remains in the Location.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the storing event logically follows.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Location: The location where the Theme is kept. Some, though not all, LUs in this frame incorporate this FE.
roles.Manner: Any description of the storing state which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient chara
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place indicates where the Storing occurs.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by perform the storing action.
roles.Theme: The Theme is the object that is kept in a Location by the Agent
roles.Time: Time is the time period during which the Theme is stored.

Strictness.def: These adjectives describe the degree of strictness or tolerance of an Agent, usually with regard to another person (the Controllee) and often with regard to a particular Issue.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the person who is strict or liberal in his/her control over another.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Controlled_entity: The Agent's strictness may be directed towards or limited to some particular person or group over whom he/she has control.
roles.Controlling_act: The Agent's strictness may be manifested in particular behavior: The judge was lenient in dealing with the offender.
roles.Expressor: The body part or expression of the Agent that indicates their strictness.
roles.Issue: The Agent may be strict or lenient with respect to a particular matter or situation.
roles.Manner: The Manner is the way in which the Agent embodies the strictness associated with him or her.
roles.Medium: A Medium of control, such as rules, may also be described as strict or lenient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Studying.def: A Student enrolls and then remains at an Institution for the purposes of education within a Subject.

roles.Co-participant: Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the Studying event.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time for which the process of study is ongoing.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Student studies the Subject.
roles.Institution: An educational establishment, such as a school or college.
roles.Manner: The manner of studying that the Student has.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the location within which the studying takes place.
roles.Student: One who receives instruction from a Teacher or Institution.
roles.Subject: The area of knowledge or skill which is taught to a Student.
roles.Teacher: One who instructs a Student in some area of knowledge or skill.
roles.Time: The time when the student is studying.

Suasion.def: A Speaker succeeds in getting an Addressee to believe or plan to execute the Content the Speaker has in mind.

roles.Addressee: The person that the Speaker seeks to influence to act.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: The wish for action on the Addressee's part that the Speaker expresses.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Speaker suades the Addressee.
roles.Means: An act of the Speaker that accomplishes the persuasion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Speaker suades the Addressee.
roles.Speaker: The person who intends through the use of language to get another person to act.
roles.Text: A piece of written or spoken material that changes the mind of the Addressee.
roles.Time: When the Speaker suades the Addressee.
roles.Topic: The general item or items that are the focus of the Content of the Speaker's message.

Subjective_influence.def: An Agent, Situation or Entity has an influence on a Cognizer.

roles.Action: An Action that the Cognizer decides to carry out as a consequence of the influence of a Situation or Entity.
roles.Agent: The Agent acts to influence a Cognizer.
roles.Behavior: A Behavior that the Cognizer is engaged in independently but whose execution is subsequently influenced by the Situation or Entity.
roles.Cognizer: The person who is influenced by the Situation or Entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: A person or thing that has an influence on the Cognizer.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which one has influence. 'Chavez has much influence in South America.'
roles.Product: An entity that stands metonymically for the actions and considerations that produced it.
roles.Situation: A state of affairs--- which can be an event, state or conditions---that has an influence on the Cognizer.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Subjective_influencing event occurs.

Subjective_temperature.def: An Experiencer senses different degrees of warmth that may or may not be related to the ambient temperature.

roles.Body_part: A part of the body of the Experiencer in which the sensation of a temperature is located.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Experiencer: The entity which perceives a level of warmth.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Submitting_documents.def: A Submittor gives Documents to an Authority so that they can be processed as part of an application, evaluation or other official or bureaucratic process.

roles.Authority: The individual or organization that ends up in possession of the Documents and processes them.
roles.Beneficiary: This extra-thematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Documents: The artifacts containing content, typically in the form of text and images, that the Submittor gives to the Authority.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which event of the Submittor's giving the Documents to the Authority logically follows.
roles.Manner: The Manner is the manner in which the Submittor gives the Documents to the Authority.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Submittor gives the Documents to the Authority.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the Submittor gives the Documents to the Authority.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Submittor gives the Documents to the Authority.
roles.Submittor: The person that begins in possession of the Documents and gives them over into the possession of the Authority for processing.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Submittor gives the Documents to the Authority.

Subordinates_and_superiors.def: Two individuals, the Subordinate and the Superior have a relationship such that the Subordinate generally follows orders given by the Superior and has the best interests of the Superior in mind.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Subordinate: The individual under the command of the Superior.
roles.Superior: The individual in charge of the Subordinate.

Subsisting.def: An Entity survives a situation with some Support, which tends to be far below the accustomed or standard level expected.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time that the Entity survives with the help of the Support.
roles.Entity: The living organism which requires the Support to survive.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Support: The resource that the Entity relies on to survive through a situation.

Substance.def: This frame concerns internally undifferentiated Substances.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Substance: The undifferentiated entity which is presented as having a permanent existence.

Substance_by_phase.def: In this frame a Patient is in a phase brought about after a change of phase.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Substance: The Substance is the entity which has had its phase altered.

Subversion.def: A Counter_actor or Cause impedes an Agent in an Activity or impedes the unfolding or continuation of a State_of_affairs.

roles.Activity: An Activity that is being impeded. 'The Dominican Republic was widely held to have undermined its own efforts to become a full member of CARICOM'
roles.Agent: A person who is intentionally engaged in some Activity and who is impeded in that Activity.
roles.Cause: An event or state_of_Affairs that successfully impedes an Agent or a State_of_affairs.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Counter_actor: A person who intentionally or not acts in such a way that an Agent or State_of_affairs is impeded.
roles.Frequency: This FE denotes the number of times the Counter_actor or Cause subverts the Agent per unit of time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: An action performed by the Counter_actor or an event related to the Cause that enables the subversion.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Counter_actor subverts an Activity.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Counter_actor hopes will result from his undermining.
roles.State_of_affairs: A state or event that is ongoing and whose continuance or unfolding is impeded.
roles.Time: The time at which the Counter_actor or Cause works agains the Agent.

Success_or_failure.def: An Agent has attempted to achieve a Goal, and the actual outcome of the Agent's action has been resolved, so that it either specifically matches the Agent's intent (e.g.

roles.Agent: The Agent makes an attempt to achieve a Goal.
roles.Circumstances: This FE is applied to expressions which indicate the prevailing physical conditions for the event, or some concurrent states of affairs.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the success or failure logically follows.
roles.Goal: The Goal is what the Agent attempts to achieve.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Goal is achieved (or not).
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where an attempt succeeds or fails.
roles.Role: A participant function in a particular event or in events of a particular kind.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the attempt succeeds or fails.

Successful_action.def: The Means action by which a deprofiled agent (the Protagonist) has attempted to achieve a Goal, is finished and the actual outcome of the Means action has been resolved, so that it either specifically matches the Protagonist's intent (e.g.

roles.Circumstances: The FE Circumstances encodes a setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the successful action expressed by the target takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the success or failure logically follows.
roles.Goal: The Goal is what the agent attempts to achieve by performing the Means action.
roles.Instrument: An entity directed by the agent as part of the Means action in order to accomplish the Goal.
roles.Means: The action that the agent undertakes to achieve the Goal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where Means action succeeds or fails.
roles.Role: A participant function of an Instrument or Means in a particular event or in events of a particular kind.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the attempt succeeds or fails ' But it did the trick at the time.'

Successfully_communicate_message.def: A Communicator speaks to an Addressee in such a way that the Addressee understands and fully appreciates the truth and/or relevance of the Message.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee receives a Message from the Communicator.
roles.Communicator: The person who uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey a Message to another person.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Communicator communicates.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Communicator communicates.
roles.Medium: The physical or abstract setting in which the Message is conveyed.
roles.Message: Message A proposition or set of propositions that the Communicator wants the Addressee to believe or take for granted.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The time at which the communication takes place.

Sufficiency.def: An Item is located on a Scale relative to a critical value which is determined by some Enabled_situation.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Enabled_situation: This FE identifies the Enabled_situation by which the critical value is judged.
roles.Item: The entity whose scalar property is specified.'The light is probably bright enough.''I have sufficient paper for the purpose.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Scale: The Scale is the attribute of the Item that is being described.'It was hot enough to ignite the iron.''The workforce is sufficient in number and proficiency to

Suicide_attack.def: An Assailant attacks a Victim, intending to die in the process.

roles.Assailant: The person (or other self-directed entity) that is attempting physical harm to the Victim.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, soft
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Assailant that accomplishes the assault.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Assailant makes an assault on the Victim.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Assailant attacks the Victim.
roles.Result: The Result of the attack on the Victim by the Assailant.
roles.Source: The starting-point of the motion of the Assailant or projectiles of the Assailant as they move toward the the Place that the Victim is occupying in the attack.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Assailant attacks the Victim.
roles.Victim: This Victim is the being or entity that is injured by the Assailant's suicide attack.

Suitability.def: This Frame is concerned with evaluating an Evaluee as being suitable for a Purpose or a User, presupposing some choice that is being made about which Evaluee to use for the Purpose or User.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: This Frame Element marks constituents expressing the entity that is judged to be more or less suitable for some Purpose or User.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: This Frame Element marks constituents that express the Purpose for which the Evaluee is judged to be suitable or unsuitable.
roles.User: This FE marks expressions that indicate a User to whom

Summarizing.def: A Communicator processes some information (either from textual or real-world/perceptual sources) regarding a State_of_affairs into a concise form (a summary) that contains the essential content in briefer form, and communicates this summary

roles.Addressee: The Communicator communicates the summary to the Addressee.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Communicator: The Communicator creates and communicates the summary of the Information.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time taken by the Communicator in creating and conveying the Summary.
roles.Manner: Any description of the details of the action beyond the identity of the participants and the setting, especially descriptions of the Communicator that affect th
roles.Means: An action performed by the Communicator that brings about the communication.
roles.Medium: The textual or other Medium through which the Communicator summarizes.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Communicator communicates.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Communicator is attempting to bring about by communicating.
roles.State_of_affairs: The State_of_affairs is summarized by the Communicator.
roles.Time: The time at which the Communicator makes the Summary.

Supply.def: A Supplier gives a Theme to a Recipient to fulfill a need or purpose (Imposed_purpose) of the Recipient.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are the conditions under which the Theme is supplied.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Supplier gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Imposed_purpose: The Recipient's intended purpose for the Theme.
roles.Manner: Any description of the supplying event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), seconda
roles.Means: The Means by which the Supplier acquires or gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the Supplier gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Supplier gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Recipient: The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
roles.Source: The source of the Theme. 'We equipped them from our own supply of equipment.'
roles.Supplier: The person that begins in possession of the Theme and causes it to be in the possession of the Recipient.
roles.Theme: The object that is given to the Recipient .
roles.Time: The Time is when the Supplier gives the Theme to the Recipient.

Supporting.def: A Supporter assists to strengthen the Supported by lending itself in material aid (or abstract assistance in the case of metaphorical uses).

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The time period during which the Supporter supports the Supported.
roles.Explanation: A state-of-affairs from which the accomplishment would be predicted.
roles.Instrument: An entity used by the Supporter in service of the Supported's strength by support.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which a Supporter supports the Supported.
roles.Means: An action that the Supporter undertakes in service of the Supported's strengthening.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the support occurs.
roles.Purpose: The situation that the Supporter wishes to bring about by supporting the Supported.
roles.Supported: The Supported is given strength through the assistance of the Supporter.
roles.Supporter: The Supporter acts to benefit the Supported by providing additional strength or stability.
roles.Time: This FE identifies when the support occurs.

Surpassing.def: In this frame a Profiled_item is higher that its Standard_item on a scale with respect to some Attribute.

roles.Attribute: The Attribute is a property that evokes a scale along which the Item is located closer to one extreme in comparison to the Standard_item.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Profiled_attribute: The Profiled_attribute is a particular value on a scale which is being compared to an Attribute or Standard_item.
roles.Profiled_item: The Profiled_item is the entity that is located closest to the end of the scale evoked by some Attribute.
roles.Standard_attribute: The Standard_attribute is used when the standard is a specific value on a scale.
roles.Standard_item: The FE Standard_item denotes the entities that are exceeded by the Item with regard to the Attribute.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Item is higher on the scale than the Standard.

Surrendering.def: In this frame a Fugitive presents himself or herself to the Authorities to be subject to the criminal process.

roles.Authorities: The Authorities are the officials, government or otherwise, who are in charge of initiating the criminal process.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE denotes a proposition from which the surrendering event logically follows.
roles.Fugitive: The Fugitive is wanted by the Authorities and turns himself or herself in to the Authorities.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Fugitive surrenders to the Authorities.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is the location where the surrendering occurs.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Fugitive surrenders.

Surrendering_possession.def: A Surrenderer is compelled to transfer a Theme to a Recipient.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the Surrendering event itself and any of its
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE denotes a proposition from which the surrendering event logically follows.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: The Manner is the manner in which the Surrenderer gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Means: The Means by which the Surrenderer gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the Surrenderer gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Surrenderer gives the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Recipient: The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
roles.Result: This FE identifies the Result of an surrendering event.
roles.Surrenderer: The person compelled to transfer the Theme to the Recipient.
roles.Theme: The object that changes possession.
roles.Time: The Time is when the Surrenderer gives the Theme to the Recipient.

Surrounding.def: A Figure surrounds a Ground. The Ground location is presented as more likely to be a known location than the location of the Figure. Some lexical units entail more-or-less complete surrounding in two or three dimensions (e.g. surround.v), w

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Figure: The Figure is the entity located with respect to the Ground.
roles.Ground: The Ground is the area that the Figure surrounds.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Profiled_region: The area or zone immediately external to the Ground.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Figure is located around the Ground.

Surviving.def: A Survivor manages to avoid being negatively affected, despite encountering a Dangerous_situation.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Dangerous_situation: The Dangerous_situation is one in which people are likely or expected to be negatively affected.
roles.Means: An action performed by the Survivor that enables them to live throug hthe Dangerous_situation.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Survivor (primarily) lives during the Dangerous_situation.
roles.Survivor: The Survivor lives through a Dangerous_situation.
roles.Time: The time at which the surviving takes place.

Suspicion.def: A person or group, the Authority, believes that another person, the Suspect is a participant in a criminal Incident.

roles.Authority: The Authority is the group or person who suspects the Suspect of criminal activity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Incident: The (typically criminal) Incident in which the Suspect is suspected of being involved.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Suspect: The Suspect is the target of the Authority's suspicion.
roles.Time: When the suspecting takes place. 'Jakobson was placed under suspicion last week .' 'At that time, the police suspected no one.'

System.def: A Complex with a particular Function is formed out of Component_entities.

roles.Complex: The unit formed by the Component_entities.
roles.Component_entities: The entities that function together as a unit.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Function: The activity that the Complex entity performs by virtue of its Component_entities interacting.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Salient_entity: The kind of entity that the Complex operates on as part of its Function.

System_complexity.def: A System is perceived as complex depending on the intricacy of the interconnectivty of its parts or components.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.System: The complete entity or system whose complexity is under consideration.

Take_place_of.def: A New filler occupies a Role or serves a Function after the Old filler ceases to occupy the position.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Function: The (generally desirable) state of affairs that the New and Old entities are involved in bringing about.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descri
roles.New: The new filler of the Role that was previously occupied by the Old filler.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Old: The entity that occupied the Role or served the Function before the New filler.
roles.Role: The category that the New and Old entities fit into as a result of the Function they serve.
roles.Time: The time at which the New takes up the Role previously occupied by the Old.

Taking.def: An Agent removes a Theme from a Source so that the it is in the Agent's possession.

roles.Agent: The person who takes possession of the Theme.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for the taking. 'Milton took the champagne out of the ice because it was getting too cold.'
roles.Manner: The Manner of the taking. 'Milton stealthily took the can of beer out of the refrigerator.'
roles.Means: The intermediate action taken by the Agent to take the Theme.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the taking takes place. 'Police seized several tons of marijuana in Berkeley last weekend.'
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for the taking. 'Milton took the can of beer out of the refrigerator to make sure no one else took it.'
roles.Source: The location of the Theme prior to the taking.
roles.Theme: The Agent takes possession of the Theme. 'Milton took the can of beer out of the refrigerator.'
roles.Time: When the taking takes place. 'The government seizure of a suspected dissident's computer last November has increased the tension between citizens and law enforc

Taking_captive.def: An Agent begins preventing a Captive from moving despite a tendency or desire on the part of the Captive to do so.

roles.Agent: The Agent brings the Captive into custody.
roles.Captive: The entity which is captured. 'Police have captured three of the suspected bombers after a week-long search.'
roles.Cause: The Cause is the non-sentient entity which is responsible for restricting the movement or location of the Captive.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in capturing the Captive.
roles.Instrument: The instrument with which the capturing is carried out.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Agent takes the Captive into custody.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Taking_sides.def: A Cognizer has a relatively fixed positive or negative point of view towards an Issue.

roles.Action: An action taken by a Side or a view that the Side takes on an issue which the Cognizer either supports or opposes.
roles.Cognizer: The individual that holds an opinion on an Issue or Side.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is a proposition denoting a state of affairs from which the Cognizer's taking the indicated view on the Issue logically follows.
roles.Issue: The matter, usually concerning a course of action, which the Cognizer has a positive or negative opinion about.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Taking_sides which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Cognizer takes Sides on an Issue .
roles.Side: The party or individual (generally associated with a particular position on an Issue) that the Cognizer has an opinion about.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Cognizer has the indicated point of view towards the Issue.

Taking_time.def: An Activity takes some Time_length to complete.

roles.Activity: The event which requires some Time_length for completion.
roles.Agent: The individual who performs the Activity.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the Circumstances under which the Activity takes a particular amount of time.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: A modifier expressing the deviation of the Time_length from the norm.
roles.Duration: Duration is the length of time from the beginning of the Activity to its end.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Time: The Time at which the Activity takes place.
roles.Time_length: The amount of time required for the Activity.

Talking_into.def: A Speaker expresses through language his wish to get the Addressee to act.

roles.Addressee: The person that the Speaker seeks to influence to act.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: The wish for action on the Addressee's part that the Speaker expresses.
roles.Instrument: An entity that the Speaker manipulates to get the Addressee to perform the Content.
roles.Means: Act of the Speaker that enables them to persuade the Addressee.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Speaker talks the Addressee into performing the Content.
roles.Purpose: The state of affairs that the Speaker hopes to bring about.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker intends through the use of language to get another person to act.

Tasting.def: An Agent ingests or begins to ingest a Food item that they have not had before with the intention of determining its quality on some scale.

roles.Agent: The person who eats or drinks the Food. 'Patty tried the sausage before serving it.'
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Food: The entity being tasted or ingested by the Agent.
roles.Instrument: The object that the Agent uses to try the Food.
roles.Manner: A characterization of the Agent as they try the Food.
roles.Means: The method in which the Food is eaten or drunk if not covered by the FE Instrument.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the scene of an Agent trying Food occurs.\ 'Patty tried the sausage in the kitchen.'
roles.Purpose: A more specific description of what the Agent hopes to determine by trying the Food.
roles.Time: The time at which the Agent tries the Food.

Team.def: A Team is a group with shared goals and works toward them together in a coordinated fashion.

roles.Activity: The job, obligation, or goal worked towards jointly by the Members of the Team.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Members: This FE identifies the people or things that form the Aggregate.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Team: This FE identifies the collection of entities that are the Team.

Telling.def: A Speaker addresses an Addressee with a Message, which may be indirectly referred to as a Topic.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee receives the Message from the Speaker.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: The Manner describes the way in which the Speaker delivers the Message.
roles.Means: The Means describes the way the Speaker accomplishes the task of giving the Addressee the Message.
roles.Medium: This FE is the Medium in which the Message is expressed.
roles.Message: The Message is the communication produced by the Speaker.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Place is the location in which the Speaker informs the Addressee of the Message.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker is the sentient entity that produces the Message.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Speaker informs the Addressee of the Message.
roles.Topic: The Topic is a general description of the content of the Message.

Temperature.def: An Entity has a Temperature characterized by the target.

roles.Attribute: The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the Circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Temperature.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: A modifier expressing the deviation of the Temperature from the norm.
roles.Entity: The Entity for which the temperature Attribute is under consideration.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Temperature: A quantity or other characterization of the Entity's state with respect to the temperature Attribute.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular Degree for the temperature Attribute.

Temporal_collocation.def: A Trajector is identified as occurring at the same time as some better-known Landmark.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Landmark_entity: The entity which designates the time of some trajector.
roles.Landmark_event: The event which designates the time at which a trajector occurs.
roles.Landmark_period: The period in which a trajector takes place.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Trajector_entity: The entity that occurs at some time. 'The current President of Georgia was born in Tbilisi.' 'Books in the early 19th century had fewer pictures.'
roles.Trajector_event: The event that occurs at some time. 'Currently, researchers are making new discoveries very quickly.'
roles.Trajector_period: The period that occurs with respect to some other time.

Temporal_pattern.def: A salient Subevent has a Pattern of recurrence within a larger Process.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Pattern: The Pattern that can be detected in the recurrence of the Subevents of the Process .
roles.Process: The larger event that is characterized by the recurring Subevents.
roles.Subevent: The salient, punctual event that is construed as part of a Process.

Temporal_subregion.def: A Subpart of a Time_period is picked out.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Subpart: The part of the Time_period which is profiled.
roles.Time: This FE indicates the Time that is being referred to.
roles.Time_period: A temporal span conceived of as a whole. 'A zillion copies and clones have been made of this Russian game since it first was released in the mid 80's.'

Temporary_group.def: A Temporary_group is formed from members of a Parent_organization for a particular Purpose.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Members: The people belonging to the Temporary_group.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Parent_organization: The Parent_organization is the larger group from which members are selected to be part of the Temporary_group.
roles.Place: This FE describes the general location where the Temporary_group operates, but does not indicate the possessor of the Temporary_group.
roles.Purpose: The reason for which an Temporary_group is formed.
roles.Temporary_group: The group formed temporarily from a larger group for a particular purpose.

Temporary_leave.def: A Person takes leave from his or her routine Activity (such as work or school) for a Duration of time.

roles.Activity: This FE describes the activity or responsiblilities from which the Person is taking a temporary leave.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time the Person is absent from his or her Activity.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for the Person's absence.
roles.Frequency: How often the absences occur. 'Laura's frequent absences in London meant that her baby, Emma, was often left behind with Gwenny. '
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Person: The person who is absent from his or her Activity for a Duration of time.
roles.Purpose: The Person's intended purpose for the temporary leave.
roles.Time: The time at which the leave occurs. 'Columbus took leave of the known world on 6 September 1492.'

Temporary_stay.def: A Guest stays for a time at a Location, which is not his or her permanent residence, for some Duration.

roles.Co-participant: Another person who, along with the Guest, is temporarily living at the Location.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Guest remains at the Location.
roles.Explanation: A state of affairs that provides an explanation for the temporary stay.
roles.Frequency: The average number of times the event occurs over a period.
roles.Guest: The Guest remains for a relatively short period of time in the Location.
roles.Host: The Host is living at the Location on a permanent basis, and is allowing the Guest to stay there.
roles.Location: The Location where the Guest spends a short amount of time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the type of event by comparison to other events (the same way) or by characterizing a state of the Guest that affects the action.
roles.Means: An action of the Guest that brings about their ability to stay at the Location.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place indicates the larger physical setting of the temporary stay.
roles.Purpose: The activity that the Guest hopes to achieve by the stay.
roles.Time: The time at which the temporary stay takes place.

Terms_of_agreement.def: A condition that is set out in an Agreement imposes Requirements on a Party or parties, with respect to some Regulated_entity.

roles.Agreement: A mutual commitment to an obligation made by two or more parties.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Desired_state_of_affairs: An event or state of affairs that is desirable to some or all of the parties to the Agreement and which is conditional on the Requirements being met.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Party: A party who demands that certain Requirements be met before they will enter into an Agreement or allow a Desired_state_of_affairs to be realized.
roles.Regulated_entity: A salient entity, an activity or behavior by the parties to the agreement to which a particular stipulation pertains.
roles.Requirements: The Requirements that a particular stipulation of the Agreement imposes on one or both of the parties.

Terrorism.def: A Terrorist commits a violent or otherwise harmful Act upon a Victim in order to coerce or terrorize a government or populace.

roles.Act: The Act is the harmful action performed by the Terrorist or terrorist organization.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Instrument: The Instrument is used by the Terrorist in order to inflict harm or commit the Act.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Terrorist commits the Act.
roles.Means: The intermediate action performed by the Terrorist in order to comit the Act.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Act takes place.
roles.Purpose: The action or state-of-affairs that the Terrorist is trying to accomplish by commiting the Act.
roles.Terrorist: The Terrorist commits the Act of terror for political or ideological gains.
roles.Time: The location in time when the Act takes place.
roles.Victim: The Victim is most directly affected or harmed by the Act of terrorism.

Text.def: A Text is an entity that contains linguistic, symbolic information on a Topic, created by an Author at the Time_of_creation.

roles.Beneficiary: The person for whom the Text is produced.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The region where the Text is sold, circulated, or otherwise popular.
roles.Text: The Text is the entity that contains linguistic information.

Text_creation.def: An Author creates a Text, either written, such as a letter, or spoken, such as a speech, that contains meaningful linguistic tokens, and may have a particular Addressee in mind.

roles.Addressee: This is the person to whom the Message is communicated.
roles.Author: The Author produces a particular Text.
roles.Beneficiary: Beneficiary identifies the person in whose honor or for whose benefit the Text is created.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for creating the text. 'I wrote the article because I would have lost my teaching post otherwise.'
roles.Instrument: The instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action. This frame includes some peculiar examples of manner phrases. Write it in pen. Write it in ink.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which a Text is created.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
roles.Text: The entity which results from the act of writing or speaking.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time at which the text is created.

Theft.def: These are words describing situations in which a Perpetrator takes Goods from a Victim or a Source.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE identifies the Explanation for why a theft occurs.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that a theft occurs. 'Thieves twice stole my Dodge Dart in the last two weeks'
roles.Goods: Goods is anything (including labor, time, or legal rights) that can be taken away.
roles.Instrument: An object used by the Perpetrator in taking possession of the Goods.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the theft occurs.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which a Perpetrator takes the Victim's Goods.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Perpetrator: Perpetrator is the person (or other agent) that takes the goods away.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the theft occurs.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which a theft occurs.
roles.Source: Source is the initial location of the goods, before they change location.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the theft occurs.
roles.Victim: Victim is the person (or other sentient being or group) that owns the goods before they are taken away by the perpetrator.

Thermodynamic_phase.def: This frame describes the attributes of a thermodynamic Phase of Matter.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Matter: The Matter is the physical substance or entity being described in terms of a Phase.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Phase: The state of the Matter being described.

Thriving.def: An Entity is in a state such that it participates in a preponderance of states and events which are desirable for it.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Desirability: This FE describes the state of the Entity.
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation to its end.
roles.Entity: The Entity is experiencing a period of desirable events or states.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for why or how the Entity thrives.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place where the thriving takes place.
roles.Role: The category in which the Entity thrives.
roles.Time: The Time during which the Entity thrives.

Thwarting.def: In this frame a Preventing_cause interferes with the ability of a Protagonist to complete an intended Action.

roles.Action: The Action is the action or event certain individuals desire to bring about which is prevented by the Preventing_cause.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for why or how the Protagonist and/or Action was thwarted by the Preventing_cause.
roles.Frequency: This FE is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Preventing_cause thwarts the Action of the Protagonist.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place is where the thwarting occurs.
roles.Preventing_cause: The Preventing_cause is the agent or force who keeps the Protagonist from completing her or his planned Action.
roles.Protagonist: The Protagonist is the individual or group of individuals who have a planned Action which is prevented by the Preventing_cause
roles.Time: The Time is when the thwarting occurs.

Time_period_of_action.def: LUs in this frame denote a period of time in which an Enabled_action becomes possible.

roles.Agent: The Agent is the one who performs the Enabled_action.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: A quantity or other characterization of the period of the time in which an Enabled_action is allowed.
roles.Enabled_action: The action that becomes possible through the existence of the period of time.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Time_vector.def: An Event is identified as occurring at a particular Distance and in a particular Direction from a Landmark_event.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Direction: This FE marks expressions that indicate whether the Target is prior or subsequent to the Landmark_event on the time line.
roles.Distance: This FE marks expressions that indicate the amount of time that lies between the Target and the Landmark_event.
roles.Event: This FE indicates the Event temporally located with respect to the Landmark_event.
roles.Landmark_event: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate the reference point in which the Event is anchored.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Timespan.def: The words in this frame describe a period of time, as opposed to a point in time.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: A quantity or other characterization of the State's duration.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State: An ongoing state whose duration can be measured.

Timetable.def: A Timetable of Events is a mental object deliberately created, modified or kept by a Cognizer.

roles.Cognizer: The sentient entity who keeps the Timetable.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Events: The events which are to take place at specified times acording to the Timetable.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: The purpose for which the Cognizer keeps the Timetable.
roles.Timetable: The mental schedule of times at which the Events are set to take place.

To_do.def: A task someone needs or intends to do, or asked someone else to do; reminders.

roles.Agent: Who should do it.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Recipient: Who the task is aimed at ("tell Priya").

Tolerating.def: The words in this frame describe an Experiencer's feelings of tolerating with respect to some Content.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances FE encodes the circumstances or conditions under which the Experiencer experiences the emotion.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: Content is what the Experiencer's feeling of tolerance is directed towards..
roles.Event: The Event is the occasion or happening that Experiencers in a certain emotional state participate in.
roles.Experiencer: The Experiencer experiences tolerance with respect to the Content.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is the explanation for why an Experiencer tolerates the Content.
roles.Manner: Manner of performing an action
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State: The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
roles.Time: The time at which the Experiencer is in the state of toleration.
roles.Topic: The Topic is the area about which the Experiencer has the tolerated experience(s).

Tool_purpose.def: A living entity intends a Tool to be able to fulfill a generic Purpose.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: A Purpose is a generic goal associated with the Tool.
roles.Tool: A Tool is the object or process that has been designed specifically to achieve a Purpose.

Topic.def: A stretch of linguistic discourse or a Text that a Communicator produces has a Topic that it is about.

roles.Communicator: The Communicator is the person who has produced a Text on a Topic.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Text or Communicator presents the Topic.
roles.Manner: This FE marks expressions in which Manner the Topic is treated.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Text: A set of propositions that is coherent in being about a Topic 'Sue bought a book about Pennsylvania'
roles.Time: The time at which the Communicator produces Text on a Topic.
roles.Topic: The Topic is what a Text is about.

Touring.def: A Tourist experiences an Attraction, a location with a unique history or other societally recognized individual character, with the goal of seeing and learning about it.

roles.Attraction: The societally-recognized unique location that the Tourist experiences.
roles.Co-participant: The Co-participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the touring event with the Tourist.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time the touring activity lasts.
roles.Manner: Any description of the details of the event in terms of how they compare to other events (the same way) or in terms of how the state of the Tourist affects them
roles.Means: The Means indicates a method the Tourist is using to participate in a tour.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the touring takes place.
roles.Purpose: Some action that the Tourist is trying to accomplish with touring.
roles.Time: The time that the touring takes place.
roles.Tourist: The individual that is seeking an experience at an Attraction.

Toxic_substance.def: A Toxic_substance causes death or harm when introduced into or absorbed by a living organism, the Victim.

roles.Circumstances: A set of circumstances, often the relative amount of the Toxic_substance that is present, under which the Toxic_substance is specified to have or lack a toxic e
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Temporal period for which the substance or source remains toxic to the victim.
roles.Explanation: A fact or action that explains why the Toxic_substance has a harmful effect on the Victim .
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Toxic_substance: This FE marks expressions that indicate the substance which potentially causes harm to a Victim.
roles.Toxin_source: A living organism, object or process that produces a Toxic_substance.
roles.Victim: The Victim is the being or entity that is capable of being harmed by the Toxic_substance.

Transfer.def: This frame involves a Donor transferring a Theme to a Recipient.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Donor: The person that begins in possession of the Theme and causes it to be in the possession of the Recipient.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which an event occurs.
roles.Manner: Any description of the transfer which is not covered by more specific FEs
roles.Means: The action whereby the transfer of the Theme from the Donor to the Recipient is effected.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which a Theme is transferred
roles.Recipient: The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
roles.Theme: The object that changes ownership.
roles.Time: When the transfer occurs.
roles.Transferors: The Donor and Recipient conceived of as a unit.

Transition_to_a_quality.def: An Entity ends up with a particular new Final_quality.

roles.Circumstances: This FE marks the set of conditions under which the Entity adopts Final_quality.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity which undergoes a change so that it possesses the Final_quality.
roles.Explanation: Any eventuality or entity which brings about the change of the Entity.
roles.Final_quality: The quality that the Entity has at the end of the event.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the change takes place. 'I went nuts in Berlin .'
roles.Time: When the change occurs. 'By 1945 he had gone bad .'

Transition_to_a_situation.def: An Entity ends up in a Final_situation. 'I have come to appreciate good coffee .' 'We have come to expect three meals a day .' 'When the history of our times comes to be written , They Organized Themselves to Death will be the only possible

roles.Circumstances: This FE marks the set of conditions under which the Entity enters the Final_situation.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity which undergoes a change, ending up in the Final_situation.
roles.Explanation: Any eventuality or entity which brings about the change of the Entity.
roles.Final_situation: The Entity's situation after the change. 'My father came to wonder why he 'd worked so hard .'
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the change takes place.
roles.Time: When the change occurs. 'By 1945 he had come to doubt the advisability of anyone having such a weapon.'

Transition_to_state.def: An Entity ends up in a Final_category, Final_situation, or Final_quality which it was not in before.

roles.Circumstances: This FE marks the set of conditions under which the Entity enters the Final_category, Final_situation, or Final_quality.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The Entity which undergoes a change, ending up in the Final_category, Final_situation, or Final_quality.
roles.Explanation: Any eventuality or entity which brings about the change of the Entity.
roles.Final_category: The category that the Entity ends up in after the change.
roles.Final_quality: The quality of the Entity after the change.
roles.Final_situation: The Entity's situation after the change. 'My father got to where he did in the business through instinct and entrepreneurialism.'
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the change takes place.
roles.Time: When the change occurs. 'By 1945 he had become uncertain of the advisability of anyone having such a weapon.'

Translating.def: A Cognizer produces a Target_symbol which represents, in the Target_representation format, a Content that pre-exists in the form of a Source_symbol in a Source_representation format.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are the set of conditions in which the translation is made.
roles.Cognizer: This is the person who carries out the translation.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Content: The information that is meant to be represented by the Source_symbol and Target_symbol.
roles.Manner: Any description of the translation event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comp
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Cognizer which accomplishes the translation of the Content.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the translation takes place.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Cognizer hopes to bring about by translating.
roles.Source_representation: The representation system in which the Content pre-exists.
roles.Source_symbol: A symbol or set of symbols representing the Content in the Source_representation format.
roles.Target_representation: The representation system into which the Content is rendered by the Cognizer.
roles.Target_symbol: A symbol or set of symbols representing the Content in the Target_representation format.
roles.Time: This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate when a certain Categorization was made.

Transportation_status.def: A Rider is being transported in a Vehicle, or is moving on foot.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Rider: The Rider is being transported by a Vehicle.

Trap.def: A Deceiver sets up a Trap in order to cause a Victim to have an incorrect understanding about a situation.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Deceiver: The Trap is orchestrated by a Deceiver.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Trap: The Trap is a device, strategy, or system designed to mislead and cause harm to a Victim.
roles.Victim: The Deceiver intends to mislead and cause harm to the Victim by means of the Trap.

Travel.def: In this frame a Traveler goes on a journey, an activity, generally planned in advance, in which the Traveler moves from a Source location to a Goal along a Path or within an Area.

roles.Area: This is the Area in which the traveling takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Direction: The direction in which the Traveler goes.
roles.Duration: This FE identifies the Duration of time during which the trip occurs.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the travel is undertaken.
roles.Frequency: The Frequency with which the Traveler makes the journey.
roles.Goal: The Goal is the location where the travelers end up.
roles.Means: The action done by the Traveler by which the traveling is accomplished.
roles.Mode_of_transportation: The Mode_of_transportation expresses how the motion of the Traveler is effected, by their body or by a vehicle which holds and conveys the Traveler.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: The Path is the route along which the travel takes place.
roles.Place: The Place is the location of the motion. It describes the area in which motion (with a specified Source, Path or Goal) takes place.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Traveler travels, i.e.
roles.Source: The Source is the starting point of the trip.
roles.Time: When the traveling occurs.
roles.Traveler: This is the living being which travels. Normally, the Traveler is expressed as an external argument.

Traversing.def: A Theme changes location with respect to a salient location, which can be expressed by a Source, Path, Goal, Area, Direction, Path_shape, or Distance, as shown in the examples below: '' 'Start your ascent from Achintree Farm in Glen Nevis.'

roles.Area: This frame element is used for expressions which describe a general area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular and not to co
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Direction: The direction in which the Theme goes. 'The frogs jumped down through the meadow.'
roles.Distance: Any expression which characterizes the extent of motion expresses the frame element Distance.
roles.Duration: The length of time that the Theme spends in motion.
roles.Explanation: A factor which explains the particular motion or manner of motion of the Theme.
roles.Frequency: The number of times that an action occurs in a given time.
roles.Goal: Any expression which tells where the Theme ends up as a result of the motion expresses the frame element Goal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Path: Any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal (see below) expresses the frame element Path, including directional expressions:
roles.Path_shape: The configuration formed by the entire Path of the Theme, taken simultaneously.
roles.Place: The Place is where the motion (which is specified by a Source, Path or Goal) is located.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Theme wishes to bring about.
roles.Source: Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source.
roles.Theme: This is the object which moves. In many sentences this FE will be expressed as something which moves under its own power. However, this FE is not required to be
roles.Time: The time at which the motion takes place.

Treating_and_mistreating.def: In this frame an Agent is evaluated as behaving toward an Affected_Party in some Manner, which may or may not be incorporated into the target LU.

roles.Affected_party: The person to whom behavior is directed by the Agent.
roles.Agent: This FE marks expressions that denote the person whose conduct is being evaluated.
roles.Circumstances: This FE marks expressions that indicate a set of Circumstances under which the Agent acts in a particular way.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE marks expressions that indicate why an Agent behaved in a certain way.
roles.Manner: This FE marks expressions that characterize the way that the Agent behaves toward the Affected_Party.
roles.Means: The way in which the treating or mistreating is done.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the Agent exhibits their behavior.
roles.Time: The Time when the Agent behaves in a certain way.

Trendiness.def: A Behavior, attributed to an Evaluee, conforms with or is heavily influenced by a popular trend or practice, often in the realm of fashion, design, though extending social and interactional behavior in general.

roles.Circumstances: Some specification of the circumstances under which the Behavior is trendy or not.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Evaluee: The Evaluee is judged to conform to some degree with popular fashion with respect to his or her behavior.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Behavior is trendy..
roles.Time: The Time during which the Behavior is trendy or fashionable.

Trial.def: A trial is a process conducted in a Court before a Judge and (usually) a Jury in which the participants meet in order to decide a Case.

roles.Case: The Case which a Trial is convened to decide.
roles.Charges: The legal label for the crime that the Defendant is accused of.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Court: The specific room where the participants in a Trial meet.
roles.Defendant: The person charged with an offence.
roles.Defense: The individual or group which is responsible for promoting the welfare of the Defendant during a Trial, usually involving the contention that the Defendant is i
roles.Judge: The official who directs and presides over the Trial.
roles.Jury: The group of individuals who observe the Trial and ultimately attempt to come to a verdict.
roles.Manner: The way in which the Trial is conducted.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the trial occurs.
roles.Prosecution: The individual or group responsible for promoting the interests of the state in the Trial, prototypically including presenting arguments for the guilt of the De
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the trial occurs.

Triggering.def: A Cause triggers a System to operate in accordance with its intended purpose.

roles.Actor: An entity which participates in a Cause, perhaps volitionally and perhaps not.
roles.Cause: The Cause interacts with the System such that conditions are met for the System to operate.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Any holistic description of the event, including overall depictions (the same way) and descriptions pertaining to the Actor's or Cause's influence on the charac
roles.Means: The Means is a subevent which the Cause or Actor participates in which results in triggering the System .
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the triggering takes place. 'Police came running downstairs when someone set off the metal detector at the county courthouse.'
roles.Purpose: The purpose of the Actor in setting off the System.
roles.System: The System interacts with or detects the Cause and activates.
roles.Time: The time when the triggering takes place.

Trust.def: A Cognizer thinks that the Information given by a particular Source is correct.

roles.Cognizer: The Cognizer is the person who has an opinion about the reliability of a Information_source or the Information from the Information_source.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Expressor: An object or action associated with the Cognizer which is so affected by the Cognizer's belief that it reveals the Cognizer's state.
roles.Information: The text or speech which the Cognizer has heard and evaluates the truth of.
roles.Information_source: The individual that gives Information to the Cognizer.
roles.Manner: A description of an aspect of the Cognizer that also affects the nature of the trusting, or a general comparison of the state-of-affairs to others.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Try_defendant.def: A Defendant is tried by a Jury or Judge in a Court for Charges.

roles.Charges: This FE identifies the Charges brought against the Defendant.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Defendant: The Defendant is being tried for the Charges in Court.
roles.Governing_authority: The Defendant is tried under the laws of the Governing_authority.
roles.Judge: The Judge heads the Court where the case is tried.
roles.Jury: This FE identifies the people who are charged by the Court to listen to the testimony, evidence, and arguments, and come to a consensus about the guilt or innoc
roles.Manner: The Manner of the trial of the Defendant.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the case is tried.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the case is tried.

Trying_out.def: An Evaluator participates in an Experience (or metonymically, a salient Entity of the Experience), often for the first time, in order to form an opinion about its quality.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: Entity is something that the Evaluator uses to try an Experience, and metonymically stands in for the Experience.
roles.Evaluator: The person (or metonymic manifestation thereof) that participates in the Experience.
roles.Experience: The activity or event that the Evaluator participates in.
roles.Manner: A description of how the Evaluator acts in having the Experience.
roles.Means: A description of what the Evaluator does in order to participate in the Experience.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The physical location in which the Experience occurs.
roles.Purpose: A more explicit description of what the Evaluator seeks to learn by having the Experience.
roles.Time: The temporal location during which the Experience occurs.

Turning_out.def: A State_of_affairs turns out to be true in someone's knowledge of the world.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State_of_affairs: The state of affairs that a cognizer realizes.
roles.Time: The time at which the State_of_affairs is realized.

Type.def: This frame has to do with nouns denoting types of entities.

roles.Category: The more general type that the target denotes a subtype of.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Subtype: The entity which denotes a subtype of the more general Category.
