Typicality.def: A State_of_affairs is generally, or with regard to a particular Feature, representative of its class, which may be narrowed to a specific Comparison_set.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Feature: A property of the State_of_affairs wherein it differs or is similar to members of a Comparison_set.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.State_of_affairs: The state of affairs which is evaluated with regard to whether it exhibits the essential characteristics of a Comparison_set.

Unattributed_information.def: A Reported_fact is presented by the speaker as deriving from statements (made directly to them or to others) of third parties.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The span of time for which the Reported_fact has been circulating.
roles.Explanation: The reason for which or the apparant cause of the Reported_fact.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Reported_fact: An assertion of a state, event, property or existence or the assignment to a category that the speaker attributes to unnamed others.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Reported_fact was reported.

Undergo_change.def: An Entity changes, either in its category membership, its situation, or in terms of the quality of an Attribute.

roles.Attribute: A characteristic of the Entity for which a quality can be assigned or determined by calculation, measurement, or observation.
roles.Cause: An event or state that causes the change to take place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The concrete or abstract entity that undergoes a change.
roles.Final_category: The type of Entity that results from the change.
roles.Final_quality: The quality of the Attribute that results from the change.
roles.Final_situation: The Entity's situation that results from the change.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Initial_category: The category that the Entity belongs to before it undergoes the change.
roles.Initial_quality: The value of the Attribute before the change takes place.
roles.Initial_situation: The situation that the Entity began in. 'She slowly shifted from giving him makework to actually finding he had some skills .'
roles.Manner: Any description of the Change event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location that the change takes place.
roles.Time: The time at which the Entity undergoes the transformation.
roles.Value_range: The Initial_value and Final_value taken together as the range through which the Entity changes.

Undergo_transformation.def: An Entity changes from one kind of thing (Initial_category) to another kind of thing (Final_category).

roles.Cause: An event or state that causes the change to take place.
roles.Circumstances: The physical or abstract Circumstances under which the change takes place.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The concrete or abstract entity that undergoes a change.
roles.Final_category: The type of Entity that results from the change.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Initial_category: The category that the Entity belongs to before it undergoes the change.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Transformation event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), se
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location that the change takes place.
roles.Time: The time at which the Entity undergoes the transformation.

Undergoing.def: An Entity is affected by an Event. 'The hotel is undergoing renovations at this time.'

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The thing which is affected by the Event.
roles.Event: A change in the world which affects the Entity.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for which the Entity undergoes the Event.
roles.Manner: Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the Entity undergoes the Event.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which the Entity undergoes the Event.
roles.Time: The Time at which the Entity undergoes the Event.

Undressing.def: A Wearer removes an item of Clothing from a Body_location (the part of the body that the Clothing is prototypically worn on.) 'Walking on sand is better if you take off your shoes.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Clothing: The item that the Wearer is initially wearing but then removes.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Manner: Any description of the clothing removal which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compa
roles.Means: The Means is an act whereby the Wearer achieves the removal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which the Wearer undresses an item of Clothing.
roles.Purpose: The Purpose for which a Wearer undresses.
roles.Result: The Result of the event.
roles.Time: The Time at which a Wearer undresses.
roles.Wearer: The individual who begins the action wearing the Clothing and ends the action without it.

Unemployment_rate.def: Based on how many Individuals are employed, the Individuals as a whole are described with a Value (either a percentage or absolute number) representing the Employment of the Individuals.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Degree: A modifier expressing the deviation of the Value from the norm.
roles.Employment: The property of a group of Individuals describing how many of them are employed or unemployed.
roles.Individuals: The group of people whose employment status is considered.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Individuals under consideration reside.
roles.Time: The Time during which Employment level of the Individuals has a specified Value.
roles.Value: The count or percentage of people among the group of Individuals that are of the specified employment status.

Use_firearm.def: An Agent causes a Firearm to discharge, usually directing the projectile from the barrel of the Firearm (the Source), along a Path, and to a Goal.

roles.Agent: The self-directed entity that uses and activates the Firearm.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Firearm: This FE identifies the Firearm that an Agent activates so that it rapidly propels a projectile.
roles.Goal: Goal is the location the Theme ends up in, or is intended to end up in.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the manner in which an Agent uses the Firearm.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the means by which an Agent uses the Firearm.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Agent intentionally affects the Patient.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent uses the firearm.
roles.Source: The Source is the location of the Firearm from which projectiles originate.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Agent fires the Firearm.

Used_up.def: Through use, a Resource is diminished in quality or quantity (up to complete attrition) such that it becomes less capable of sustaining future use.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes an event or state from whose occurrence the Resource's being used up logically follows.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Resource: The Resource is a physical entity or an ability to perform work that was used in an earlier process, typically in pursuit of a goal.

Usefulness.def: An Entity aids in the successful completion of a Purpose.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Entity: The item which is useful for some purpose.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: The kind of task which is promoted by the use or presence of the Entity.
roles.Time: When the Entity is useful for a Purpose.

Using.def: An Agent manipulates an Instrument in order to achieve a Purpose.

roles.Agent: The Agent uses the Instrument to achieve their Purpose.
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation to its end.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Instrument: An entity directed by the Agent that serves to bring about the Purpose of the Agent.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent uses the Instrument.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Agent uses the Instrument.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent uses the Instrument.
roles.Role: An Instrument that has a function associated with it.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent uses the Instrument.

Using_resource.def: An Agent has access to a finite amount of some Resource and uses it in some way to complete a Purpose.

roles.Agent: The person who depletes a Resource to achieve some Goal
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: A more specific description of how the Purpose is achieved by spending the Resource.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The physical location where the Resource is used.
roles.Portion: The amount of the Resource that the Agent uses to achieve the Purpose.
roles.Purpose: What the Agent is attempting to achieve by using the Resource.
roles.Resource: The exhaustible commodity that the Agent has access to.
roles.Time: The time at which the Resource is used.

Vehicle.def: The frame concerns the vehicles that human beings use for the purpose of transportation.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Vehicle: Vehicle is the transportation device that the human beings use to travel.This FE is incorporated into each LU in this frame.

Vehicle_departure_initial_stage.def: A Vehicle moves into position or otherwise changes configuration or state as preparation for normal operation.

roles.Circumstances: This FE indicates the Circumstances under which the preparation of the Vehicle takes place.
roles.Co-participant: An individual or vehicle that is also involved in the preparations.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation is a proposition from which the main clause logically follows.
roles.Manner: Any description of the preparation for motion which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions
roles.Means: An event in which the Vehicle participates which causes or enables it to travel.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The Place describes the location where the Vehicle prepares for motion.
roles.Result: The Result of the Vehicle's motion. 'The plane lifted off right into some trees.'
roles.Source: Any expression which describes the location that the Vehicle has been stationed at.
roles.Time: The Time when the Vehicle gets ready for motion.
roles.Vehicle: The vehicle which moves into position for typical operation.

Vehicle_landing.def: A flying Vehicle comes to the ground at a Goal in a controlled fashion, typically (but not necessarily) operated by an operator.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the landing event itself and any of its part
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Frequency: How often the Vehicle lands at the Goal.
roles.Goal: Goal is any expression that tells where the Vehicle ends up, or would end up, as a result of the motion.
roles.Manner: A Manner expression describes a property of landing which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which a Vehicle lands.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the landing occurs.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which the Vehicle lands at the Goal.
roles.Source: Source is any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the aircraft lands.
roles.Vehicle: The Vehicle comes to the ground, usually (but not necessarily) under the control of an operator.

Vehicle_subpart.def: An entity is integrated into a vehicle as a Part of a (possibly unexpressed) Whole which may refer to the whole vehicle or merely to a sub-part of the vehicle.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Part: Some Part of the larger vehicle, the Whole.
roles.Whole: A vehicle (the Whole) which includes the Part.

Verdict.def: In this frame, which is a part of the Trial sequence, a Judge gives a Finding with respect to the Charges against the Defendant in a particular Case.

roles.Case: The Case on which the verdict is being given.
roles.Charges: This FE refers to the Charges with respect to which the verdict is being given.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances under which the verdict was reached.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Defendant: The person who stands accused of a crime and is subject to the verdict.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation for the verdict given. 'The jury convicted him on all charges because of the overwhelming evidence against him.'
roles.Finding: This FE identifies the outcome of the Judge's deliberation or consideration.
roles.Judge: The Judge (which may be the jury, judge, magistrate or court) decides on the Finding.
roles.Manner: This FE identifies the Manner in which the Judge acts.
roles.Means: This FE identifies an action that the Judge performs in order to return the verdict.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Where the event takes place.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Judge returns a particular verdict.
roles.Time: When the event occurs.

Verification.def: An Inspector attains a degree of certainty in the Unconfirmed_content, generally by inspecting some evidence.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The reason for the state of the verification event.
roles.Inspector: The individual or individuals that ascertain that the Unconfirmed_content is true.
roles.Instrument: A tool or instrument used by the Inspector in the verification process.
roles.Manner: Any description of the verification which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (har
roles.Means: An action performed by the Inspector by which the Inspector manages to establish the truth of the Unconfirmed_content.
roles.Medium: The Medium is the piece of text or work in which the Inspector verifies the Unconfirmed_content: 'Chapter four confirms the reader 's suspicions completely.'
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE describes where the verificiation event takes place.
roles.Purpose: The state of affairs that the Inspector hopes to bring about by going through the verification.
roles.Time: This FE describes the Time at which the verification event takes place.
roles.Unconfirmed_content: An open proposition that the Inspector decides by examining evidence.

Version_sequence.def: An entity goes through several versions, from initial to final.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Item: The Item is one version among several versions (which may or may not yet exist), progressively getting closer to a final version.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Victim_operated_IED.def: An improvised explosive device, the Bomb, is placed so as to be hidden from view or disguised as something not harmful.

roles.Bomb: The explosive device which activates when set off by the victim.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Victim: The Victim inadvertantly causes the Bomb to denotate.

Violence.def: The words in this frame describe acts (or situations characterized by acts) that cause injury or harm.

roles.Aggressor: The Aggressor is the person causing the Victim's injury.
roles.Aggressors: The Aggressors commit acts of violence upon each other.
roles.Cause: The Cause marks expressions that indicate some non-intentional, typically non-human, force that inflicts harm on the Victim 'The storm's violence left many live
roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the violent event and any of its participant
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: A fact or action related to one of the participants in the volient act that the Aggressor responds to in doing violence.
roles.Frequency: How often the violence occurs. 'Residents by now are used to the daily violence that plays out on their streets.'
roles.Instrument: This FE is any object used to cause the injury.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Aggressor acts upon the Victim.
roles.Means: An intentional action performed by the Aggressor that results in the committing of a violent act.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: Place identifies the place where the violence occurs.
roles.Purpose: Purpose identifies the purpose for which a harm-causing action is carried out.
roles.Time: Time identifies the time when the harm-causing event occurs.
roles.Victim: The Victim is the being or entity that is injured.

Visiting.def: An Agent matches location with an Entity in order to fulfill some Purpose.

roles.Agent: The sentient entity that is temporarily with the Entity in order to fulfil some Purpose.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The amount of time that the Agent spends with the Entity.
roles.Entity: The physical entity that is permanently associated with entities or characteristics that the Agent wishes to use for some Purpose.
roles.Frequency: A characterization of the average number of times a visit happens over a period of time.
roles.Manner: Any overall description of the details of the visit, either in terms of how it matches other events (the same way) or in terms of states of the Agent that affec
roles.Means: An action of the Agent that enables their visit.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: A description of the position of the Agent during the visit.
roles.Purpose: The activity that is enabled by the Entity and that the Agent wishes to achieve.
roles.Time: The time at which a visit is made.

Vocalizations.def: This frame is concerned with the sounds produced by animate entities by means of their vocal tracts.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: This FE idntifies the Explanation that the Sound_source produces the sound.
roles.Frequency: How often the Vocalization event occurs.
roles.Manner: Certain properties of the sound relating to its production, loudness, etc may be of lexicographic interest if they describe properties of a sounds as such: loud
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location at which sound is produced. This FE differs from Location_of_sound_source in that it does not highlight the sound's spreading from its source to th
roles.Sound_source: An entity that is construed as a single point source emitting sound.

Volubility.def: These words describe the size of message that a Speaker is judged by a (usually unexpressed) Judge to give, either in a specific occasion or Topic or in general.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: Manner in which the speaker is reticent or voluble.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Speaker: This is the person who is characterized as talkative, reticent etc.
roles.Text: Text is rarely expressed because the quantity of information given is the focus of the frame, rather than the information content.
roles.Topic: This FE is the Topic on which much or little information is communicated.

Wagering.def: A Gambler commits an Asset to a prediction that an Uncertain_situation will have a particular Outcome (or class of outcomes).

roles.Asset: Something desirable possessed by or directly associated with the Gambler which is lost if the Gambler loses the wager.
roles.Beneficiary: The Gambler intends for his/her actions to benefit Beneficiary in some way.
roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances indicates the state of affairs under which the Gambler makes a wager.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: An Explanation for why the Gambler has put the Asset up in a wager.
roles.Frequency: The Frequency with which the Gambler makes wagers.
roles.Gambler: The person who wages the Asset on a certain Outcome.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Outcome: The Gambler predicts that a certain Outcome will hold.
roles.Place: The place where the Gambler makes the wager.
roles.Purpose: The desired action or goal that the Gambler hopes to bring about.
roles.Time: The time when the Gambler makes the wager.
roles.Uncertain_situation: The Gambler predicts how an Uncertain_situation will resolve.

Waiting.def: A Protagonist delays a planned action because they cannot or do not want to proceed until an Expected_event occurs.

roles.Co-participant: Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the same event as the primary protagonist, regardless of whether the protagonist, and henc
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the waiting to its end.
roles.Expected_event: The Expected_event is an event that needs to take place or a state that needs to begin to hold before the Protagonist can proceed with their planned activities.
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the occurrence of the waiting event logically follows.
roles.Manner: Any description of the waiting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient chara
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Protagonist is waiting.
roles.Protagonist: The sentient being who cannot proceed with their planned activities until a Salient_entity has arrived or an Expected_event has occurred.
roles.Purpose: An action that the Protagonist intends to accomplish by waiting.
roles.Salient_entity: A concrete or abstract entity that the Protagonist expects to participate in an Expected_event, typically that of arriving at the Place of the Protagonist.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Protagonist is waiting.

Waking_up.def: A Sleeper transitions from a state of consciousness where they are largely unaware of their environment to a wakeful state.

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The reason for which the Sleeper awakes from the Sleep_state.
roles.Frequency: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Sleeper awakens.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.
roles.Sleep_state: This describes the state out of which the Sleeper awakens.
roles.Sleeper: This FE identifies the sleeping entity.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.

Want_suspect.def: A Suspect has been investigated and has a warrant issued for his or her arrest on certain Charges.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Suspect: The Suspect is suspected of having committed a crime by the authorities who want the Suspect to enter the criminal process.

Warning.def: A Speaker warns an Addressee by giving a Message that describes an undesirable situation that may affect the Addressee.

roles.Addressee: The Addressee receives the warning from the Speaker.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: The Manner describes the way in which the Speaker delivers the warning.
roles.Means: The Means describes the way the Speaker accomplishes the task of warning the Addressee.
roles.Medium: This frame element is the Medium in which the Message is expressed.
roles.Message: The Message is the communication produced by the Speaker.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location in which the Speaker warns Addressee.
roles.Speaker: The Speaker produces the Message to alert the Addressee as to possible danger.
roles.Time: The time period during which the Speaker warns the Addressee.
roles.Topic: The Topic is a general description of the content of the Message.

Waver_between_options.def: A Cognizer faces a choice on some Issue. They have several Options available but keep changing their mind between Option_1 and Option_2. The Cognizer may in fact act on their choice at some point but they need not; the Options can simply be

roles.Circumstances: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants
roles.Cognizer: The Cognizer is the person who repeatedly changes their mind about which of the Options to choose.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: In the cases where the Cognizer does not act on their choice, the Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the Cognizer's deliberations to the
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which it logically follows that the Cognizer keeps changing their mind about the Issue.
roles.Frequency: This FE describes the number of times within a given period that the Cognizer wavers.
roles.Issue: The Issue is a question about a course of action or a choice between items.
roles.Manner: Any description of the selecting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient cha
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Option_1: When there is an explicitly separate construal of the Options, Option_1 is the first-mentioned alternative, typically in the form of a from-PP.
roles.Option_2: When there is an explicitly separate construal of the Options, Option_2 is the second-mentioned alternative, typically in the form of a to-PP.
roles.Options: The Options are the alternative courses of action or the alternative physical or concrete entities that the Cognizer can choose from.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Cognizer keeps changing their mind between the Options that present themselves.
roles.Time: This FE denotes the Time interval during which the Cognizer keeps changing their mind about which of the Options to select.

Wealthiness.def: A Person or Institution is being described in terms of their wealthiness, in other words the amount of money in their possession.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Institution: A group which has (or lacks) possession of some resource.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Person: The individual or individuals whose wealthiness is being described.

Weapon.def: A Weapon is an artifact created specifically to cause harm or damage.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Weapon: An entity prototypically used by a Wielder to cause damage.

Wearing.def: The words in this frame refer to what Clothing the Wearer (or a specific Body_part of the Wearer) has on.

roles.Body_part: The body part of the Wearer which is covered by the Clothing.
roles.Clothing: This FE identifies the Clothing that the Wearer wears.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Manner: A characterization of the impression given by the Wearer's clothing status.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Wearer wishes to bring about.
roles.Source: NB: This FE will be mapped to Intended_wearing_location The location that the Wearer exits while wearing the Clothing.
roles.Time: The time at or during which the Wearer has the Clothing on.
roles.Wearer: The person whose clothing is under discussion.

Weather.def: Ambient conditions of temperature, precipitation, windiness, and sunniness pertain at a certain Place and Time.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the weather occurs.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the weather occurs.

Willingness.def: A Cognizer would engage in an Activity if asked or otherwise prompted to do so.

roles.Activity: The Activity is what the Cognizer would do under certain circumstances.
roles.Cognizer: The Cognizer is the individual that is willing to engage in the Activity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the Cognizer's willingness logically follows.
roles.Frequency: This FE denotes the number of times the Cognizer is willing per some unit of time.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Cognizer is willing to engage in the Activity.
roles.Purpose: The state of affairs that the Cognizer wants to achieve by being willing to engage in the Activity.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Cognizer is willing to engage in the Activity.

Win_prize.def: A Competitor claims a Prize as a result of the outcome of their participation in a Competition.

roles.Circumstances: The state of the world when the Competitor wins the Competition.
roles.Competitor: The individual or individuals involved in the Competition.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The reason why the Competitor wins the Competition.
roles.Manner: Any description of the Competitor which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary ef
roles.Means: An action of the Competitor that results in the outcome of the Competition.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The location where the Competition takes place.
roles.Prize: A socially and/or monetarily significant entity which is given to a Competitor according to Score or Rank.
roles.Result: The state-of-affairs that prevails as a result of the Competitor winning the Competition.
roles.Time: When the Competition takes place.

Withdraw_from_participation.def: An individual that is scheduled to be a Participant, or already is a Participant in an Activity or an Organization, indicates that they will no not or no longer participate in that Activity or Organization.

roles.Activity: The event that the Participant is engaged in or was scheduled to be engaged in.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the withdrawing event logically follows.
roles.Manner: A description of the attitude of the Participant which also affects the character of the withdrawal.
roles.Means: The act done by the Participant that accomplishes their withdrawal.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Organization: The Organization is an intentionally formed human social group with some definite structure to which the Participant belongs.
roles.Participant: The individual or individuals that are engaged or are scheduled to be engaged in an Activity.
roles.Place: This FE identifies the Place where the Participant ends the participation in the Activity.
roles.Purpose: The state-of-affairs that the Participant hopes to bring about by withdrawing
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the Participant ends their participation in the Activity.

Within_distance.def: As is usual for locative relations, the location of the Figure is specified as being inside a region defined relative to the Ground.

roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Distance: This FE identifies the Distance between the Ground and the borders of the region within which the Figure is located.
roles.Figure: The Figure is perceived as located relative to a certain Ground location.
roles.Ground: The Ground serves as a basis for describing the location of the Figure, as inside a region measured outward from the Ground and of a width specified by Distance
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").

Word_relations.def: One linguistic unit, Sign_1, has a relation to another linguistic unit, Sign_2.

roles.Circumstances: The Circumstances are conditions under which the relationship holds between Sign_1 and Sign_2.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Sign_1: FN: a linguistic unit that carries semantic, phonological or syntactic information.
roles.Sign_2: FN: a linguistic unit 'In one sense, dog is a hyponym of itself.'
roles.Signs: FN: Linguistic units ' Happy and sad are antonyms.'

Work.def: An Agent expends effort towards achieving a Goal.

roles.Agent: The Agent puts effort into reaching Goal.
roles.Circumstances: The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is independent of the the attempt of the Agent to achieve the Goal.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Duration: The time peiod over which the work takes place.
roles.Frequency: How often the Agent works.
roles.Goal: The Goal is what the Agent expends effort to achieve.
roles.Manner: The Manner in which the Agent puts in effort in acheiving the Goal.
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the effort is done.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: The place where the work is done.
roles.Purpose: The reason for which the Agent puts effort into achieving the Goal.
roles.Salient_entity: An entity that is centrally involved in the Goal that the Agent is attempting to acheive.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the Time when the effort occurs.

Working_a_post.def: The Agent is assigned to a Post where he or she performs a task associated with that Post.

roles.Agent: The Agent is assigned to a Post to perform a task involving a Salient_entity.
roles.Condition: A condition that must hold for the frame to happen ("when the ladder comes back").
roles.Explanation: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
roles.Frequency: The Frequency with which the Agent works in a given period of time.
roles.Manner: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions compar
roles.Means: This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent works at the Post.
roles.New_value: The new value when the frame states a change of an earlier fact ("moved to the 14th").
roles.Place: This FE identifies the place where the Agent staffs the Post.
roles.Post: The Post is a location or station assigned to the Agent where a task or tasks are to be performed.
roles.Purpose: This FE identifies the purpose for which the Agent works at the Post.
roles.Result: The Result of working at the Post.
roles.Salient_entity: The Salient_entity is centrally involved in the task the Agent is assigned to perform.
roles.Time: This FE identifies the time when the Agent works at the Post.
